fdroid:com.focus.launcher.name: Focus Launcher
fdroid:com.focus.launcher.summary: A text-only, black and white launcher with app timers and a weekly review
fdroid:com.focus.launcher.description:
Focus is a minimalist launcher: a home screen built to be looked at as little as possible. No icons, no colour, no feed. Black and white text, the time, the few apps you chose, and an honest picture of where your day is going.
 Home screen 
* The clock and one section next to it (your next events, or today's screen time), with a single line between them. A ring that shows the battery, or a plain clock, are one setting away.
* Up to five apps, as words. Phone and camera in the corners.
* Tap the clock to open an app of your choice. Long-press almost anything to change it.
 Every app, one swipe away 
* A plain list with a search that understands names, initials and typos.
* Apps installed in the last 24 hours sit on top.
* Sort A to Z, by most used or by most recent. With a work profile, personal and work apps get their own tabs.
* Rename apps, hide them, pin them to the home screen.
 Limits that hold 
* Social media apps and games get a daily allowance (30 minutes by default). Any other app can have one too. Mail, browsers and messengers are never limited automatically.
* When the time is used up the app locks. You can still get in, but only after a pause and only by saying so, and Focus keeps asking before every visit for the rest of the day.
* How often you went past a limit is counted and shown back to you.
 A weekly look back 
* Once a week, one screen: how long, which apps, what time of day, how often you pushed past a limit. Then a single question, and one line to write for next week.
 Private by construction 
* No internet permission: nothing can leave the phone. No account, no ads, no analytics.
* Usage access is used to count screen time. The optional accessibility service only learns which app is in front, so that it can lock it; it cannot read the screen.
* Calendar access is optional and only used to show your next events.
Website: https://how2me.me/focusapp/

fdroid:org.proninyaroslav.blink_comparis.name: Blink Comparison

fdroid:org.proninyaroslav.blink_comparis.description:
The concept of "blink comparison" method is simple - the app allows you to quickly switch pictures without delay so you can see the differences.
"Blink comparison" method uses high efficiency pattern recognition by human eyes, to permit quick verification between a reference picture and an actual one being taken on the spot. For example, in the goal of detecting tampering in high contrast nail polish tamper-evident seals.
📋 Features
* Free and Open Source software (FOSS)
* Support for various platforms and devices (currently Android only)
* Add and store reference pictures in the app or take a photo on the spot
* Encrypting images (optional), making it harder to steal or replacement
* Compare a reference image with the one just taken using "blink comparison" method
* Helps to take a compared photo in the correct position, at the correct angle, lighting and distance
* Material Design 3
* Night theme
* Responsive UI for different devices form factors
For more information, please see here: https://github.com/proninyaroslav/blink-comparison/blob/HEAD/README.md

flathub:io.github.hydrusnetwork.hydrus.name: Hydrus
flathub:io.github.hydrusnetwork.hydrus.description:
The hydrus network client is a desktop application written for Anonymous and other internet enthusiasts with large media collections. It organises your files into an internal database and browses them with tags instead of folders, a little like a booru on your desktop. Tags and files can be anonymously shared through custom servers that any user may run. Everything is free, nothing phones home, and the source code is included with the release. It is developed mostly for Windows, but builds for Linux and macOS are available (perhaps with some limitations, depending on your situation).
 Currently importable filetypes are:
 images - jpg, gif (including animated), png (including animated!), tiff, webp, bmp
 video - webm, mp4, mpeg, avi, mov, mkv, flv, wmv
 audio - mp3, flac, ogg, wma
 misc - swf, pdf, psd, zip, rar, 7z
 The client can download files and parse tags from a number of websites, including by default:
 various imageboards, with a thread watcher
 the popular boorus
 gallery sites like deviant art, and pixiv
 tumblr and twitter
 And can be extended to download from more locations using easily shareable user-made downloaders. It can also be set to 'subscribe' to any gallery search, repeating it every few days to keep up with new results.
 The program's emphasis is on your freedom. There is no DRM, no spying, no censorship. The program never phones home.

flathub:io.github.picocrypt_ng.Picocrypt.name: Picocrypt NG
flathub:io.github.picocrypt_ng.Picocrypt.summary: A very small, very simple, yet very secure encryption tool
flathub:io.github.picocrypt_ng.Picocrypt.description:
Picocrypt NG is a small, simple, yet very secure file encryption tool.
 It uses XChaCha20 for encryption and Argon2id for key derivation, with
 optional cascaded Serpent encryption in paranoid mode.
 Features include Reed-Solomon error correction for data recovery,
 keyfile support, volume splitting, and a full command-line interface
 for scripting and automation.

flathub:io.github.quantum_mutnauq.pictur.name: Pictures Converter
flathub:io.github.quantum_mutnauq.pictur.description:
The image converter is a program that allows users to convert various file formats through a
 graphical interface. With this program, the following formats can be converted into all supported
 formats:
 JPG, PNG, TIFF, and PDF
 Users can select images from different directories. By double-clicking, the program automatically
 navigates to the directory where the image is stored. After selecting the new format (using the
 buttons in the middle), the files are converted into the desired format. They are saved in the
 same directory from which they were selected.
 The TIFF and PDF formats can contain multiple pages. These pages are converted into separate
 files with sequential numbering.
 In the settings function, users can choose whether images are always saved in the "Pictures/Converted"
 directory, the original directory from which they came (note that the Flatpak version requires
 elevated permissions for this), or if the program should always prompt for the desired save location.

The Abseil library code is collected from Google's own C++ code base, has been extensively tested and used in production, and is the same code we depend on in our daily coding lives. In some cases, Abseil provides pieces missing from the C++ standard; in others, Abseil provides alternatives to the standard for special needs we've found through usage in the Google code base. We denote those cases clearly within the library code we provide you. Abseil is not meant to be a competitor to the standard library; we've just found that many of these utilities serve a purpose within our code base, and we now want to provide those resources to the C++ community as a whole.

fedora-packages:folly/folly-docs.name: folly-docs
fedora-packages:folly/folly-docs.description: Folly (acronymed loosely after Facebook Open Source Library) is a library of C++14 components designed with practicality and efficiency in mind. Folly contains a variety of core library components used extensively at Facebook. In particular, it's often a dependency of Facebook's other open source C++ efforts and place where those projects can share code. It complements (as opposed to competing against) offerings such as Boost and of course std. In fact, we embark on defining our own component only when something we need is either not available, or does not meet the needed performance profile. We endeavor to remove things from folly if or when std or Boost obsoletes them. Performance concerns permeate much of Folly, sometimes leading to designs that are more idiosyncratic than they would otherwise be (see e.g. PackedSyncPtr.h, SmallLocks.h). Good performance at large scale is a unifying theme in all of Folly. The folly-docs package contains documentation for folly.

firefox-addons:3092992.name: AdBonk - Twitch Ad Blocker
firefox-addons:3092992.summary: Block ads on Twitch live streams with AdBonk. Free, open source, and easy to use.
firefox-addons:3092992.description:
Bonk Twitch ads.
AdBonk blocks ads on Twitch live streams, helping you watch with fewer interruptions. Install the extension, open Twitch, and watch, no userscript manager or extra setup required.
• Blocks ads during Twitch live streams.
• Tries higher-quality alternative streams before using a lower-quality fallback.
• Free and open source.
During ad breaks, stream quality may temporarily drop or playback may briefly buffer. Twitch changes can affect blocking, so results may vary.
Already using the AdBonk userscript? Disable it before using the extension to avoid conflicts.
Found a problem? Report it on GitHub with your browser version, AdBonk version, and what happened:
 https://github.com/rafelolv/AdBonk/issues 
Maintained by rafelolv. Contributions and pull requests are welcome.
Source code:
 https://github.com/rafelolv/AdBonk 
*Use this extension together with an ad blocker like uBlock Origin. uBlock will handle cosmetic ads, such as those displayed in the chat, next to the stream, and in other parts of the page.

firefox-addons:3107073.name: Auto Post Facebook Groups
firefox-addons:3107073.summary: One click to copy a product image and caption for Facebook: a copy-title button, post navigation and a link formatter.
firefox-addons:3107073.description:
Auto Post to Multiple Facebook Groups & Sched adds helper tools to Facebook and to the product and deal pages you use, so you can build and manage posts in a few clicks.
FEATURES
• Copy a product image, title and caption for a post with one button
• Collect, download and re-post deal posts; follow short links to the real shop page and its price
• Light and dark themes, a small popup with your status and license
• Always up to date: a new version of the helper reaches you on your next page load
• Pro: the full helper script, unlocked with a license key
HOW IT WORKS
The tools are MavelyLink's own helper script, kept on mavelylink.com and run through your browser's user-scripts feature. After installing, a welcome page shows you step by step how to turn on "Allow User Scripts" (one switch). The developer can update the script or turn it off at any time. Your license key unlocks the Pro script.
PRIVACY
The extension keeps your settings, license and the helper's saved work in your browser. It talks to mavelylink.com (for the script, the license check and anonymous install counts you can turn off) and to the pages the helper works with. It never sells or shares your data. Privacy policy: https://mavelylink.com/fbext-privacy.php?b=fb-uxvccn

firefox-addons:2618616.name: Toast - Bookmark and Tab Manager
firefox-addons:2618616.summary: Save, organize, and restore tabs anytime. The best tab manager, session saver, and bookmark organizer for productivity!
firefox-addons:2618616.description:
The Ultimate Tab & Bookmark Manager – Organize, Save, and Restore Your Tabs
Too many tabs cluttering your browser? Toast is the ultimate bookmark manager for tabs and links, letting you save, organize, and restore them effortlessly. 
Whether you're working, researching, or collecting inspiration, Toast helps you manage browser sessions, save tabs, and organize your bookmarks without the clutter. Close tabs without losing them—Toast keeps everything you need accessible and organized across devices.
⚡ Powerful Features for Seamless Tab, Bookmark, and Session Management:
✅ Save & Bookmark Tabs – Save individual tabs or entire browser sessions with one click.
✅ Instant Restore – Open your saved tabs or entire sessions anytime, with just one click.
✅ Organize Bookmarks & Tabs – Group your saved pages and tabs by project, topic, or research.
✅ Cross-Browser Sync – Works with Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, and Opera, syncing your tabs and bookmarks seamlessly. Available for iPhone.
✅ Cloud Backup – Your bookmarks and tabs are safely stored, ensuring they’re never lost.
✅ Real-Time Tab Sync – Instantly access saved tabs and bookmarks across all your devices.
✅ Easy Sharing – Share your organized tabs and bookmarks with a single link.
🔍 How Toast Tackles Tab Clutter & Boosts Productivity:
📌 Save & organize research – Easily bookmark pages from Google Docs, YouTube, Quora, and more.
📌 Declutter your browser – Keep tabs and bookmarks neatly organized into categorized collections.
📌 Effortlessly manage sessions – Save entire browser sessions, switching between them smoothly with no hassle.
📌 Focus on what matters – Close unneeded tabs without losing important ones, keeping your browser fast and organized.
📌 Sync across browsers and devices – Access all your saved tabs and bookmarks wherever you go.
🚀 Why Choose Toast as Your Session Manager and Bookmark Organizer?
➤ Organize your tabs and sessions – Toast helps you easily manage and switch between saved sessions, keeping your workflow smooth.
➤ Efficient tab and bookmark management – No more searching through tabs or bookmarks—everything is organized for you.
➤ Boost your browser’s speed – Reduce tab clutter and improve browser performance.
➤ Perfect for professionals and creatives – Save ideas, research, and inspiration, all while staying organized and productive.
🧠 Our Journey & Insights:
Since 2019, we’ve been meticulously crafting Toast, launching four major releases and earning the “Product of the Day” award on ProductHunt. Throughout development, we learned the power of simplicity. Toast’s native, minimalistic design ensures effortless tab management while offering robust functionality across various browsers.
🔥 Join thousands experiencing a clutter-free browsing! 🔥
——————————————————
Version Change log:
⚡️Toast Crust: Introducing a new way to communicate with Toast. With two always-present buttons—Save Current Tab and Save All Tabs—you can instantly save your tabs without interrupting your research process.
🎉 Toast V4.0: Elevating Your Browsing Experience
After a series of minor yet crucial updates and the successful launch of our new iPhone app over the past year, we are thrilled to unveil a significant update amplifying your browsing experience with our browser extension. Here’s what’s new:
📑 New Saving Flow:
Revamped saving options! Now, save all tabs, single tab, or highlighted tabs into a new or existing folders. Plus, the “Last Used” feature intelligently remembers your last save location for quick access.
🔄 Sorting Capabilities:
Take control! Rearrange your items on home page by name, creation date, or manually. Easily reorder them by drag-and-drop directly on the Toast home page.
🔍 Enhanced Search:
Effortless navigation! Find folders or links instantly using the search icon in the navigation bar on the home page.
📁 Details Page Refinement:
Refined Details page for better usability. Clearer buttons and the ability to rename it directly from the navigation bar.
🌟 And More:
Several additional updates and enhancements await your exploration in the new extension version. Discover the improved Toast experience yourself!

firefox-addons:3085884.name: Dark Mode - Dark Theme for Websites
firefox-addons:3085884.summary: Turn on a dark theme for websites, and adjust brightness, contrast, and warmth for each site.
firefox-addons:3085884.description:
Dark Mode adds a comfortable dark theme to websites and lets you customize the appearance for each site.
Choose from three display modes: Dark, Filter, or Normal. Dark mode applies your selected theme to the webpage. Filter mode keeps the site's original colors while adjusting visual properties such as brightness and warmth. Normal mode leaves the website unchanged.
You can save settings for the current website or apply them to all websites at once. Sites that already have their own settings will continue to use those settings.
Fine-tune the appearance with controls for brightness, contrast, saturation, warmth, and dimming. The extension interface and webpages use the same theme, so changing the theme updates both automatically.
Additional features include Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English, plus the ability to export and import your settings for backup or migration.
You can also right-click any supported webpage to quickly enable or disable dark mode for that site.

bluejetty:00149648:ios.summary: Are you applying for the New Jersey DMV permit driver’s license test certification? Use this application to study for, improve your score on, and ultimately pass both the CDL driver's license test and the DMV driver's license test for the s
bluejetty:00149648:ios.description:
Are you applying for the New Jersey DMV permit driver’s license test certification? Use this application to study for, improve your score on, and ultimately pass both the CDL driver's license test and the DMV driver's license test for the state of New Jersey in order to obtain your permit on the very first attempt. 
This app contains quizzes that are derived from the official New Jersey Department of Motor Vehicles state manual. This application will help you in preparing for and practicing for the Car, Motorcycle, and Commercial Driver's License (CDL) tests required by the state of New Jersey. All of the practice tests included in this application are based on the most recent editions of the applicable manuals. Therefore, if you are looking for preparation for the DMV driver's license test, this is the ideal DMV driver's license test practice app for you. Cafe Packed with Delights
Your cafe is the place where all the magic happens! Serve your customers the chocolate, crafted from your very own farm. Watch their faces light up as they savor your exquisite treats. Keep expanding your cafe, opening new tables to serve more customers and increase your earnings.
Drive Thru - Fast, Fun, and Profitable
Fancy a quick buck? Why not sell your delightful mini chocolate milkshakes at a drive-thru? It’s a fast, fun, and profitable way to make money and expand your business. Plus, who can resist a refreshing milkshake on the go?
Worker and Upgrade System - Boost Your Earnings
Chocoland features a comprehensive worker and upgrade system to help you earn more money over time. Utilize your earnings strategically to upgrade your farm and cafe, hire workers, and boost your chocolate production. Remember, in my perfect Chocoland, every investment you make paves the way for greater returns.

-Immersive and engaging farm and cafe management

-A unique blend of strategy and idle gameplay
-Regular updates with new features and improvements
Expansion is the Name of the Game
As you earn money from your thriving cafe and drive-thru, you can use these profits to expand your game. Open new fields on your farm for increased wheat and milk production. Additionally, expand your cafe to serve more customers and diversify the menu. In my perfect Chocoland, the sky's the limit!
Embark on this enriching journey of managing your own farm and cafe in my perfect Chocoland. Experience the joy of nurturing cows, producing chocolate, and serving customers in your bustling cafe. It's a game that beautifully captures the essence of farming and cafe management with a sweet twist. Get ready to churn some milk, make some chocolate, and brew some success!

bluejetty:00034075:ios.description:
THE OFFICIAL LIKE NASTYA APP: GAMES, VIDEOS, SELFIE VIDEOS AND AI CALLS
Step into the sparkling world of Like Nastya, the YouTube star loved by millions of children and parents. Whether you know her as Nastya or Nastia, all her official episodes, exclusive videos, learning games, personal selfie videos and real AI conversations with Nastya and her friends live in one safe kids app for children aged 2 to 6.
NEW! SAY CHEESE WITH NASTYA: MAKE YOUR OWN SELFIE VIDEO
Create a selfie video with Nastya! Upload a photo, pick a fun story, and your child stars in an exclusive video right next to Nastya.
- Pick from a growing set of funny stories and adventures
- Your child becomes part of the show, not just a viewer
- Save the finished video and share it with family
- Photos are used only to create your video
NEW! CALL NASTYA AND HER FRIENDS: REAL-TIME AI CALLS
Your child can call Nastya and chat with her in real time, and now Nastya's friends are waiting for a call too! Pick who to call, ask questions, tell stories and enjoy playful conversations with friendly characters who answer in real voice. Every AI call is private, age appropriate and supports speech, vocabulary, creativity and communication skills, all through play.
ALL KIDS VIDEOS AND GAMES IN ONE PLACE
Looking for fun and safe entertainment for kids who love YouTube? Every official Like Nastya episode plus exclusive kids videos you will not see anywhere else are waiting here.
FUN AND EDUCATIONAL GAMES FOR KIDS
The app is packed with kids games and toddler games that help children grow while they play:
- Dress up games for girls: design outfits for Nastya and her friends
- Cooking games for kids: bake colorful cupcakes, pizza and smoothies
- Makeup and fashion: try on styles and learn self-expression
- Hair salon: wash, cut, braid and style hair like a pro
- Slime fun: create squishy, sparkly slime
- Coloring games and painting: creativity with magical tools
- Logic puzzles and arcade mini games: train memory and reflexes
- Play with ponies, dolls and adorable characters
These games for girls are perfect for toddlers and preschool kids aged 2 to 6 who love princesses, fashion, pets and fantasy. Boys love them too!
Every learning game builds real skills:
- Focus and memory
- Imagination and problem solving
- Hand and eye coordination
- Colors, shapes, numbers and letters
WATCH VIDEOS FOR KIDS: ALL EPISODES PLUS EXCLUSIVES
Your child can watch every favorite Like Nastya episode and discover exclusive videos not available on YouTube: funny adventures, songs for kids, challenges, learning clips and pretend play, updated regularly.
OPTIMIZED FOR TABLETS
Bigger screen, bigger fun! Every game, video and selfie story is optimized for iPad and feels even more immersive.
SAFE FOR KIDS, TRUSTED BY PARENTS
No external links, no pop-ups, gentle content and intuitive controls designed for little hands. A parent gate protects photo upload. Parent-approved educational value for preschool and kindergarten kids. Upgrade to the Fun Pass for a 100% ad-free experience.
FOR GIRLS, BOYS, PRINCESSES AND UNICORNS
This is not just a girl game, it is a magical world where every child can laugh, create, star in their own video and grow. From dress up with dolls to puzzles and cooking in a rainbow kitchen, there is something for everyone who loves fantasy, fashion and fun!
DOWNLOAD NOW AND JOIN THE LIKE NASTYA WORLD
Discover a world where kids learn, laugh, play and talk every day with Nastia, their favorite YouTube star, and her friends.
GO BEYOND LIMITS: UNLOCK FUN PASS
Upgrade to the Fun Pass and get everything your child dreams of:
- Full access to all games, including dress up, makeup, cooking, slime and salon fun
- Coins to call and talk to Nastya and her friends
- All premium and exclusive videos
- 100% ad-free experience with no time limits
- New content every week
- Download videos for offline play

bluejetty:00185298:ios.name: Kids Video Tube Learning Games
bluejetty:00185298:ios.summary: We made Kids Video Tube for those moments when your little one wants something to watch or play, and you want to feel good about what's on the screen. It's a calm, simple space with safe videos and shorts, nursery rhymes, learning activitie
bluejetty:00185298:ios.description:
We made Kids Video Tube for those moments when your little one wants something to watch or play, and you want to feel good about what's on the screen. It's a calm, simple space with safe videos and shorts, nursery rhymes, learning activities and 18 fun games, made for babies, toddlers and preschoolers.
Watch and listen
• Kids Shorts: quick, funny clips and tiny cartoons that are just the right length for small attention spans.
• Kids Video Shorts: cartoons and learning videos we picked with young children in mind.
• Audio Rhymes: old favorites like Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, the ABC Song and the Fish Song. The words show up on screen, and the buttons are simple enough for little hands.
Learn a little every day
• Math Learning: adding, taking away, multiplying and dividing, starting easy and getting harder as your child grows.
• 1 to 100: tap any number to see it and hear it said out loud.
• Times Tables: pick a table, practice it, then try a short quiz.
• Letter Learning: tap a letter, hear its sound and see a word that starts with it.
• General Knowledge: watch, learn to spell, or take a quiz on lots of different topics.
• Daily Quote: a small thought for the day, nice to talk about over breakfast.
Game Zone: 18 games and puzzles
Simple games that quietly build memory, focus, logic and those fine motor skills.
• Tic Tac Toe: the one we all grew up with, great for taking turns.
• Snake: help the snake grow and try to beat your best score.
• Water Sort: pour the water until every tube holds just one color.
• Memory Match: flip the cards and find the pairs.
• Balloon Pop: pop the colorful balloons before they float away.
• Jigsaw Puzzle: drag the pieces into place and watch the picture come together.
• Coloring Book: choose a color and fill in the pictures.
• Alphabet Tracing: follow the lines and learn to write each letter.
• Maze: find the way from start to finish.
• Spot the Difference: look closely and find what changed.
• Bubble Shooter: aim, match the colors and pop.
• Whack-a-Mole: tap the moles as fast as you can.
• Shape Sorter: put each shape where it belongs while learning shapes and colors.
• Fruit Sort: sort the fruit by color and kind.
• Fishing: cast the line and catch colorful fish.
• 2048: slide and join the number tiles to reach 2048.
• Match Stick: move a few matchsticks to solve a little puzzle.
• Sudoku: a gentle sudoku for practicing numbers and logic.
For parents
We check every video, rhyme and game to make sure it suits young children, so you can hand over the screen without worrying. We keep adding new videos and games, so there's always something new to find.
Thank you for letting us be a small part of your child's day.

bluejetty:00167050:ios.summary:
Do you like classic civilizational strategy? Then try a new, unique 4x RTS strategy, built on the love of classic games with lots of possibilities!
Welcome to the Civilization Hex: Tribes Rise! 
Build your town from scratch! Start from
bluejetty:00167050:ios.description:
Do you like classic civilizational strategy? Then try a new, unique 4x RTS strategy, built on the love of classic games with lots of possibilities!
Welcome to the Civilization Hex: Tribes Rise! 
Build your town from scratch! Start from a small tribe and go all the way to a world empire! Develop your lands, demonstrate your diplomacy abilities, and if it comes to that - show off your skills on the battlefield! 
Create your civilization and turn a small city into a large and powerful empire. Capture small villages and attach them to your civilization. Build farms, army barracks, mines, and more in new territories. Each building can be improved to produce more resources, gold, and accumulate military power. Help your citizens, show no mercy to your enemies, and make your kingdom thrive! How are you going to rule? Will it be a dictatorship of a frightful ruler or a democratic republic of a noble leader? It's all up to you!
Discover new lands and wonders of the world to get more advantages for your Empire. Explore, find new continents in the Open World map, capture barbaric tribes, and colonize islands! Send units on expeditions and scout missions, so always know what the enemy nations are up to. Your units may clash with enemy armies. Watch how the enemies develop and build unbeatable tactics.
Every action brings experience which improves your units and helps you become the strongest nation in the world. Each unit gains experience and new levels that will improve its stats, making it a true veteran of war. Cities also have their own levels, which you can upgrade by building up and improving structures.
If the war is upon you, become an army commander! Send your armies to battle, control the battlefield, and win no matter the cost! Unlock new and unique units, summon them to your army to repel enemy attacks, defend your territory, and capture new ones. Complete your conquest with ease and become the grand lord of your nation!
Each unit has a different skill set. Assemble an army for your playstyle: bring down all the power heads-on, or create stealthy assassins who will suddenly attack from a tuck.
Don't like fighting? No problem, you can choose to develop through diplomacy. Open new trade routes, build alliances, and help your allies so they are always ready to come to your aid and protect you from new threats.
But there is no progress until you know your ultimate goal! And that goal is represented via the huge and diverse skill tree. It has many branches of development and upgrades. Each branch covers different types of technologies. From fishing and farming to ship building and siege weapons. You can unlock the secrets of economics, philosophy, and military prowess to help you on your quest to greatness.
- Lots of unique units. From fast infantrymen and sharp archers - to warships and catapults.
- Several large maps, with randomly spawning enemies - each session will be unique
- The skill tree offers extensive improvements, with tons of deep mechanics. Learn the art of building walls to protect your cities or powerful ballistas that will help you capture enemy castles quickly.
- A large world to explore, in which you can find different biomes.
- Different civilizations and tribes, each with their own abilities, buffs, and debuffs.
- Each faction is based on real historical civilizations, with unique architecture, visuals, and culture.
- The game is easy to learn but hard to master. With each new game, you will improve your skills.
Only you will choose in which direction you want to develop.
You can play this game the way you want, there is no definite right way! Strategize, use logic, improve your skills and you will definitely succeed! You can play this game even if you don't have internet because it has offline mode!
So what are you waiting for? Download Civilization Hex: Tribes Rise right now, absolutely free, and become the ultimate ruler! Be the King!

—--
Don't forget to follow us on Instagram @BLWMealsApp 
—--
Confidently start solids with your baby. Learn how to safely prepare a variety of foods for your baby in our entirely free food library.
We’re a team of 20+ women dedicated to bringing the most up-to-date information in the world of child nutrition. Our team includes pediatricians, maternal and pediatric nutritionists, a speech therapist, and other healthcare professionals.
Our app is entirely ad-free with no random product promotions. Download it for free!
In this app you will find:
-A detailed feeding guide for each age with how to start and navigate Baby-led Weaning from 6 to 24 months along with guidance for allergen introduction. As your child grows, we also offer nutritional and behavioral guides for children from 2 to 7 years old.
-A free baby food library with photos, videos, and tips on how to cut and prepare food safely for your baby to offer as finger foods or with responsive spoon-feeding. Integrated note feature for recording baby’s favorite foods, making shopping lists, jotting questions and photos for your pediatrician and much more…
-Baby Cookbook: delicious, quick, and easy to make recipes
-650+ recipes made by nutritionists and board-certified dietitians
-450+ Vegetarian and 200+ vegan recipes
-Use our filters to find exactly what you’re looking for
-Search for specific ingredients, save your favorites, put them in folders and make notes!
-Baby Meals: Monthly meal plans (with a vegetarian option) for all ages (6 months and up), made by board-certified dietitians
-Foods Checklist (Tracker): baby's first foods checklist
-Track your baby’s first foods and take notes
-Ideal for keeping track of the top allergens introduced
-Quiz
-Fun quizzes you can find in the Guides by Age.
How BLW Meals Works:
Free version: Access to the entire 100+ food section,, over 20 nutrition guides, and multiple quizzes.
Premium version: Unlock 650+ recipes, menus for each stage of your baby’s development, a food checklist, and full access to all guides. Available with monthly and yearly plans, and a free trial option.
Your subscription renews automatically, but you can cancel anytime with just two clicks. 
The app store sends a purchase confirmation email. You can turn off auto-renewal in your subscription settings after purchase. All billing details are clearly explained within the app and the app store.
For any questions, message us on Instagram @BlwMealsApp or send an e-mail to hi@blwmeals.com
This app is for English-speaking users. For recipes and menus in Portuguese, download BLW Brasil. For Spanish, search BLW Ideas.

bluejetty:00123844:ios.name: Dog Board Game
bluejetty:00123844:ios.summary: Dog is a popular board game with cards. Your goal is to get all your and your partner's marbles into the target area before your opponents do. Our app is available for iPhone, Mac, iPad, and iPod touch. It reached repeatedly ranks 2 and 3 o
bluejetty:00123844:ios.description:
Dog is a popular board game with cards. Your goal is to get all your and your partner's marbles into the target area before your opponents do. Our app is available for iPhone, Mac, iPad, and iPod touch. It reached repeatedly ranks 2 and 3 of all games in the Swiss App Store, with thousands of ratings at an astonishing average of 4.7 stars, and ranks regularly among the top ranks for card and board game apps in several countries.
In each round you first receive a handful of cards. You have to give one of your cards with your partner, and receive one of his cards. Cards that you play advance your marble. A marble that lands exactly on another marble sends it home. Special cards speed up your moves, by exchanging marble positions, going backwards, or splitting advances over several marbles. When you are done with your own marbles, you have to help your partner, as you can only win together.
Dog for iPad, iPhone, and iPod touch lets you play on boards of variable size, and offers a variety of bot players with different characters and strength that you can select as partners or adversaries. In addition we offer the following rule variants:
- Canadian Seven: A Seven may be split among all of a team's marbles, including own and partner marbles. Such splits are available during the entire game and not just when all own marbles have reached the target area. This enables more complex moves.
- Joker cannot win: A Joker may not be used for the final move to enter a team's last marble and win the game. This prolongs the game and improves the trailing team's chances to win.
Variants may be selected separately or in combination.
The complexity of the game literally explodes with the Canadian 7 split rule. Millions of different moves are possible in some situations. We had to rebuild almost everything to ensure that even in such cases you can select every possible move without delay, and that our bot players can analyze and compare every single move. We have therefore decided to offer these variants as in-app purchases.
Invite friends to a multiplayer game, or find other players on the Internet! The players see your board and play their cards and marbles on their iPhone, Mac, iPad, or iPod touch. Your devices communicate easily over the Internet via Game Center, or locally (no registrations needed) via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi network. The app supplies bot players on empty game seats, so you can finally play with your friends even if you are missing a third or fourth player.
Blind and visually impaired players can select moves through VoiceOver. We encourage you to get acquainted with the standard VoiceOver features of iOS, and in particular with rotors.

bluejetty:00026844:ios.name: ApowerMirror- Screen Mirroring
bluejetty:00026844:ios.summary: ApowerMirror is a screen mirroring app that can be used to cast phone to computer or Smart TV (TV box) with audio. It allows you to mirror&control phone from another phone freely, and you can remotely control iPhone&iPad from computer with
bluejetty:00026844:ios.description:
ApowerMirror is a screen mirroring app that can be used to cast phone to computer or Smart TV (TV box) with audio. It allows you to mirror&control phone from another phone freely, and you can remotely control iPhone&iPad from computer with your mouse and keyboard. Moreover, 4 devices can be streamed simultaneously without delay. ApowerMirror also performs well when streaming videos, photos and documents saved on your phone in a business meeting. 
==Key Features==
• Mirror Phone to computer and Vice Versa
Screen sharing on the computer makes it possible to get a better video experience by watching movies from YouTube and Netflix on a bigger screen. Whether you’re playing PUBG Mobile, Call of Duty Mobile, Free Fire, Clash Royale, Pokemon GO, or any other mobile game, the app makes it easy to share gameplay with your fans during live streaming. Besides, controlling PC from phone is no longer a difficult thing.
• Cast Phone to TV 
ApowerMirror supports screen mirroring or casting a variety of file types (including videos, pictures, and music) from phone to TV or other DLNA device. Save your eyes from the small phone screen and enjoy big screen TV series shows in the family area now.
• Mirror&Control Phone from Phone
ApowerMirror is also a good screen mirroring app to mirror phone to phone. You can also control the phone from another phone using ApowerMirror to watch videos and movies with your friends and share your files with your audience more efficiently. For classroom set-up, the wireless screen mirroring can introduce new ways for instructors, students, teams, and meeting groups to communicate their ideas and collaborate on projects.
• Control iPhone/iPad from PC
You can take full control of your iPhone/iPad device, without cables, just need to connect to PC via Bluetooth, to do whatever you want to do on your iPhone/iPad freely, ex, play games, open an app, check the phone status and send messages from WhatsApp.
• Screen Sharing Between Different Networks
This advanced feature is AirCast! It allows screen mirroring between devices that cannot be connected to the same network. If you use AirCast, even if you are located in different places and on different network connections, you can share the screen with each other. This can be used to mirror phone to phone, cast phone to PC, and stream PC to phone.
==Suitable for Various Screen Mirroring Occasions==
* Personal use
* Business meeting
* Online class /Education
* Live streaming from Youtube, Twitch, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok etc
* Movies/Sports video mirroring
* Presentation
* Work from home
......
==Quick Guide==
1. Connect your phone and computer/TV to the same WiFi network.
2. Install and run this screen casting app( ApowerMirror) on your phone and computer/TV.
3. On your iPhone, open the Control Center and then tap "Screen Mirroring". Select the name of "Apowersoft + your device" and then your phone screen will successfully be mirrored.
If you want to mirror the devices from different networks, you can try the USB connection or AirCast.
==Supported Devices==
1. Windows & Mac
2. iPhone & iPad
3. Smart TV: Sony, Sharp, Philips, Hisense, Skyworth, Xiaomi, LG etc.
4. Devices with built-in DLNA or AirPlay protocol. Some projectors and car screens. 
Start using your favorite mouse and keyboard to take full control of phone from the computer right now!
Feedback:
1. Contact us at support@apowersoft.com
2. Send feedback from "Settings" > "Feedback" on the ApowerMirror desktop program.
3. Discord: https://discord.gg/dK7y8Sf3Re

bluejetty:00130874:ios.description:
Machinedrum: "It's awesome, a lot of fun to work with and very easy to get something going. I love the sound presets too.“
Keyboards: „An extremely flexible beatbox with tons of character."
CDM: "Finally, Your Pocket Gets a Perfect Drum Synth: Elastic Drums for iPhone."
FACT Magazine: „One of the iPad’s best drum machines.“
Unlike most drum apps that rely heavily on samples, Elastic Drums uses drum synthesis models - making the sounds much more elastic and deeply tweakable. This approach allows for radical sound shaping, and when combined with the app’s versatile effects section, Elastic Drums becomes not just a beat-making tool, but a powerful instrument for sound design.
Features:
- 6 synth channels with 20 different percussion synth engines (kick, snare, hihat, clap, tom, wobble, fm, fm4, square, grain, synth, drone, sampler, 808 kit)
- 12 parameters for each synth engine
- Automation for each parameter via knob recording or velocity
- 4 send effect channels with 2x13 mono effects and 2x11 stereo effects
- Automation for all of the 8 possible effect parameters via xy pad
- Master effects (stutter, delay, compressor ...)
- 16 step sequencer for the 6 channels, each with it's own tempo multiplier & length
- Record audio and export to via Airdrop or Audioshare 
- Email audio recordings and presets
- Ableton Link synchronization and Ableton Live Set Export
- Audiobus, Audiobus Remote, Inter-App Audio
- Midi learn/Midi implementation of the most important parameters
Factory presets by: 
App Sound, Ben Jeffrey, Bill Jobs, Dead Fader, Hecq, Kero, Leonard de Leonard, Machine Drum, Mouse on Mars, Ochre, Pan, Phlex, Pilocka Krach, Red Sky Lullaby, Servando, Shadow Dancer, Swarm Intelligence, zNo

bluejetty:00078817:ios.description:

Welcome to Eggy Party, the ultimate party royale game where the fun never stops! Run, jump, dash, roll, and whack your way through dozens of colorful obstacle courses and arenas, either solo or with friends! Face off against hundreds of whacky challenges and prove you're the top eggy in town!
ACTION-PACKED CHALLENGES BY THE DOZEN!
Eggy Party offers a variety of action-packed challenges for players to enjoy! Test your skills in a variety of mini-games, each with its own unique twist. From racing through obstacle courses to brawling in arenas, there's something for everyone to enjoy!
SUPERCHARGE YOUR EGGY!
Unlock new abilities and power-ups to supercharge your eggy! Transform into an explosive powerhouse, summon lightning to strike your opponents, shoot arrows to clear obstacles, and much more! With unlockable ultimates and pickable power-ups, the possibilities are endless!
TEAM UP TO CRACK YOUR WAY TO THE TOP!
Everything's better with friends by your side! Team up with your friends to crack your way to the top in Eggy Party! Whether you're competing in brawling arenas or racing through obstacle courses, teamwork is the key to victory!
MESS AROUND EGGY ISLAND!
Explore Eggy Town between matches and discover a variety of fun activities to enjoy with your friends! Connect with friends, express yourself with emotes, and enjoy various activities like soccer and concerts!
CREATE YOUR OWN FUN & FAME!
Unleash your creativity and become the next famous creator in Eggy Party! Use our powerful course creator to design unique courses and arenas to share with players worldwide! With new experiences hatching daily, the Eggyverse is yours to explore and create!
NEW EXPERIENCES HATCHED DAILY!
With hundreds of creators making new courses every day, there's always something new to discover in Eggy Party! Whether you're racing through obstacle courses or brawling in arenas, the Eggyverse is yours to explore and conquer! Join the party and experience endless fun in Eggy Party today! Here comes the perfect planner app for organizing all of your activities and plans.
This application is everything you need to schedule all the things you need and want to do. You can pin the most important entries to the Dashboard, so that you can always have the quick look of the upcoming duties. You can add different entries, like parties, birthdays, meetings, make lists for packing or shopping, taking down notes, adding photos and all other things that are important to you.
FEATURES:
Add different entries – tasks, events, notes, checklists and photos
Set priority, duration, notifications and repetition for every entry
Pin the most important entries to the Dashboard
Pick a certain period you want to view the entries for in your Calendar
Use this app for various purposes – reminder, organizer and planner
This app is a perfect all in one planner for to go. Wherever you are, write down all the necessary things – movie recommendations, recipes, things to buy, places to see, anything. Have an important meeting? Write it down. Organizing a party? Make a checklist of everything you need.
Busy lives, lack of time, many daily activities. It becomes hard to organize and remember everything. Download this app now and make your life easier, and, what is more, you will never forget anything.

bluejetty:00019444:ios.summary:
This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
Collect, upgrade, and battle with iconic heroes from across Star Wa
bluejetty:00019444:ios.description:
This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
Collect, upgrade, and battle with iconic heroes from across Star Wars™ history, including Luke Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano, Darth Vader, Han Solo, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Yoda, The Mandalorian, and more. Experience a role-playing adventure that combines strategy, action RPG, and online multiplayer gameplay.
Enter the Star Wars universe in a cinematic turn-based RPG game where strategy, skill, and legacy define every move. Relive moments from The Mandalorian™, Star Wars™: The Bad Batch™, and Star Wars™: The Last Jedi™ as you command your team. Whether you fight for the Rebellion, the Empire, or something in between, the next great battle for galactic dominance begins with you.
STAR WARS™: GALAXY OF HEROES GAMEPLAY
 - Unlock legendary bounty hunters, Jedi, Sith, & heroes like Luke Skywalker, Darth Vader, Han Solo, Yoda, Ahsoka, & The Mandalorian
 - Battle, level up, & upgrade heroes to create elite squads in strategic turn-based RPG games
 - Master turn based combat with upgradable gear & abilities to dominate PvE / PvP battles in this RPG strategy game
CONQUER THE COLISEUM
 - Face a rotating roster of Star Wars opponents like the Dyax, Jotaz, & Pirate AT-ST, & more
 - Climb the ranks to achieve leaderboard glory to earn top-tier rewards & materials
COMPETE IN GALACTIC STARSHIP BATTLES
 - Command iconic ships like the Millennium Falcon & dominate the Fleet Arena in a tactical RPG game set among the stars
 - Recruit heroes to pilot your fleet & unlock powerful ship abilities to build your armada
JOIN A STRATEGIC TURN-BASED RPG
 - Deploy reinforcements, counterattack enemies, & master tactical combat in both PvE / PvP RPG games
 - Fight for dominance in Territory Battles & Wars with your Guild in turn based online multiplayer games
 - Collect epic loot, upgrade your roster, & rise through the ranks in this action role-playing game adventure
BECOME A MASTER OF THE GALAXY
 - Unleash powerful abilities like Han Solo’s "Never Tell Me the Odds," Obi-Wan Kenobi’s "Mind Tricks," & The Mandalorian’s "Disintegrate"
 - Command Jedi, Sith, & bounty hunters across unforgettable battles in turn based RPG battles
SQUAD UP ONLINE
 - Join forces with friends in Guilds to lead raids against legendary bosses like rancors & AAT tanks in epic online RPG combat
 - Compete in online games including Squad Arena, Galactic Challenges, & the Coliseum
Join the holotables, summon your squad, and prove your legacy in an iconic turn-based strategy RPG game.
This app: Requires acceptance of EA’s Privacy & Cookie Policy and User Agreement. Requires an Internet connection (network fees may apply). Allows players to communicate via in-game chat. To disable see "Chat Setting" in the in-game settings menu. 
User Agreement: terms.ea.com
Privacy and Cookie Policy: privacy.ea.com
Visit help.ea.com for assistance or inquiries.
Do Not Sell My Personal Information: https://tos.ea.com/legalapp/WEBPRIVACYCA/US/en/PC/
EA may retire online features after 30 days’ notice posted on ea.com/service-updates.

bluejetty:00141376:ios.description:
Supplemental Health Care's WeConnect mobile app is your portal to healthcare employment, catering specifically to travel nursing and healthcare roles across hospitals, schools, home health, hospice, correctional facilities, clinics, skilled nursing, and more.
Find the job you’re looking for
- Search across thousands of healthcare jobs, including travel nursing, per-diem, school assignments, correctional healthcare roles, behavioral health specializations, and more, all curated by a leading healthcare staffing agency.
- Tailor your job search to meet your specific healthcare skills and interests, with options to search by location, expertise, and salary. You'll be the first to know when your ideal position becomes available thanks to real-time mobile alerts.
- Take control over your healthcare employment journey with 24/7 access. SHC WeConnect lets you find and apply to the perfect job at any hour of the day or night.
Transparency and instant alerts
- Gain confidence in your job search. SHC WeConnect ensures an open, transparent application process with real-time progress tracking, eliminating the need to chase updates from recruiters.
- Pay ranges available for every open position at thousands of healthcare and school employers across the United States.
- Manage your employee profile, upload compliance, track application progress and more – all from within the SHC WeConnect app. It’s your new single source for managing your healthcare career. 
- Avoid missed calls and endless emails with push notifications to alert you to next steps, application progress, critical communications, or new job matches.
Tools for your assignment and beyond
- Manage your credentials seamlessly, and say goodbye to faxing or unsecured emails. When you’re ready, you can effortlessly upload and organize documents via the SHC WeConnect mobile app.
- From submitting your hours, viewing pay stubs, and accessing benefits, the SHC WeConnect app centralizes all your needs, allowing you to manage your healthcare career on your terms.
Over nearly four decades, SHC has connected tens of thousands of professionals with the best in healthcare, education, and travel nursing roles across the U.S. With the SHC WeConnect app, nurses, therapists, radiologists, special educators, and other healthcare professionals can take control of their careers. Download the SHC WeConnect mobile app now and experience everything that Supplemental Health Care has to offer.

bluejetty:00165828:ios.description:
Application Description：
Health Way Life is a multifunctional health application that monitors heart rate, records blood pressure, blood sugar, water consumption, and mood, allowing you to track your health data; At the same time, we provide you with a series of mental health tests, including fatigue tests, depression tests, insomnia tests, anxiety tests, and forgetfulness tests; Of course, for you who usually pay attention to your own health, daily health themed information is also essential; I hope you can gain more happiness and health in Health Way Life.
Product Features：
1. Blood pressure:
You can use the app to record blood pressure data and observe blood pressure trends through charts.
2. Blood sugar:
You can use the app to record your blood sugar data and observe your blood sugar trends through charts.
3. Drink water:
You can use the water drinking function to understand the daily water intake that meets your body's needs, and achieve the goal of drinking healthy water through alarm reminders.
4. Mood:
Every day is a new beginning, record your mood for that day, and leave a beautiful memory for yourself.
5. Psychology:
We have prepared an interesting set of mental health tests for you to better understand your psychological state.
6. News:
Update health news every day, so that those who pay attention to health can learn more knowledge that is beneficial to their physical health.
More health features are waiting for you to use.More health features are waiting for you to use.
Disclaimers：
1. This application does not measure your blood pressure or blood sugar and is not suitable for medical emergencies. If you need any help, please consult your doctor.
2. The information provided by this application is for general overview purposes only and does not replace written laws or regulations. This application does not provide health professional guidance. If you need professional guidance on health, please consult a professional medical institution or doctor.
3. This application does not provide medical services or professional advice from doctors. You take full responsibility for your own health. This application is only used for general information recording and is not intended to suggest, diagnose, or treat any medical or other illness, nor is it intended to replace professional medical care. This application is not a clinical professional device.
Subscription Members：
Health Way Life Membership Subscription: Our app offers auto-renewing subscriptions on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis. Once the purchase is confirmed, your account will be charged at the price applicable in your region. The subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term.
You can turn off auto-renewal at any time. To avoid renewal, cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.

bluejetty:00150681:ios.name: Affinity Plus Youth Banking
bluejetty:00150681:ios.summary:
Welcome to Affinity Plus Youth Banking! Easily send money, view transactions, and track finances with our all-in-one app designed for parents and kids. 
It’s where your kids can learn about money and practice good habits, all with your hel
bluejetty:00150681:ios.description:
Welcome to Affinity Plus Youth Banking! Easily send money, view transactions, and track finances with our all-in-one app designed for parents and kids. 
It’s where your kids can learn about money and practice good habits, all with your help.
What kids can do:
• Set a savings goal and transfer money into it. 
• Watch short videos about how banking works, and how to be smart with money.
• Send you requests for money, with a note about why they want it.
• See your notes and reply to them, or just send a heartfelt emoji.
• Transfer between their own Affinity Plus accounts, if they have more than one.
• Keep track of their chores, and let you know when they’re done.
• They can even send YOU money, if they need to pay you back.
• Check their balance and see all their transactions.
What parents can do:
• Set a savings goal for your child, and watch their saving progress.
• Watch short videos with tips on how to talk to your child about money, and how to use the app with them.
• Request money from your child, and make it a practice loan with monthly payments, an interest rate, and due dates (late fees, too).
• Include notes to your child when you transfer to them, or when you say no to their requests.
• Set spending limits for them.
• Assign chores, track progress, and pay when they’re done.
• Freeze their debit card.
• Check their balance and see all their transactions.
• One parent can link to multiple kids in the app.
To get the app:
1. First, both you and your child need:
 • Your own mobile phones with separate phone numbers (for multi-factor authentication)
 • Your own separate email addresses (to register for the app)
 • Affinity Plus memberships
 If your child doesn't have a membership yet, you can open one over video banking, or at one of our branches. Please note that we’ll ask for a copy of your child’s birth certificate.
2. You’ll both download the Affinity Plus Youth Banking app to your devices.
3. The parent should register first, then the child – and both should do it on their own phones.
4. It helps to have both devices handy when you register, because your child will need a Parent Code from you.
5. Then get ready for easy transfers, and even better – good talks about money!

• Small business owners for their employees, contractors, and gig workers

Features offered in our paystub generator app
• Accurate federal and state tax calculations based on current payroll laws
• Supports accurate state tax calculations for all 50 US states
• Supports both 2020 W-4 and prior year W-4 form for accurate tax calculation
• Option to include time-off information as mandated by some US states
• Free paystub templates to choose from, which fit your business and look professional
• Multiple customization options, such as options to include company logo, attach deposit slip, and more.
• Options to include additional earnings such as bonus, overtime, tips, commission, and custom earnings
• Options to include deductions such as insurance, 401(k), and custom deductions
• Free corrections to pay stubs
• Send paystubs to employees and contractors by email
• Single-click pay stub generation for subsequent pay periods
Create paystubs in simple steps and in less than 5 minutes.
1. Enter company, employee, and salary information
2. Preview the pay stub
3. Download or send the pay stub by email to employees and contractors.
Top 3 reasons to choose our paystub maker
• Accuracy: Applicable payroll taxes, including federal taxes (federal income tax, FICA - social security, and FICA - Medicare) and state taxes (state income tax and local taxes), are calculated based on the information you provide and payroll tax laws. bluejetty:00129187:ios.description:
My Translator Pro — Speak, scan, and translate instantly
Break the language barrier wherever you are. My Translator Pro combines text, voice, and camera translation in one simple app, built with Apple's translation framework for fast, private translations right on your device.
Translate your way
• Type or paste text for an instant translation
• Speak naturally — the app listens, transcribes, and translates what you say
• Take a photo of any text (a menu, a sign, a document) and let the app read it automatically
• Listen to the translation read aloud in a natural voice
Always ready when you need it
• Home Screen shortcuts and Siri quick commands open the app straight to the microphone, camera, or keyboard
• Works offline with Apple's built-in translation — no internet connection needed for basic translations
Travel smarter with the phrasebook
Browse hundreds of useful phrases organized by category for restaurants, transportation, emergencies, and much more — perfect for quick reference on the go.
Keep track of your translations
Your full translation history is saved automatically, so you can easily find past conversations and phrases.
On your wrist and in your messages
• The Apple Watch app lets you translate without taking out your phone
• Translate directly in the Messages app through our iMessage extension
Privacy first
Translations can run directly on your device. We do not collect or sell your personal data.
Download My Translator Pro today and speak with the world — one word, one phrase, one image at a time.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

bluejetty:00144304:ios.description:
في تانيا الجودة ليست فقط طريقة عملنا أو أسلوب نتبعه بل هي إيمان داخلنا بأساس كل عملية نقوم بها. إنها المبدأ الجامع الذي ننتهجه في كل مجالاتنا من التعبأة، التغليف، الزجاجات، النقل، التوزيع وخدمة احتياجات عملائنا. تهدف تانيا للمياه أن تكون «الخيار الأول» في فئة المياه المعبأة في السعودية. 
لا تنتهي القصة هنا فقد قمنا بتطوير تطبيق الجوال والذي يقدم لكم المميزات التالية:
امكانية طلب عبوات المياه المختلفة المقدمة من تانيا لتصلك في الوقت والمكان المناسبين لك في ثلاث خطوات بسيطة: اختر طلبك، حدد تفاصيل الطلب، ثم تابع تقدُّم الطلب حتى يصلك!
امكانية اضافة عناوين مفضلة لتوصيل المياه إليك عند الطلب
عرض قائمة بالطلبات السابقة ومتابعة الطلبات الحالية
استلام تنبيهات عند تغيّر حالة الطلب
يوفر التطبيق طرق دفع سلسة ومريحة لتناسب الجميع: كاش، سداد أو البطاقة الائتمانية. وكذلك من خلال رصيد تانيا!
إمكانية الحصول على نقاط رصيد من تانيا ليتم استخدامها لاحقاً كطريقة للدفع
إمكانية التواصل المباشر مع خدمة العملاء في تانيا من خلال إرسال شكاوى أو مقترحات
يدعم التطبيق اللغتين العربية والانجليزية
الفئات التي يخدمها التطبيق
يخدم التطبيق جميع المستخدمين بالأعمار المختلفة حيث يمكنهم الطلب المباشر من شركة تانيا للمياه
كيفية استخدام التطبيق
يحتاج التطبيق الى تسجيل أولاً عن طريق إدخال بيانات المستخدم حتى يمكنه لاحقاً استخدامها في الحصول على طلبه من مياه تانيا
يتطلب التطبيق الاطلاع على موقع المستخدم لعرض المنتجات المتاحة حسب مكان المستخدم كما يوفر إمكانية تجاهل استخدام الـ GPS عن طريق إدخال العنوان يدوياً
يتطلب التطبيق الوصول إلى معلومات الرسائل الخاصة بك وذلك لإرسال كود التفعيل للتحقق من رقم الهاتف الخاص بك والذي يعد الوسيلة المستخدمة للتسجيل في تطبيق تانيا
نسعد دائماً بسماع آرائكم والتي هي محل تقدير كبير من قبلنا. برجاء إرسال تعليقاتكم القيمة واقتراحاتكم على care@tania.sa
كما يسعدنا أيضاً تقييمكم للتطبيق.
Our essence culminates form a basic fact of life: Life is a Gift! So, let’s enjoy this gift together by exploring new and exciting opportunities to celebrate life! At Tania, we ensure that all these elements are incorporated in all aspects of our services and behavior and that they are the guiding principles of how Tania strives to interact with you. This is why we have created this mobile app for your comfort and happiness.
Application Features
Order any of the different water packages provided by Tania in three easy steps: Pick your order, specify its details, and then check its status until it is delivered to your doorsteps!
Add your own list of preferred addresses to deliver water to you upon request
View the history of old orders and track the status of new ones
Receive notifications about the status and updates of your order
The application provides easy and convenient payment methods for everyone: Cash, SADAD and credit card. You can also pay for your orders using Tania balance!
Request Tania credit for later use as a payment method
Get in contact with the customer service in Tania for any complaints or suggestions you have
The application is available in both Arabic and English
Who is it For?
Water is for everyone! Likewise, you are welcome to enjoy our app and services.
How to use the application
Register by keying in your personal data which will be later used for order fulfillment
Tania application requires access to your location via GPS to view the provided items by Tania according to your location. It is also possible to ignore the use of GPS by manually entering your address
Tania application requires access to your cellphone SMS in order to send the activation code to verify your phone number, which is required for the registration in Tania application.
We are always glad to hear back from you. Your valuable comments and suggestions at care@tania.sa will be highly appreciated.
Please take a few minutes to review the application for support

bluejetty:00193145:android.description:
How long haven't you been to Blair's Boutique? How's her shop going? It will absolutely surprise you this Halloween!
Horror, costumes, parties, trick or treat... It's Halloween, the busiest time of the year. Look, the shop is full of guests from the school. A sweet date, a birthday party, an audition... the girls will have a magnificent holiday. Dress up them as scary as possible! What's that? Is that a pineapple? Yes, someone dresses up like a pineapple on the street! Use your imagination to dress the girls both horrific and unique!
Features:
- Enjoy matching with a good deal of outfits and accessories
Tons of Halloween themed items offer you a chance of being a stylist.
- Get a sense of accomplishment in Election of Party Queen
Join the Election and win the first prize, you'll get great items as rewarded.
- Exchange furniture with stars and decorate the shop
The shop can look better if you earn more stars.
- Learn courses and achieve higher skills and titles
With more courses here, Blair can make progress every day.
- Serve the guests and win surprising gifts
What will the gift box give you? Try to serve all the guests and see what will happen.
About Libii:
With over 600 million downloads and growing, Libii is committed to creating innovative games for kids. We'll keep working on establishing a good relationship with both parents and their children and bringing a healthy, happy atmosphere for them.
Visit us: http://www.libii.com/
Like us: http://www.facebook.com/LibiiGame
Contact us: Got any ideas? Suggestions? Need technical support? Please feel free to contact us 24/7 at WeCare@libii.com
Need You Know:
This app is totally free to download and play, some basic items are also free to use, but some additional items need you to purchase and pay to unlock. Therefore, if you do not want to use these items, please turn off the in-app purchase in your settings. Thanks.

bluejetty:00179339:ios.summary:
Have SAND in your pocket. Create music anywhere. Sketch your ideas, compose with MIDI and audio clips, host your favorite plugins. All designed for creative flow, whether you're at home or on the go.
SAND is a music sketchpad for AUv3, MID
bluejetty:00179339:ios.description:
Have SAND in your pocket. Create music anywhere. Sketch your ideas, compose with MIDI and audio clips, host your favorite plugins. All designed for creative flow, whether you're at home or on the go.
SAND is a music sketchpad for AUv3, MIDI, and audio clips—built so you can try ideas quickly, without setup getting in the way.
Please note: SAND does not generate sound on its own—it relies on AUv3 plugins you can find on the App Store. Try SAND free for 14 days; in-app purchases unlock features after the trial.
GRID SEQUENCER
Arrange MIDI and audio clips on a grid to build your ideas.
Copy, duplicate, merge, combine, and drag-and-drop clips to shape your project.
Quick clip tools: quantize, length, legato, transpose from the clip menu.
Render MIDI clips as audio by dropping them onto an audio track.
MIDI TRACKS
Work with instrument and MIDI tracks in your projects.
Load an instrument and unlimited audio and MIDI effects on each track.
Hide tracks and assign custom icons to keep sessions organized.
Save tracks as templates for future projects.
Edit MIDI in a piano-roll clip editor: quantize, legato, split, duplicate, copy, and paste.
Build chords with the chord selector.
Adjust note position, pitch, duration, and velocity.
Handle bars edit position and pitch on the note.
Use an adjustable grid or free placement.
Scale highlighting helps you stay in key.
Record with an optional count-in or from the first note.
Quantize recordings for tighter timing.
AUDIO TRACKS
Add dedicated audio tracks alongside your MIDI material.
Import audio into clips from other apps or the clip import flow, with preview before committing.
Record audio into clips with per-track input settings and track arming.
Set loop or one-shot playback, beat-aligned or immediate start, and optional clip BPM.
Looping clips follow project tempo.
The audio editor supports copy, paste, crop, gain adjustment, normalize, silence, fades, reverse, pitch, stretch, and split. With automatic or manual preview.
PLUGIN HOST
Host AUv3 instruments, audio effects, and MIDI processors.
Control parameters and presets, and save default states for new instances.
Record notes and MIDI from plugin interfaces, and capture output from MIDI plugins.
Mark plugins as favorites for faster access.
SONG MODE
Arrange clips in sections with independent lengths, played back seamlessly in order.
Launch every clip in a section at once, sections work as scene launchers.
Set a different time signature per section when needed.
AUTOMATION
Automate volume, pan, effect parameters, and MIDI for dynamic changes across your tracks.
MASTER TRACK
Apply effects globally across the project.
Use the master track's clip to generate bass lines and chord progressions.
MIDI ROUTING
Record from external MIDI devices, including hardware synths.
Send MIDI out for real-time playback and route MIDI between tracks.
Use SAND as a virtual MIDI input and output.
MIDI MAPPING
Map a MIDI controller to control the app with a flexible, customizable layout.
"Shift" mappings extend what a single controller surface can do.
PROJECT VERSIONS
Save and restore named snapshots of a project—experiment freely, then return to an earlier state.
PROJECT MANAGEMENT
Rename projects and branch copies with Save As…. (iOS 18+) Start new work from project templates. (iOS 18+)
SYNC
Sync with other apps and DAWs using Ableton Link.
ON-SCREEN KEYBOARD AND PADS
Record with a velocity-sensitive on-screen keyboard. Choose scale and root to limit keys to a scale, and adjust visible keys to match how you play. Play and record beats with on-screen drum pads.
IMPORT / EXPORT
Export clips as audio or MIDI. Export projects as Ableton Live sets. Record performances and export audio, including stems for separate processing.

bluejetty:00184580:ios.description:
Your iPhone is the only remote you need.
Universal Smart Remote turns your phone into a full-featured TV controller — just connect to the same Wi-Fi and you're good to go. No dongles, no IR blasters, no setup headaches.
Works with Samsung, LG, Sony, TCL, Roku, and Philips.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Use a full d-pad, volume, channel, and playback controls
- Navigate with a touchpad — just like a laptop trackpad
- Type with your keyboard instead of clicking one letter at a time
- Launch Netflix, YouTube, and other apps in one tap
WORKS WITH YOUR TV
Samsung — Every Smart TV from 2010 to 2026. Crystal UHD, QLED, Neo QLED, The Frame — all supported.
LG — All WebOS TVs and Netcast TVs (2012-2013).
Sony — Android TV and Google TV models.
TCL — All Roku-powered TCL TVs.
Roku — All Roku TVs and streaming devices.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Connect your iPhone and TV to the same Wi-Fi
2. Open the app — your TV shows up automatically
3. Tap to connect. Done.
The app remembers your last TV and reconnects automatically next time.

Requires iOS 18.0 or later.
Universal Smart Remote is not affiliated with Samsung, LG, Sony, TCL, Roku, or Philips. Keyboard input may not work in some streaming apps.

bluejetty:00037091:ios.name: Groove Rider 2
bluejetty:00037091:ios.summary:
What our users already say about GR-2:
"This is the workflow Akai, Logic Pro, and all the others in my opinion are missing!" - App Store review
"The sound engine is grand, the ease of use is great. At first glance it’s ticking all the box
bluejetty:00037091:ios.description:
What our users already say about GR-2:
"This is the workflow Akai, Logic Pro, and all the others in my opinion are missing!" - App Store review
"The sound engine is grand, the ease of use is great. At first glance it’s ticking all the boxes :)" - App Store review
"The new standard of groovebox. Easy, quick, powerful, fun" - App Store review
"Thanks for this great release! GR-16 was great. This is many magnitudes even greater!" - App Store review
"Groove Rider 2 is a monster of an app. It’s all here.. so good… so slick… so musical… so fun" - App Store review
-------
Groove Rider 2 takes you to the next level of mobile music production with a brand new workflow! Being perfectly balanced between a groove box and a DAW, GR-2 can boost your creative musical inspiration in a way you couldn't even imagine!
• PERFORM LIVE SETS
Use 16 x 16 clip launch grid and Ableton Link feature to synchronize GR-2 with other music apps and gear. Connect your midi controllers to control GR-2 parameters via midi. Crossfade between your patterns in a DJ style with onscreen crossfader and EQ controls!
• CREATE FULL LENGTH TRACKS
Timeline-based song mode editor allows you to arrange and edit midi clips in a professional DAW manner. Record and edit parameters automation. Copy, paste, duplicate clips as well as entire time ranges. Export & share your compositions as a master audio file or as separated stems.
• SKETCH YOUR MUSICAL IDEAS
- use layering for instruments (up to 3 layers per part)
- process with built-in realtime insert effects (3 IFX per part)
- tweak sound with 3-band EQ with visual controls
- improvise with MFX (master effects) using onscreen XY controls (3 MFX per pattern)
- add depth, using 2 Send / Return FX busses with up to 3 effect slots in each bus
- resample what you hear and edit right in place with the built-in Sample Editor
- save your own presets and drum sets with audio previews for further use in other compositions
• USE BUILT-IN INSTRUMENTS
Internal instruments include:
- Sampler with realtime beat time stretching (Warp) and Slicing options, supports stereo samples of 16, 24 or 32 bit depth, up to 5 minutes long
- 2-oscillator Synthesizer with over 280 oscillator preset programs, with Filter, ADSR and LFO modules
- Sound Font 2 (sf2) sample bank player with ability to use imported sf2 banks
- WaveTable synthesizer with ability to import user wavetables (Serum .wav format supported)
- seamless integration with the JimAudio Poison-202 and Pure Acid apps (sold separately) allows to use their integrated modules in GR-2 without actually loading them as AUv3 audio units, which saves system resources and speeds up pattern loading process!
- all internal synths allow customizing their micro scale tunings.
FEATURES:
• supports Ableton Link, AUv3 units hosting, AudioBus, Inter-App Audio, Core/Virtual Midi In/Out, Bluetooth Midi, Relative Midi knobs
• Multi Core audio rendering
• built-in Sample Editor with record audio function
• convenient sample and preset browser with instant previewing
• timeline-based song mode editor
• can host AUv3 Audio Unit instruments, Effects and Midi FX
• includes internal library of Factory samples, presets and patterns to start from
• supports importing of patterns, created in Groove Rider GR-16
• supports import & export of Midi files
• master or stems wav export
• big variety of built-in effects include Delay, Chorus, Reverb, Shimmer, Pitch Shifter, Flangers, Phasers, Distortion & saturators, EQ, Filters, Slicers, Sidechain Compressor & Gate, Limiter, Maximizer and more!
• supports Akai APC40 mkII, Novation Launchpad X, Launchpad Pro MK3 and Launchpad Mini MK3 controllers with full access to the session clip grid and various modes of GR-2!
Designed for both iPad and iPhone
iOS or iPadOS 16+ is required
iPad Pro 2nd generation and newer is recommended for best experience
Manual guide is available for download at 
https://www.jimaudio.pro

bluejetty:00185120:ios.description:
This app is for making mosaic/blur video.
You can choose 4 types of blur.
■Simple mode.
Simple mode is for Blur to the specified area and all duration of the video. 
-- How to edit mosaic/blur --
Position ：Drag mosaic/blur area directory or screen using with one finger.
Size ：Pinch mosaic/blur area directory or screen using with two fingers. 
Blurriness：Parallel swipe mosaic/blur area or screen using with two fingers.
■Timeline mode.
Timeline mode is you can blur to the specified area in a specified time range of the video.
-- How to use basics. --
1. Select the video.
2. Press [+] button to add a new blur area.
3. Drag the red area to the place you want to blur.
4. Press [OK].
5. [≡] button is to show the list of blur areas. you can edit again after you've done once.
6. Adjust blur types and level, and then press [save] to render the video with blur.
-- How to set the time range
1. Press [+] button to add a new blur area.
2. Slide the slider to the time that is started blur.
3. Drag the red area to the place you want to blur.
4. Slide the slider to the time that is ended blur.
5. Drag the red area to the place you want to blur.
6. You can see three thumbnails under the slider. Tap the last one and press the trash bin button to delete.
7. Then the blur area is only showed up in the time range. 
8. Press [OK] to do it.
-- How to change the shape of blur area
1. Tap the red area which is located under the slider.
2. Select the shape you want to.
■Face tracking mode
App blur faces that are recognized. 
Face tracking mode is not a perfect solution to blur faces so be careful.
-- How to use --
・Faces are recognized automatically after you select a video.
・You can adjust blurs size/level/type and inverse area or nor.
・Press [save] to export it.
