bluejetty:00087376:ios.name: Consulta Placa - Débito, Multa
bluejetty:00087376:ios.developer: G PLUS - TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMACAO EIRELI
bluejetty:00087376:ios.description:
Aplicativo completo e grátis feito para simplificar e facilitar a consulta de placa de veículos, seja ele carro, moto ou caminhão. Entre os principais recursos, destacamos:
- Consulta Placa - Detalhes como modelo, ano, cor... do veículo;
- Situação no Sinesp - Se há restrição ou comunicado de roubo do veículo;
- Consulta Tabela Fipe - Preço do veículo em diferentes períodos;
- Consulta de Multas e Débitos em todos os DETRAN Estaduais;
- Consulta de Multas e Débitos diversos órgãos fiscalizadores;
Não Esqueça de Avaliar nosso Aplicativo. Também Estamos Abertos a Sugestões de Melhorias e Críticas. Deixe seu comentário para Melhorarmos ainda mais.
A CONSULTA DE MULTA E DÉBITOS ESTÃO DISPONÍVEIS NOS SEGUINTES DETRANS:
Detran-AC - Detran-AL - Detran-AM - Detran-AP - Detran-BA - Detran-CE - Detran-DF - Detran-ES - Detran-GO - Detran-MA - Detran-MG - Detran-MT - Detran-MS - Detran-PA - Detran-PB - Detran-PE - Detran-PI - Detran-PR - Detran-RJ - Detran-RN - Detran-RS - Detran-RO - Detran-RR - Detran-SC - Detran-SE - Detran-SP - Detran-TO
DEMAIS ÓRGÃOS PARA CONSULTA DE MULTA E DÉBITOS SÃO:
Departamento de Polícia Rodoviária Federal - PRF - Departamento Nacional de Trânsito - Denatran - Departamento Nacional de Infraestrutura de Transportes - DNIT - Agência Nacional de Transportes Terrestres - ANTT - Departamento de Estradas de Rodagem - DER Estaduais
O QUE É A TABELA FIPE?
A FIPE é uma tabela que expressa o valor médio em reais de veículos do mercado nacional, isto é, ela indica a precificação média de um veículo automotor para facilitar negociações e avaliações.
A FIPE é um parâmetro de mercado, quer dizer, ela apresenta valores médios de automóveis de acordo com a marca, o ano e o modelo de um veículo, relacionando somente esses três fatores.
Ela não leva em consideração informações como quilometragem, estado do automóvel, cor, opcionais vindos de fábrica, acessórios instalados, região e quaisquer outros fatores que possam influenciar o valor de um automóvel para mais ou para menos.
PARA O QUE SERVE A TABELA FIPE?
A tabela é um ponto de partida para que pessoas, quando em negociação ou avaliação de automóveis, tenham um instrumento em mãos que lhes forneça um ponto de partida para a condução de compra ou venda de automóveis.
A tabela FIPE é um instrumento baseado na coleta de preços de carros, motos e caminhões usados, seminovos e novos no mercado nacional, trata-se de uma referência , quer dizer, ela serve somente para situar melhor compradores e vendedores.
Como dissemos, o valor pode sofrer variações em decorrência de inúmeros outros fatores que incidem na formação de preço de determinado veículo, sendo que estes outros dados, a tabela não leva em consideração na hora de formar e informar os valores.
CONSUTA DE RESTRIÇÃO DE ROUBO/FURTO DE VEÍCULO - SINESP
O Sistema Nacional de Informações de Segurança Pública, Prisional e sobre Drogas (Sinesp) é uma plataforma de informações integradas, que possibilita consultas operacionais, investigativas e estratégicas sobre segurança pública implementado em parceria com os entes federados.
Pelo aplicativo é possível consultar restrições de roubo/furto de veículos a partir da inserção dos caracteres da placa do veículo, tendo como retorno as seguintes informações:
- Marca/modelo;
- Ano;
- Cor;
- Final do Chassi; e
- Status de Restrição de Roubo e Furto.
O QUE É O RENAVAM?
O RENAVAM significa Registro Nacional de Veículo. Em outros termos, o RENAVAM do veículo permite saber todo o histórico, desde sua fabricação até o dia de seu descarte. Ele armazena todas as informações do veículo como características, multas, emplacamento, licenciamento, mudanças de proprietários, furtos e etc. Todas essas informações ficam no poder no DENATRAN que distribui para os DETRANs de cada estado.
O RENAVAM vem impresso no topo do seu CRLV (Certificado de Licenciamento do Veículo) e é indispensável para realizar certas consultas pelo aplicativo.

- Consulta Tabela Fipe - Preço do veículo em diferentes períodos;
- Consulta de Multas e Débitos em todos os DETRAN Estaduais;
- Consulta de Multas e Débitos diversos órgãos fiscalizadores;

Não Esqueça de Avaliar nosso Aplicativo. Também Estamos Abertos a Sugestões de Melhorias e Críticas. Deixe seu comentário para Melhorarmos ainda mais.

A CONSULTA DE MULTA E DÉBITOS ESTÃO DISPONÍVEIS NOS SEGUINTES DETRANS:

Detran-AC - Detran-AL - Detran-AM - Detran-AP - Detran-BA - Detran-CE - Detran-DF - Detran-ES - Detran-GO - Detran-MA - Detran-MG - Detran-MT - Detran-MS - Detran-PA - Detran-PB - Detran-PE - Detran-PI - Detran-PR - Detran-RJ - Detran-RN - Detran-RS - Detran-RO - Detran-RR - Detran-SC - Detran-SE - Detran-SP - Detran-TO

DEMAIS ÓRGÃOS PARA CONSULTA DE MULTA E DÉBITOS SÃO:

Departamento de Polícia Rodoviária Federal - PRF - Departamento Nacional de Trânsito - Denatran - Departamento Nacional de Infraestrutura de Transportes - DNIT - Agência Nacional de Transportes Terrestres - ANTT - Departamento de Estradas de Rodagem - DER Estaduais

O QUE É A TABELA FIPE?

A FIPE é uma tabela que expressa o valor médio em reais de veículos do mercado nacional, isto é, ela indica a precificação média de um veículo automotor para facilitar negociações e avaliações.

A FIPE é um parâmetro de mercado, quer dizer, ela apresenta valores médios de automóveis de acordo com a marca, o ano e o modelo de um veículo, relacionando somente esses três fatores.

Ela não leva em consideração informações como quilometragem, estado do automóvel, cor, opcionais vindos de fábrica, acessórios instalados, região e quaisquer outros fatores que possam influenciar o valor de um automóvel para mais ou para menos.

PARA O QUE SERVE A TABELA FIPE?

A tabela é um ponto de partida para que pessoas, quando em negociação ou avaliação de automóveis, tenham um instrumento em mãos que lhes forneça um ponto de partida para a condução de compra ou venda de automóveis.

A tabela FIPE é um instrumento baseado na coleta de preços de carros, motos e caminhões usados, seminovos e novos no mercado nacional, trata-se de uma referência , quer dizer, ela serve somente para situar melhor compradores e vendedores.

Como dissemos, o valor pode sofrer variações em decorrência de inúmeros outros fatores que incidem na formação de preço de determinado veículo, sendo que estes outros dados, a tabela não leva em consideração na hora de formar e informar os valores.

CONSUTA DE RESTRIÇÃO DE ROUBO/FURTO DE VEÍCULO - SINESP

O Sistema Nacional de Informações de Segurança Pública, Prisional e sobre Drogas (Sinesp) é uma plataforma de informações integradas, que possibilita consultas operacionais, investigativas e estratégicas sobre segurança pública implementado em parceria com os entes federados.

Pelo aplicativo é possível consultar restrições de roubo/furto de veículos a partir da inserção dos caracteres da placa do veículo, tendo como retorno as seguintes informações:

- Marca/modelo;
- Ano;
- Cor;
- Final do Chassi; e
- Status de Restrição de Roubo e Furto.

O QUE É O RENAVAM?

O RENAVAM significa Registro Nacional de Veículo. Em outros termos, o RENAVAM do veículo permite saber todo o histórico, desde sua fabricação até o dia de seu descarte. Ele armazena todas as informações do veículo como características, multas, emplacamento, licenciamento, mudanças de proprietários, furtos e etc. Todas essas  informações ficam no poder no DENATRAN que distribui para os DETRANs de cada estado.

O RENAVAM vem impresso no topo do seu CRLV (Certificado de Licenciamento do Veículo) e é indispensável para realizar certas consultas pelo aplicativo.

bluejetty:00008980:android.description:
⚽ Bundesliga Fantasy Manager 2025/26 – Your Soccer IQ decides the game!
Build your ultimate soccer team with real Bundesliga players, compete in custom leagues, and earn live points based on real Bundesliga stats. The official Bundesliga Fantasy Manager puts you in charge of every matchday, every decision, every lineup.
Choose your strategy, make bold transfers, and manage your fantasy team like a pro. Whether you're a first-time fantasy manager or a veteran of global soccer games, this is your season to shine.
✅ Key Features for Fantasy Managers
🔁 5 Transfers Between Matchdays
Use up to 5 transfers each matchday to respond to injuries, player form, and fixtures. Smart transfer planning wins points.
⭐ Pick 3 Star Players
Highlight 3 key players in your lineup each matchday and earn 1.5x fantasy points. A crucial tactic for any fantasy manager.
🏅 Top-11 Auto-Scoring
Your top 11 players score automatically, so even if you forget to submit your lineup, your team earns maximum possible points.
⏱️ Live Matchday Scoring
Track goals, assists, cards and other real actions – converted into live points for your fantasy team. Stay in the game, minute by minute.
📈 Dynamic Market Values
Real Bundesliga stats impact player prices. Sell high, buy smart – and keep your team competitive on every matchday.
🎁 Daily Login Bonus
Log in daily to get extra budget. Improve your lineup and build a stronger team with every reward.
🔓 Unlimited Transfers During Breaks
Take advantage of breaks for unlimited transfers. Reshape your team, rebalance your lineup, and optimize for the second half of the season.
🆕 Rookie Leagues & 2nd Chance Competitions
Late start? No problem. Join rookie leagues or the 2nd Chance League and compete for prizes no matter your entry date.
💾 Auto Save
All updates to your lineup, transfers, and team strategy are saved automatically. You focus on managing – we handle the rest.
⚙️ How to Play
1️⃣ Build Your Fantasy Team
Start with €150M and a randomized Bundesliga squad. You get 2 goalkeepers, 5 defenders, 5 midfielders, and 3 forwards. Only 3 players per club. Make every position count.
2️⃣ Set Your Lineup Strategically
Pick your formation and confirm your lineup before each matchday begins. Plan matchups and maximize fantasy points.
3️⃣ Transfer & Manage Weekly
Make 5 transfers per matchday. React to injuries and form dips. A good manager always evolves the team.
4️⃣ Score Points & Compete Globally
Earn live points from real Bundesliga action. Follow your team’s performance and climb the fantasy ranks.
🤝 Leagues, Community & Competition
🌍 Global Rankings & Competitive Play
 Join thousands of soccer fans and fantasy managers across the world. Prove your knowledge and build the best team.
📨 Create Private Leagues
 Invite friends or coworkers, define custom rules, and manage your own fantasy competitions.
⚔️ Head-to-Head Matchups
 Battle other managers directly in H2H leagues. Choose knockout or league modes and test your tactical edge.
🎁 Prizes for Real Fantasy Champions
🏆 Win:
• Tickets to Bundesliga matches
• Signed jerseys and official DERBYSTAR soccer balls
• VIP access to the Franz Beckenbauer Supercup
• Weekly and season-long exclusive fantasy rewards
📅 Every Matchday Counts – Download Now!
Build your fantasy team, lock in your lineup, make smart transfers, and earn live points. Join thousands of passionate soccer managers and prove you’ve got what it takes.
Download the official Bundesliga Fantasy Manager app now – and take control of your matchday destiny!
📩 Support & feedback: info@bundesliga.com

bluejetty:00119915:ios.description:
Search for "BabyBus" for even more free panda games for you to try! 
Baby Panda Art Class is in session! 
This is an art classroom designed specifically for children aged 2-5! Games of music, drawing and kids crafts for children to recognize color, learn to draw, sing and dance to music to inspire their interest in the arts. 
Baby Panda's Art Classroom includes following mini-games:
DRAWING GAMES
- Fingerprint Drawing: Imprint fingerprint on the screen and watch it turn into a balloon, grape, leaf…Children can create artwork without a pen! 
- Creative Artwork: Scribble or tap anywhere on the drawing board to turn doodles into cookies, noodles, dragon fruits and other funny food. 
- Coloring Book: Identify crayons of different colors and use them to fill up the blank coloring pages. Learn color patterns and make artwork! 
MUSIC GAMES
- Rhythm Training: Listen to the tune, tap notes according to the rhythm and collect stars for higher score! 
- Children's Songs: Learn children's song with baby panda and play music with little rabbit!
KIDS CRAFT GAMES
- Modeling Clay: Choose clay of different colors and make noodles, flowers, or crabs out of it with tools. 
- Paper Cutting: Cut paper in the shape of a lion, stick it on the wood and you have a fan! 
-Necklace Making: Collect bottle caps, decorate them with paint brush and stickers, then string them together! 
All art games are free to download, with new exciting updates!
Come to Baby Panda's Art Classroom, and use your imagination to create one-of-a-kind artwork with Baby Panda! BabyBus hopes to inspire children's interest in art during the period when they are most imaginative. 
Features: 
- 3 major themes with 8 games and 10+ playing modes to fully develop children's artistic talent; 
- Brilliant colors and adorable pictures to appeal to kids; 
- Easy games for even preschool children to follow and create artwork.
About BabyBus
—————
At BabyBus, we dedicate ourselves to sparking kids' creativity, imagination and curiosity,and designing our products through the kids' perspective to help them explore the world on their own. 
Now BabyBus offers a wide variety of products, videos and other educational content for over 250 million fans from ages 0-8 around the world! We have produced more than 150 children's educational games, 700 children's songs, and animations of various themes spanning the arts, health, and science. 
—————

Visit us: https://app.babybus.com

bluejetty:00023225:ios.name: Alto's Odyssey — Remastered
bluejetty:00023225:ios.summary: Join Alto and his friends on an endless sandboarding journey to find The Lost City and unearth the secrets hidden within. Soar above windswept dunes, traverse thrilling canyons, explore ancient temples and delve into vast caverns in a fanta
bluejetty:00023225:ios.description:
Join Alto and his friends on an endless sandboarding journey to find The Lost City and unearth the secrets hidden within. Soar above windswept dunes, traverse thrilling canyons, explore ancient temples and delve into vast caverns in a fantastical place far from home. 
On this journey, you’ll grind across vines, bounce atop hot air balloons, ride towering rock walls, glide in your wingsuit, and escape mischievous lemurs – all while uncovering the desert’s many mysteries.
Explore a new biome with special hidden challenges, layered among the classic Alto’s Odyssey experience that long-term fans know and love — only on Apple Arcade.
• Easy to learn, difficult to master. At the heart of the Alto series is an elegant one-touch trick system. Chain together combos, and complete hundreds of goals to unlock new items and abilities — all with intuitive controls.
• Discover four stunning Biomes. From The Dunes, to The Canyons, The Temples, and, for the first time, The Lost City. Explore these rich and diverse landscapes, each boasting unique visuals and gameplay.
• Newfound heights. Uncover secrets in the sky with hot-air balloons, moving grind rails, wall riding and wingsuiting.
• Master the elements. In addition to dynamic lighting and weather effects like sandstorms and shooting stars, the desert is home to swirling wind vortexes and rushing water.
• Meet Alto and friends. Unlock six unique characters, each with their own attributes and abilities.
• Zen Mode. Complete with its own serene soundtrack, this meditative mode distills Odyssey down to its purest elements: no scores, no coins, and no power-ups. Just you and the endless desert.
• Photo Mode. From the pause screen, get behind the lens and take stunning photos of your trip through the desert. Pan and zoom to frame the ideal shot, and share them with friends and family.
• Original music and handcrafted audio. Headphones recommended!
• iCloud support. Play on your Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV, and your progress will always be in sync.

bluejetty:00148743:ios.description:
As a Rochester Regional Health patient, you can securely manage and receive information about your medical record. MyCare provides you with secure access to health information anywhere, at any time. It’s a health management tool that can improve communication with your providers, document important health care information, and ultimately give you the ability to make more informed decisions so that every next day is the healthiest it can be.
With MyCare, you can access your lab and test results, request prescription renewals, schedule appointments, communicate with your providers, pay your bills, and upload health and fitness data, including data from the Apple Health app (when enrolled in self-tracking programs). MyCare offers personalized and secure online access to portions of your medical records 24/7. 
If you already have a Rochester Regional Health MyCare account, you are ready to begin.
If you do not have a Rochester Regional Health MyCare account, create one by clicking Sign Up Now in the app or by visiting https://mycare.rochesterregional.org
For assistance email MyCare@RochesterRegional.org or call (585) 922-1234

bluejetty:00079781:ios.name: Guru Granth Sahib with Audio
bluejetty:00079781:ios.summary: Guru Granth Sahib Ji is the religious scripture of Sikhism, regarded by Sikhs as the final, sovereign, and eternal living Guru following the lineage of the ten human Gurus of the Sikh religion. Adi Granth, the first rendition, was compiled
bluejetty:00079781:ios.description:
Guru Granth Sahib Ji is the religious scripture of Sikhism, regarded by Sikhs as the final, sovereign, and eternal living Guru following the lineage of the ten human Gurus of the Sikh religion. Adi Granth, the first rendition, was compiled by the fifth Sikh Guru, Guru Arjan. Guru Gobind Singh, the tenth Sikh Guru, added one salok, dohra mahala 9 ang, 1429 and all 115 hymns of Guru Tegh Bahadur. This second rendition came to be known as Sri Guru Granth Sahib.
The text consists of 1430 angs (pages) and 6,000 shabads (line compositions), which are poetically rendered and set to a rhythmic ancient north Indian classical form of music. The bulk of the scripture is divided into thirty-one ragas, with each Granth raga subdivided according to length and author. The hymns in the scripture are arranged primarily by the ragas in which they are read. The Guru Granth Sahib is written in the Gurmukhi script, in various languages, including Lahnda (Western Punjabi), Braj Bhasha, Khariboli, Sanskrit, Sindhi, and Persian. Copies in these languages often have the generic title of Sant Bhasha.
Guru Granth Sahib was composed by seven Sikh Gurus: Guru Nanak Dev, Guru Angad Dev, Guru Amar Das, Guru Ram Das, Guru Arjan Dev, Guru Hargobind and Guru Tegh Bahadur. Guru Gobind Singh added 1 sloakh in mahala 9 Ang 1429. It also contains the traditions and teachings of Indian sants (saints), such as Ravidas, Ramananda, Kabir and Namdev among others, and two Muslim Sufi saints Bhagat Bhikan and Sheikh Farid.
The vision in the Guru Granth Sahib is of a society based on divine justice without oppression of any kind.

bluejetty:00070323:ios.name: Notebooks: Write and Organize
bluejetty:00070323:ios.summary:
Own your notes — forever. Notebooks is a writing and organization app with no subscription, no lock-in, and no worries. Your documents are stored as standard files you can always access, export, or move freely. Pay once. Use for life.
Use
bluejetty:00070323:ios.description:
Own your notes — forever. Notebooks is a writing and organization app with no subscription, no lock-in, and no worries. Your documents are stored as standard files you can always access, export, or move freely. Pay once. Use for life.
Use Notebooks as a personal wiki, Zettelkasten, document archive, task manager, or long-term writing space. Capture quick notes, turn them into actionable tasks, combine text fragments into chapters, organize research, or keep business documents separate from personal journals — without ever switching apps.
Designed to help you stay focused and work at your own pace, Notebooks grows with your needs and is always ready to support you.
WRITE AND CREATE
Create beautifully formatted documents with styles, attachments, tables, checklists, and optional tables of contents. Choose from ready-made styles or design your own.
Write in different ways:
Formatted text (WYSIWYG)
Plain text, with smart handling of lists, automatic character pairing, and a focused writing view
Markdown, supporting MultiMarkdown and Discount, with syntax highlighting, dedicated keyboard keys, wiki-style links, and interactive checklists
Sketch ideas or annotate images and PDFs using Apple Pencil.
STORE AND ORGANIZE
Notebooks stores all documents as regular files in standard formats. You always remain in control — no lock-in, no export worries, fully compatible across devices and over time.
Organize your work in books and nested hierarchies without limits. Import PDFs, emails, web pages, MS Office and iWork documents, images, audio, video, and more. Use full-text search to find even the most deeply nested document.
PLAN AND ACT
Turn books into project lists and documents into tasks. Assign due dates and alerts, create nested projects, and track progress naturally — right where your work lives.
Use simple checklists in formatted documents or Markdown for lightweight task tracking.
STAY FOCUSED
Link documents together to build knowledge over time. Use wiki-style links, backlinks, contexts, and smart books to keep everything connected and within reach. When you rename or move documents, links stay intact.
A PLACE YOU CAN RELY ON
Sync your documents between iPhone, iPad, Mac, and PC. Work on documents stored in other apps, compile selections into PDFs or eBooks, scan documents and extract text using OCR, and trust that your data stays accessible — now and in the future.
With time, Notebooks often becomes the one place users rely on to keep everything that matters close at hand.
WHAT USERS SAY
“Notebooks is a wonderful app — sophisticated in an unassuming way. I feel more productive without spending time managing the app itself.”
“You are GTD in every way that makes it efficient — and makes me efficient.”

On Apple Watch, MoodyWatch uses HRV to monitor your stress & mood in real time, and gives specific, actionable emotion-regulation suggestions based on your current health data—sleep, heart rate, sunlight, steps, blood oxygen, hydration, menstrual cycle, and more.
MoodyWatch hopes you won’t overthink and burn out. Even if you ignore your feelings, Apple Watch will remind you again and again: love yourself.
---
Stress tracking:
HRV real-time stress detection x mood detection
· 6 mood tags: Joyful, Relaxed, Calm, Irritated, Anxious, Depressed
AI mood & wellness coaching:
· MBTI x mood-based action suggestions
Health management:
· Weekly sleep duration & sleep quality overview
· Body metrics & trend details: sleep heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen saturation, respiratory rate
· Fitness Rings progress + current calories with Emoji expressions
· Sleep preview, multiple sleep watch faces, sleep day/week/month/year details, restorative sleep statistics
· Hydration Ghost & Hydration Ghost watch face, with day/week/month/year hydration trend stats
· Step cards & walking data
· Menstrual cycle tracking & prediction
· Sunlight tracking & stats & sunlight watch faces
Custom watch faces:
· Quickly convert photos, Live Photos, GIFs, and videos from your iPhone Photos
· Into personalized watch faces that change with your stress state
Mood journal & emotional “safe space”:
· Use short text to record what happened and what you thought
· Save a snapshot of your feelings for your future self
Stress trends:
· Weekly / monthly / yearly stress trend statistics
Other features:
Work Cat watch face
· Smart clock-in reminders, lunch break reminders, countdown to work
Co-branded IP watch faces
Home Screen widgets
Lock Screen widgets
MoodyWatch helps you care about your emotions—and your body, too. Taking good care of yourself is truly the most important thing.
---

Data is read only via Apple HealthKit. All your data is stored locally on your device.

bluejetty:00144789:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00144789:ios.description:
In early 16th century England, a legend spoke of mystical water from the Fountain of Life, said to cure all ailments and grant immortality. Many sought this water, sparing no expense to uncover its secrets.
One day, a young explorer named Jack appeared, holding an ancient map that led southward. Determined to find the truth about the Fountain of Life and seek wealth, fame, and perhaps immortality, he quickly gathered a crew of adventurers to journey into the uncharted seas marked on the map.
The expedition included Jack, the brave explorer; Grace, the hardworking surveyor who would later win Jack's heart; Noah, the experienced and respected captain; and Henry, the steadfast army colonel. After sailing for a long time, disaster struck as they entered the mysterious sea. A giant octopus appeared, tearing their ship apart. They were thrown into the stormy waters and scattered among strange islands.
When Jack woke up, he found himself washed ashore on the sandy beach of a small island. Welcome to Lifespring Land: Farm Survival, a captivating game where you'll transform a barren desert island into a thriving community.
GAME FEATURES:
◆ Farmland and Gardens: Start by cultivating the island's fertile farmland. Plant hay and other crops, taking care of your gardens to ensure a steady food supply.
◆ Building House and Crafting: Construct essential buildings and craft useful goods to support your growing community. Every structure you create will help improve your city and enhance your township.
◆ Explore the Wilderness: As the island's main explorer, venture into the wilderness to find hidden resources and secrets that will help you, your friends, and your family survive.
◆ Adorable Animals: Raise and care for cute animals that will become a crucial part of your farm's ecosystem.
◆ Trade and Economy: Trade with neighboring islands, exchanging valuable resources to support your township's development. Some items may be expensive, but the benefits are well worth it.
◆ Daily Challenges: Each day brings new challenges and opportunities. Adapt to changing conditions and make strategic decisions to ensure your community's prosperity.
◆ Heroic Characters: Lead a team of heroes, including Jack, Grace, Noah, and Henry, each with unique skills that will contribute to your survival and success.
HOW TO PLAY:
↪ Start Small: Begin by cultivating your farmland and planting hay to establish a food supply. Use the initial resources to create basic structures.
↪ Expand and Build House: As you gather more resources, expand your township by constructing new buildings and crafting useful goods. This will help improve your city and provide better living conditions for your family and community.
↪ Explore the Island: Send Jack and the other heroes to explore the wild areas of the island. Discover hidden treasures, gather resources, and encounter new challenges.
↪ Care for Animals: Raise cute animals that will contribute to your harvest's productivity and provide companionship for your settlers.
↪ Engage in Trade: Trade surplus goods with neighboring islands to obtain valuable resources and items. Manage your economy wisely to ensure growth and stability.
↪ Face Challenges: Each day brings new tasks and obstacles. Plant, harvest, build houses, and follow the story. Just adapt your strategy to overcome these challenges and keep your township thriving.
↪ Uncover the Mystery: As you progress, uncover the secrets of the island, love, family, and the Fountain of Life. The journey to immortality and prosperity is filled with adventure and excitement.
This game combines the excitement of exploration with the joy of building and managing a thriving community. Transform barren land into a bustling township and uncover the legendary Fountain of Life.

bluejetty:00183897:ios.name: MA Bank Mobile
bluejetty:00183897:ios.summary: The MA Bank Mobile App is a free mobile support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organize
bluejetty:00183897:ios.description:
The MA Bank Mobile App is a free mobile support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
Manage Your Accounts:
· View accounts, balances, and history
· Search transaction history
· View images of checks and deposits
· Setup alerts by text, email, or push notification
· View electronic statements
· Temporarily turn your card off or back on, or quickly report it lost or stolen.
Deposit Funds:
· Deposit checks with Mobile Deposit
Make Payments & Transfer Funds:
· Pay bills
· Transfers between your MA Bank accounts
· Send money instantly with Zelle
· Pay your MA Bank loan
· Pay your MA Bank credit card
Money Management:
· View your MA Bank and non-MA Bank accounts all in one place
· Categorize and track spending
· Create a budget, set financial goals, and more
Get Help:
· Submit secure messages to our Customer Support team
· Call MA Bank Customer Support
Open & Apply:
· Open checking and savings accounts in minutes
Convenience:
· Login with TouchID or FaceID
· Locate a branch or ATM
GETTING STARTED
To use the MA Bank Mobile App, simply download the app, launch it, and log in with your existing Online Banking credentials. If you don't have credentials yet, tap "First time user? Enroll now". After you successfully log in to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00066396:ios.description:
► MUSCLE RUSH – The running game that’s really ripped!
Hey, feeling shrimpy? Instead of trying the latest miracle workout or chugging protein shakes, muscle up in MUSCLE RUSH, the fun new running game that can turn anyone into a perfect specimen of bulging humanity in a whole lot less than seven days. 
Get buff, get tough, and strut your stuff as you run through challenging obstacle courses! Smash through barriers, swat aside hoodlums, grab all the energy drinks and batteries you can, and get ready to pound at your screen in thrilling arm-wrestling boss battles to defeat an ever-wilder array of muscle-bound bullies. 
Do you have what it takes to become the beefiest runner in MUSCLE RUSH? Sprint, spin, and crash your way through wood, glass, brick, metal, and more in your quest to get swole! Hope you didn’t skip leg day, pipsqueak!
► Keep on running!
• Real dynamic tension! Fast and ferocious gameplay with an endless variety of obstacle courses to blast your way through. Watch your muscles grow as you power up!
• The rewards are greater for every obstacle you power through, but each of them also drains your strength. To get to the end, brute force won’t be enough—you’ll need a little strategy too! Show that you have the brains to match your brawn!
• Upgrade your musclehead with tons of fun skins! Collect a huge range of wacky characters as you progress through levels, from traditional strong men to gym bros, athletes, wrestlers, superheroes and more. Customize your musculature to achieve maximum strength!
• Smash the right obstacles and collect keys to earn cash, and then upgrade your punch to ensure you’ve got the strength to swat aside bullies, gold bars, and even solid metal doors. 
• Face off in epic arm-wrestling boss fights to put your biceps to the test. Have you ever gone toe-to-toe with a buff alien or a ripped granny? In MUSCLE RUSH, you can!
• Ensure you’re really ripped when your workout ends, and finish the obstacle course by breaking your way through a final series of brick walls—the further you get, the greater your rewards and the wilder your celebratory dance moves! Break-dance and boogie on top of the wreckage!
• Body building has never been so much fun! This game’s beautifully toned graphics and immensely satisfying sound effects mean in this workout there’s no pain for plenty of gain.
► The game that turns chumps into champs!
Power through obstacle courses and leave a trail of destruction in your wake. Smash that install button and hit the ground running in MUSCLE RUSH!

Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

Mobile app for AXIS Camera Station Pro & 5 - Powerful and flexible video management and access control.
Main features:
• Mobile access to multiple systems
• Quickly find and view recorded events with timeline visualization
• Export of recordings
• Notifications to take immediate actions
• Live view with selectable streaming profiles
• Two-way audio from camera in live view
• Respond to calls from Axis network intercoms
• Support for action buttons to play pre-recorded audio messages, control I/O, etc.

• 360 camera dewarping
• Custom views with support for camera, split and folder views
• Scheduling of notifications from local and port-mapped systems
• Access control features such as locking/unlocking doors, overriding/resuming schedules, and monitoring door status
Setup:
Requires AXIS Camera Station version 5.56 or later.
Setup information at www.axis.com/products/axis-camera-station
Release notes at www.axis.com/ftp/pub_soft/cam_srv/ACS_iOS/latest/relnote.txt

bluejetty:00024911:ios.summary:

Full Arabic text in Uthmani script, a page-by-page Mushaf, about 150 translation
bluejetty:00024911:ios.description:
Read and listen to the Holy Quran anywhere, even without internet. Download recitations once and keep listening offline at home, at the masjid or on the road.
Full Arabic text in Uthmani script, a page-by-page Mushaf, about 150 translations in 40+ languages (including 16 English translations plus transliteration) and verse-by-verse audio with highlighting, all in one calm, easy app.
READ THE QURAN
- Complete Quran: 114 surahs and 30 juz
- Page-by-page Mushaf view with natural page flipping
- Verse-by-verse reading by Surah or Juz, with Surah, Juz and Page lists
- Uthmani script (KFGQPC Uthmanic Hafs) and other Arabic fonts
- Color-coded waqf (stop) signs and sajdah markers
- Pinch to zoom, with separate font sizes for Arabic and translation
- Portrait and landscape, iPhone and iPad, dark and light themes
- Keep the screen awake while you read
TRANSLATIONS IN YOUR LANGUAGE
- About 150 translations in 40+ languages, downloaded when you need them
- English: Saheeh International, Pickthall, Yusuf Ali, Hilali & Khan, Arberry, Maududi, Shakir, Wahiduddin Khan, Itani, Qarai and more
- English transliteration to help you follow the Arabic recitation
- Also Spanish, Portuguese, French, Urdu, Turkish, Indonesian, Russian and many other languages
- Search the whole Quran in a translation by word or topic
LISTEN TO RECITATION
- Verse-by-verse and full-surah audio
- The current verse is highlighted while the recitation plays
- Adjustable recitation speed
- Download audio and listen offline, with downloads managed per reciter
KEEP YOUR PLACE
- Separate "last read" bookmarks for page, surah and juz
- The app remembers where you stopped and takes you back
- Build your own verse lists and keep your favorites
- Quick links to Surah Yasin, Al-Fath, Al-Mulk and An-Naba
- Khatm (completion) dua page and an in-app guide
SHARE A VERSE
- Share verses as image cards or text through WhatsApp, Messages, email and more
- Long-press any verse or translation to copy it
PREMIUM
Some advanced features require a Premium subscription, for example:
- Choosing your reciter: 100+ recitations from 80+ reciters such as Mishary Alafasy, Abdul Basit, Al-Sudais, Al-Husary, Al-Minshawi, Maher Al-Muaiqly, Saad Al-Ghamdi, Ash-Shatri and Basfar
- Repeating a verse or a range of verses with a set count and interval, a great help for memorization
- The Home Screen widget with a verse and its translation
- Changing the Quran font and the text background color
Which features are included in Premium may change over time.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://quran-app-afb4f.web.app/terms-and-conditions.html
Privacy Policy: https://quran-app-afb4f.web.app/privacy-policy.html

Hello, everyone! Our team is excited to announce our third mystery horror game, "Paper Bride 2 Zangling Village"!
You guessed it! This is the sequel to our Paper Bride series based on Chinese folklore.
This story takes place in Zangling Village, where players must explore a village shrouded in occult mystery to uncover the secret origins of this haunted village.
Compared with the previous "Paper Bride", we have added the following new features:
 - Improved Graphics - Picturesque scenery with more dynamic expression.
 - Enriched Story - More story clues and dialogue. Now the protagonist is illustrated with dialog audio for an even more engaging performance.
 - Added Suspense - Think carefully to overcome your fear and avoid the living dead. This story is not for the feint of heart!
 - In-depth Clues - Added more detailed clues, making the puzzle game more accessible to new players.
We hope to shock players with an all new heart-pounded horror adventure!
Follow our official accounts for more information.
 Facebook: @gamefpscom
 Twitter: @gamefpscom

bluejetty:00046705:ios.description:
Connect to your DumaOS powered router to reinvent your play with the ultimate router software built to reduce lag, stabilise your gaming connection and optimise your entire network.
• Geo-Filter: No bad servers, more great games. Get the best low-ping matches and stabilise your ping with worlds-first Anti-Jitter technology.
• SmartBOOST: Give your favourite apps and devices the exact bandwidth they need, all of the time. SmartBOOST adjusts dynamically to network conditions, optimising performance even when your network is stretched thin.
• Ping Optimiser: Keep your gaming smooth even during busy household use by reducing the impact of greedy apps or devices.
• Ping Heatmap: See your connection quality to your favourite game’s servers, any time of the day for the perfect Geo-Filter settings.
• Network Activity: Break down your online usage over time to get the full picture of your network.
• Adblocker: Block ads and malware directly from your router, protecting every device on your network - even hard-to-protect devices such as Smart TVs and games consoles.
• Device Manager: Easily identify and personalise connected devices and manage their network access and interaction.
If you have questions or feedback about the DumaOS app, our support forum would love to help and listen to what you have to say.
You can find DumaOS app support here: https://forum.netduma.com/forum/137-dumaos-mobile-app-support/
To use the DumaOS app, your router must be running DumaOS 3.0 or later. Telstra customers can also use this app if they have Telstra Internet Optimiser.
Supported DumaOS Routers:
• Netduma R1/R2/R3
• Nighthawk Pro Gaming XR1000/700/500/450
• Telstra Smart Modem (Gen. 2 & 3)

bluejetty:00073491:ios.description:
This one’s for the pets. Shop all the things that keep your pet happy and healthy with Chewy, the trusted destination for pet parents. With 3000+ brands of food and supplies, and 24/7 help from pet experts, your pet’s happiness is our #1 priority. Unlock high quality and low priced products, Autoship delivery, free 365-day returns and more. Food shop and pharmacy — no matter what you need, Chewy has you covered.
Download and discover something for every pet. Dog, cat, fish, reptile, horse or wildlife — all pets are supported on the Chewy app. Find everything your pet needs today.
SHOPPING FOR EVERY PET
The shopping app that’s built to make your pet parenting life easier. Shop top brands, exclusive deals and the best of each season for your pet.
Shop by Category - Search or shop by category to discover the best products for your pet.
3000+ Brands - Browse thousands of trusted brands, ensuring you have the best selection possible.
Today’s Deals - Shopping app deals, for every pet. Find the best savings of the day on everything from food to treats, toys, supplies and apparel.
Holiday Shop - Calling all party animals! Celebrate the holiday season with costumes, toys, seasonal treats and more.
PHARMACY & VET SUPPORT
Pet health, made easy. Get veterinary and pharmacy support with Chewy’s expansive health services and products.
Trusted Pet Pharmacy - Care for your pet with America’s most trusted pharmacy, carrying over 4000+ top-quality medications and 600+ veterinary diet products. Now including compounded medications.
Rx Approvals - Share your pet and veterinary info and we’ll confirm your prescription directly with your vet before shipping.
Connect with a Vet - Get timely advice from our licensed veterinary team and leave with a personalized consult report.
Symptom Tracker - Share your pet’s symptoms and receive quick advice on what to do next.
Medicine Reminders - Add your pet’s current medications and we’ll remind you on when to refill based on the frequency you need.
AUTOSHIP & SEAMLESS HOME DELIVERY
Veterinary prescription, pet food, or fun toys — get fast, easy and hassle-free deliveries with Chewy.
Manage Autoship - What your pet needs, on repeat. Schedule your Autoship delivery at checkout and change as needed. No fees or commitments, just happy pets.
Super Savings - Get extra savings off your first Autoship order and 5% off future deliveries.
Shipment Tracker - Follow their favorite box from our door to yours with our in-app shipment tracker.
PET COMMUNITY
Trusted by pet lovers, and supported by pet experts. Learn, receive help, share your voice and give back with our app. No one pet-parents alone with Chewy.
24/7 Support - Real pet experts are here for you 24/7 to support all pet parents.
Sharing - Send fellow pet lovers items you like with a text, email or social post while you shop.
Shopping App Reviews - Read what other customers are saying about products and leave your own reviews.
Pet Adoption - Find pets to adopt near you through Chewy’s network of shelters and rescues.
Food shop, pharmacy, vet advice and more. No matter what you’re looking for — Chewy is here to make pet parenting easier.

bluejetty:00126150:ios.name: HEY Email
bluejetty:00126150:ios.summary:
It’s “you’ll never go back” better
HEY replaces workarounds, messy hacks, and daily frustrations, with built-in workflows, effortless organization, and clever features that levels-up email in meaningful ways.
Screen emails like you screen
bluejetty:00126150:ios.description:
It’s “you’ll never go back” better
HEY replaces workarounds, messy hacks, and daily frustrations, with built-in workflows, effortless organization, and clever features that levels-up email in meaningful ways.
Screen emails like you screen calls
You screen your calls, so why can't you screen your emails? With HEY, you can. HEY puts you in complete control of who's allowed to email you. Don't want to hear from someone? Screen them out and won’t hear from them again.
Naturally grouped
Inboxes are typically an intertwined mess of new and old messages haphazardly mixed together. Yuck. With HEY, new messages are always grouped together at the top, and previously seen emails are always at the bottom. Neat and orderly by default. No need to wade through the inbox jungle with a machete.
Spread ’em out, read ’em together
Let's say you have 7 unread emails. Why do you have to open one, close one, open one, close one, open one, close one, and so on. It's rediculously inefficient. With HEY, you can open multiple emails at once and just scroll though them, just like you would a newsfeed. It's a revolutionary way to read your emails. You'll never go back to the old way.
Find files without pulling your hair out
If you’re looking for an attachment, why should you have to find an email first? That’s backwards. With HEY, you get an attachment library that gathers up every attachment you’ve ever received in one organized, siftable place.
Just set it aside
Sometimes you get emails you need to reference later - travel info, handy links, numbers you need, etc. With HEY, you can 'Set Aside' any email in a neat little pile for easy access whenever you need it. At hand, but out of your face.
Put receipts in The Paper Trail
Receipts, confirmations, and transactional emails getting in your way? With HEY, you can send those types of emails to The Paper Trail where they'll be out of your way, but easy to find when you need them.
Blocking email spies 24/7/365
Many companies track which emails you open, how often you open them, and even where you were when you opened them. It's a massive invasion of your privacy. HEY blocks these trackers and tells you who's spying on you.
Fix bad subjects without busting threads
If you don’t start the thread, you're often stuck with other people’s generic, non-descriptive email subjects. With HEY, you can rename a subject so it makes sense for you without changing things for the other person.
Add private notes to any email thread
Conversations may start in email, but they may continue somewhere else. Some emails turn into lunches or calls or video conferences. Where do you put the notes from those - especially if they relate to the initial email conversation? With HEY, you can add personal, private notes (and files) to any thread. This way you keep everything related to the conversation on one page, even if it didn't all happen via email.
Notifications you control
HEY push notifications are off by default so your phone doesn’t steal your attention every time an inconsequential email hits your inbox. However, HEY lets you selectively turn them on for specific contacts or threads so you don't miss the things you really care about.
A built-in ‘Reply Later’ workflow
What if you need to reply, but you don't have time right now? With HEY, just click the “Reply Later” button to move an email to a dedicated ‘Reply Later’ pile at the bottom of the screen so you don’t lose or forget it.
Stop heavy senders from dominating your inbox
When you get lots of emails from someone, they can take over your Inbox. With HEY, you can choose to bundle a sender into a single row. This means no matter how many emails they send you, they'll only take up a single row in your Inbox. Clean, controlled, and calm.
Get off threads without having to ask
Stuck on a mega email chain and want off? Good luck asking someone to remove you. With HEY, you can unfollow any thread and replies won’t show up as new emails anymore. Out of your face forever.

If you’re looking for an attachment, why should you have to find an email first? That’s backwards. With HEY, you get an attachment library that gathers up every attachment you’ve ever received in one organized, siftable place.

Just set it aside
Sometimes you get emails you need to reference later - travel info, handy links, numbers you need, etc. With HEY, you can 'Set Aside' any email in a neat little pile for easy access whenever you need it. At hand, but out of your face.

Put receipts in The Paper Trail
Receipts, confirmations, and transactional emails getting in your way? With HEY, you can send those types of emails to The Paper Trail where they'll be out of your way, but easy to find when you need them.

Blocking email spies 24/7/365
Many companies track which emails you open, how often you open them, and even where you were when you opened them. It's a massive invasion of your privacy. HEY blocks these trackers and tells you who's spying on you.

Fix bad subjects without busting threads
If you don’t start the thread, you're often stuck with other people’s generic, non-descriptive email subjects. With HEY, you can rename a subject so it makes sense for you without changing things for the other person.

Add private notes to any email thread
Conversations may start in email, but they may continue somewhere else. Some emails turn into lunches or calls or video conferences. Where do you put the notes from those - especially if they relate to the initial email conversation? With HEY, you can add personal, private notes (and files) to any thread. This way you keep everything related to the conversation on one page, even if it didn't all happen via email.

Notifications you control
HEY push notifications are off by default so your phone doesn’t steal your attention every time an inconsequential email hits your inbox. However, HEY lets you selectively turn them on for specific contacts or threads so you don't miss the things you really care about.

A built-in ‘Reply Later’ workflow
What if you need to reply, but you don't have time right now? With HEY, just click the “Reply Later” button to move an email to a dedicated ‘Reply Later’ pile at the bottom of the screen so you don’t lose or forget it.

Stop heavy senders from dominating your inbox
When you get lots of emails from someone, they can take over your Inbox. With HEY, you can choose to bundle a sender into a single row. This means no matter how many emails they send you, they'll only take up a single row in your Inbox. Clean, controlled, and calm.

Get off threads without having to ask
Stuck on a mega email chain and want off? Good luck asking someone to remove you. With HEY, you can unfollow any thread and replies won’t show up as new emails anymore. Out of your face forever.

Dive into the challenging world of Crab Life: RPG Survival, where you control a mighty crab fighting for survival on a treacherous beach. Crab Life: RPG Survival is more than just a game, it’s a fight for survival. Will you rise to the challenge and become the ultimate crab ruler? Download now and embark on your epic journey of survival and conquest in Crab Life: RPG Survival!

* Contact numbers and delivery instructions
* Space to provide proof of delivery (picture and signature)

New episodes are made available regularly. Collect the outfits and illustrations, flirt with your favo
bluejetty:00121699:ios.description:
My Candy Love is a flirting game (dating sim) where the scenario changes depending on the choices you make to create a unique love story!
New episodes are made available regularly. Collect the outfits and illustrations, flirt with your favorite crush and participate in the events!
Choose to follow the romance of your character at Sweet Amoris High School or at Anteros Academy University.
Story
In My Candy Love - High School Life, live the life of a high school student who has just arrived at Sweet Amoris. A new school, a new life, new friends… Or even more! You’ll meet very colorful boys, with each his own particularities. Will you go after the bad boy, the class president or the geek?
In Campu Life, juggle between classes and your part-time job. There are many places in which you can discover the person of your dreams! Your adorable coworker, the rockstar you fell out of touch with, your old high school friend, or even a forbidden romance… Many profiles with different attitudes and stories!
Gameplay
- Fill your love gauge
Make the right dialogue choices to make your crush’s Lov’o’Meter explode! Learn to get to know the characters by spending time with them. Find out what they like and make your choices in consequence.
- Illustrations
By making the right choices, unlock beautiful illustrations that capture important moments in your story!
- Personalize your avatar
Thousands of clothes for millions of looks! Dress your avatar with the clothes you get in the game, at the boutique or during special events!
- Events
Several times a year, participate in the colorful events. Play exclusive mini-games and unlock the new outfits and illustrations!
The strong points of the game
- Two otome games in one application
- All your choices have an influence on your love story
- A dating sim complete with many characters that you can flirt with
- A multitude of secondary intrigues to deepen your experience

bluejetty:00045395:ios.description:

- Find branches
- Aggregate your financial accounts

bluejetty:00010584:ios:1.description:
The myCigna app gives you a new and improved way to easily access your important health information. You must be a Cigna customer to use the secure myCigna mobile app. Features available are based on the coverage you have with Cigna. 
HealthKit is integrated into myCigna in order to serve the ability to customize your Find Care and Telehealth experience. 
ID Cards 
• Quickly view ID cards (front and back) 
• Easily print, email, or share from your mobile device
Find Care
• Search for a doctor, dentist, pharmacy or health care facility, from Cigna's national network and compare quality-of-care ratings and costs
Claims
• View and search recent and past claims
Account Balances
• Access and view health fund balances
Pharmacy
• View and refill your prescriptions right from your mobile device
• Update billing and shipping preferences 
Coverage
• View plan coverage and authorizations
• Review plan deductibles and maximums
• Find what’s covered under your plan
Wellness 
• View goal activity and awards
Languages Supported
• Spanish and English
About Cigna
More than just a health insurance company, Cigna is a global health service company--dedicated to helping the people we serve improve their health, well-being and sense of security. We make this happen through a broad range of integrated health care and related plans and services, and proven health and well-being programs that are targeted to the unique needs of our customers, clients and partners.

bluejetty:00147345:ios.summary: Introducing reliable companion for managing your blood pressure and promoting a healthier lifestyle. This user-friendly iOS app empowers you to effortlessly track, monitor, and understand your blood pressure readings, enabling you to make i
bluejetty:00147345:ios.description:
Introducing reliable companion for managing your blood pressure and promoting a healthier lifestyle. This user-friendly iOS app empowers you to effortlessly track, monitor, and understand your blood pressure readings, enabling you to make informed decisions about your cardiovascular health.
Key Features:
Easy Blood Pressure Tracking: Record your blood pressure measurements effortlessly using our intuitive interface. Input your systolic and diastolic values, along with the pulse rate, to keep a comprehensive record of your readings.
Smart Analysis: Gain valuable insights into your blood pressure trends through our advanced analysis tools. The app automatically calculates average readings, identifies patterns, and generates graphical representations to help you understand your progress over time.
Personalized Reminders: Set up reminders to take your blood pressure readings at specific times of the day. Never miss a measurement again and ensure accurate and consistent tracking.
Health History Log: Maintain a comprehensive log of your blood pressure readings, including date, time, and accompanying notes. This log serves as a historical reference and can be easily shared with your healthcare provider for a more informed discussion.
Trends and Charts: Visualize your blood pressure data through clear and interactive charts. Monitor your progress, identify triggers, and make adjustments to your lifestyle to achieve optimal blood pressure levels.
Health Tips and Insights: Access a wealth of educational resources, tips, and articles related to blood pressure management, heart health, and healthy living. Stay informed and make proactive choices to improve your well-being.
Secure Data Backup: Safeguard your data by enabling automatic cloud backup. Never worry about losing your information and seamlessly restore it when switching devices or if data is accidentally deleted.
Integration with HealthKit: Seamlessly sync your blood pressure data with Apple HealthKit. Consolidate all your health information in one place and leverage the power of HealthKit's ecosystem for a holistic view of your well-being.
The information provided by this app is intended for general informational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of a qualified healthcare provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition.
This app does not provide medical advice or endorse any specific healthcare provider or treatment. It is designed to provide users with educational content and tools to support their health and well-being. However, it is important to remember that individual circumstances can vary, and what may be suitable for one person may not be appropriate for another.
Before making any medical decisions or taking any actions based upon the information provided by this app, it is crucial to consult a qualified healthcare professional. They can evaluate your specific situation, provide an accurate diagnosis, and recommend the most suitable treatment options.

GO FM R
bluejetty:00039719:ios.description:
More than 50,000 radio stations of 200 countries and territories available in this app. From sports to news and music. With more than 200 countries and territories available, there are many kinds of stations for you to choose from.
GO FM Radio is the easiest way to tune in to your favorite FM radio, AM radio & online radio stations. It's really easy to find any global radio station. Search by genre to discover new music e.g. pop radio, rock radio or by category to unearth new stations e.g. news radio, live sports radio. You can also search by country, state or city.Listen to your favorite free FM & AM stations.
Listen to your favorite free FM & AM stations including: NPR Radio, BBC Radio, MRN, 77 WABC, La Mega 97.9, KNBR & WNYC. Catch up on news, listen to music or Christian radio & tune in to a huge range of live sports radio stations to catch the latest action from the NFL, MLB, NBA, MLS, NHL & more.
Radio Player Features
- Enjoy access to over 50,000 radio stations
- Tune in live to AM/FM radio stations locally and globally
- Save your preferred stations for instant access
- Get personalized station recommendations from our team
- Effortlessly search for radio stations and songs
- Explore by music genre (classical, jazz, rock, etc.), theme, city, and country
Podcast Player Features
- Subscribe to a library of over 2 million podcasts
- Stream or download episodes for offline listening
- Find new podcasts with easy-to-navigate categories
- Use the auto-delete feature to save storage space
- Customize playback speed to suit your listening preference
- Receive notifications for new episode releases
- Opt to download new episodes only when connected to Wi-Fi
- Search for podcasts by name, episode, theme, or content
The Best Live & Local Radio Stations
- Tune in to live AM and FM stations, and explore thousands of local and global favorites
- Enjoy a versatile listening experience with stations covering news, sports, music, comedy, and more
- Access free broadcasts with trending music, and easily save your top stations
- Stream songs and enjoy music from any genre on national radio stations
- Stay informed with local radio stations providing breaking news relevant to you
Free Music & Playlists
- Enjoy curated playlists and trending songs, organized by mood, activity, decade, and genre
- Discover new music every Monday with 'Your Weekly Mixtape'
- Listen offline and explore song charts featuring Pop, Country, Hip Hop, R&B, and Rock
- Experience personalized music stations tailored to your favorite artists
- Listen to ad-free music from genres like Alternative, Folk, Gospel, Christian, Dance, Indie, and more
Live Sports Stations
- Tune in to live sports on Fox Sports Radio, ESPN Radio, and FNTSY Sports Radio
- Listen to sports radio stations and news discussions from top personalities
- Follow your favorite sports: NBA, NFL, NHL, NCAA, MLB, Soccer, Golf, Tennis, and more
- Get sports news, highlights, and commentary, and interact with your favorite hosts
Search for Radio and Podcasts
Easily find the content you want with our intuitive search feature. Look up live radio stations, podcasts, episodes, and songs. Use the episode search to locate interesting guests and specific topics, or the song search to discover which station is playing your favorite music.
Discover
Explore popular AM/FM radio stations and podcasts organized in clear categories within our Discover area. Get inspired by our editorial recommendations and find a wide range of content, including jazz, rock, and classic radio.
Favorites
Quickly access your favorite content with our Favorites screen. All your preferred radio stations and podcasts are conveniently located in one place for easy and fast access.

My Cornerstone Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with My Cornerstone Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the My Cornerstone Bank app, you must be enrolled as a The Cornerstone Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00069558:ios.description:
Health CSV Importer is the easiest, fastest, and most reliable way to import your CSV data into Apple Health. Battle-tested with millions of data points and hundreds of CSV formats, from proprietary formats from blood glucose monitors to self-made CSVs exported from Google Sheets.
Import workouts, quantity types (like weight), category types (like sleep tracking), and blood pressure to the Health app (note that Activity Summaries, Stand Hours, Exercise Time, and Nike Fuel are not supported).
To see how easy it is, just watch the preview video (no sound). Note: while we use iCloud Drive in the preview video, iCloud Drive does not need to be enabled in order to perform an import. If you would prefer not to use iCloud Drive, just send your CSV to yourself in Mail.app and open it with Health CSV Importer.
Health CSV Importer integrates with the HealthKit framework and Health.app to import your data.
◆ Testimonials ◆
‣ "Does exactly as advertised with good documentation"
‣ "So glad this app exists so that I didn’t lose years of health data when I switched from Samsung to Apple!"
‣ "This tool is so easy to use and thank you for the free version which was all I require."
◆ What files does it support? ◆
CSV or TSV files from any source, including:
‣ Data files from your doctor or from a 3rd-party health device (e.g. blood glucose monitor)
‣ Health data you’re manually tracking in a spreadsheet (e.g. weight)
‣ Data from another phone
◆ Free Features ◆
‣ Import weight / body-mass CSVs or TSVs for free with NO subscription.
‣ Fast, quick, efficient, and battle-tested—import your data in just a few seconds.
◆ Pro Features ◆
‣ Support for all Apple Health quantity data types, like steps, heart rate, and over 70 others.
‣ Category data types, like sleep analysis, mindfulness sessions, and cycle tracking.
‣ Support for over 80 workouts and exercise activities (see full list below).
‣ Unlock blood pressure correlation imports
‣ Smart header assignment: format your column headers once, and we'll remember it for every import afterwards.
◆ Pro Feature: Workouts ◆
‣ Team Sports: American Football, Australian Football, Baseball, etc.
‣ Exercise And Fitness: Stretching, Cooldown, Walking, Running, Wheelchair Walk & Run Pace, Cycling, Core Training, Elliptical, Strength/Cross Training, Mixed Cardio, HIIT, Jump Rope, Stairs, Fitness Gaming, And More!
‣ Studio Activities: Barre, Cardio Dance, Social Dance, Yoga, Meditations, Pilates
‣ Racket Sports: Badminton, Pickleball, Racquetball, Squash, Table Tennis, Tennis
‣ Outdoor Activities: Climbing, Equestrian Sports, Fishing, Golf, Hiking, Hunting, Play (E.g., Tag, Dodgeball, Or Hopskotch)
‣ Snow And Ice Sports: Cross-Country Skiing, Curling, Downhill Skiing, Snow Sports, Snowboarding, Skating Sports
‣ Water Activities: Paddle Sports, Rowing, Sailing, Surfing Sports, Swimming, Water Fitness, Water Polo, Water Sports
‣ Martial Arts: Boxing, Kickboxing, Martial Arts, Tai Chi, Wrestling
◆ Documentation ◆
Check out our data formatting guide at https://lionheartsw.com/software/health-csv-importer/guide.html
◆ Help and Support ◆
If you run into an issue, please email our team at support@lionheartsw.com. We've helped many customers import their data successfully and will try our best to help you too.
Two optional, auto-renewing Pro subscriptions are available for $2.99 per week or $9.99 per year (pricing varies by territory).
Payments will be charged to your iTunes Account after confirmation. Subscriptions are automatically renewed unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. Accounts will be charged for subscription renewals within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed in your iTunes Account's Settings after purchasing.
Privacy policy: https://lionheartsw.com/software/health-csv-importer/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://lionheartsw.com/software/health-csv-importer/terms.html

bluejetty:00063343:ios.summary:
Face Swap Booth
The ultimate tool for swapping faces—now with Real-Time Live Camera Swapping!
Face Swap Booth is an advanced tool that allows you to swap faces with anyone else, whether you are taking a live video or editing your favorite
bluejetty:00063343:ios.description:
Face Swap Booth
The ultimate tool for swapping faces—now with Real-Time Live Camera Swapping!
Face Swap Booth is an advanced tool that allows you to swap faces with anyone else, whether you are taking a live video or editing your favorite photos. Our brand-new live camera feature lets you instantly swap faces with friends in real-time, or even overlay a saved face from your library directly onto anyone in your camera view!
You can also save a face from one photo and use it again on a completely different photo. Custom overlay faces using a special set of masks to pick only the facial features you want. Mix one person's eyes with another person's mouth, or give yourself a realistic beard—the possibilities are endless.
Core Features That Make Us Different:
==============================
NEW: Real-time Live Face Swapping using your camera!
NEW: Live swap 2 or more faces at once.
NEW: Live swap any saved face onto a face in your camera view.
Swap faces between completely different photos.
Swap whole faces or isolate specific parts (Eyes, Lips, Nose).
Copy & save faces to a library to be used again later.
Adjust skin tones and blend seamlessly for a perfect match.
All Face Swap Booth Features:
==============================
Live camera face swapping and multi-face swapping.
Swap faces across multiple photos from your gallery.
Swap faces with celebrities & vice versa.
Save an unlimited library of faces to use forever.
Advanced editor tools to blend images perfectly.
Advanced auto-detect face recognition.
Multiple facial overlay masks to custom-blend features.
Mix and match facial features to create "New People."
Tons of pre-loaded celebrity photos and faces to play with.
Easily share your creations with friends.
Subscription Terms & Pricing:
Choose the length of subscription: 1 Month / 3 Months / 1 Year.
Choose from different premium subscription options.
Subscriptions with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription. You can cancel your subscription in your iTunes settings at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period. Subscription payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of your purchase and upon commencement of each renewal term.
Please note: any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
You can cancel a free trial or subscription anytime by canceling your subscription through your iTunes account settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service.

Please read Terms of Use here:

bluejetty:00014942:ios.description:
Do you dream of playing a musical instrument? tonestro is the platform for you. Whether you're interested in string, wind, woodwind or keyboard instruments, our app offers you a wide range of options:
- Violin,
- Piano,
- Saxophone,
- Trumpet,
- Flute,
- Clarinet,
- And many other instruments.
Start your musical journey with tonestro today!
Why should you choose tonestro for your musical learning adventure?
tonestro brings the joy and depth of music learning right to your fingertips. Developed by music education experts, our app offers:
- A wide range of music theory basics,
- Fingering charts for various instruments,
- Engaging exercises and sheet music,
- Customized lessons that match your learning pace.
It's like having a personal music teacher anytime, anywhere. Practice to master rhythm and pitch and take regular exams to measure your progress.
Stay motivated with our fun learning experience! Earn points by practicing regularly, beat high scores and see how you compare to other musicians. Our weekly challenges and hand-picked songs provide an extra thrill to improve your skills.
Play the songs you love! Dive into our extensive sheet music library with hundreds of songs for different instruments. Enjoy studio-quality background music for truly intense practicing. New songs are added weekly to keep your practicing fresh and exciting.
tonestro supports a variety of instruments, including violin, piano, saxophone, trumpet, clarinet, flute and more, and offers comprehensive lessons and tools for:
- Learning and practicing songs,
- Accessing interactive sheet music,
- Using tuners and metronomes for each instrument.
Experience real-time feedback with live performance analysis! Just play your piece and let our technology give you instant insights into pitch, rhythm, and intonation, just like a live teacher.
Whether you're playing an instrument for the first time or perfecting your skills, tonestro is with you every step of the way.
Is there an instrument you'd like to learn that we haven't listed? Then get in touch and let us know!
Find out more about what we offer and how we can make your musical dreams come true. Visit us at:
General Terms and Conditions: https://www.tonestro.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.tonestro.com/privacy

bluejetty:00177207:ios.description:
Patients with Medtronic heart devices that have Bluetooth® wireless telemetry can download this app for free and use it for remote monitoring. The app can be used to automatically send heart device information to your clinic – wherever you go. Cellular and Wi-Fi availability applies. To get started, contact your doctor to confirm your enrollment in the Medtronic CareLink™ network.
To learn more, visit www.MCLHeart.com.
Important Safety Information: www.medtronic.com/MCLHeartISI.
The MyCareLink Heart™ mobile app has requirements for your phone or tablet and operating system (OS) version. The app cannot transfer data between your heart device and the Medtronic CareLink™ network if those requirements are not met.
The requirements for your phone or tablet and OS version will change over time. You may need to update, or replace, your phone or tablet and OS to use the app to transfer data between your heart device and the Medtronic CareLink™ network.
Talk with your heart doctor for additional monitoring options.
All patient and clinical data are fictitious and for demonstration purposes only.

bluejetty:00167029:ios.description:
Stoic Thoughts is a self-awareness journal inspired by Stoicism.
Reduce your anxiety and stress, enhance your wellbeing, and live better.
"Stoic Thoughts helps me every day on my path to better self-knowledge. It brings me peace of mind, helps me manage all my thoughts and emotions, and eases my anxiety. It's a great help." - Emily Johnson, New York.
"I use all the features of Stoic Thoughts. It’s helping me a lot to understand my thoughts and learn how to manage them. The app asks questions that encourage self-reflection and provide clarity, enhancing my wellbeing." - Michael Smith, San Francisco.
Thoughts offers valuable tools, insights, and counseling support to guide users on their journey to better mental health and self-discovery.
**WHY USE STOIC THOUGHTS?**
Stoic Thoughts offers tools and guidance rooted in Stoicism to help you cultivate self-awareness, manage your emotions, and achieve inner peace. With a clean, intuitive design, it’s easy to use and incredibly impactful.
- Know Yourself: Guided journal for self-discovery
- Gratitude Journal: Focus on what matters most
- Manage Your Thoughts: Understand and organize your mind
- Not-To-Do List: Prioritize what not to do
- Mood Tracker: Visualize and reflect on your emotional state
- Daily Progress Indicator: Stay motivated throughout the day
- Inspiring Quotes & Stoic Wisdom: Daily reminders to ground you
It's so easy to use that you'll love it. 
Self-awareness journal inspired by Stoicism. 
Know yourself and improve your wellbeing with Thoughts.
Stoicism and its principles are at the core of every feature in Stoic Thoughts, ensuring a meaningful experience for every user.
Stoic Thoughts is more than an app—it’s your daily companion for self-improvement, inspired by the principles of Stoicism.
**Stoicism and Modern Wellbeing: A Timeless Philosophy for Mental Health**
Stoicism, an ancient philosophy, has long been admired for its practical wisdom and resilience in the face of adversity. In modern times, its principles offer a powerful framework for mental health and personal growth. Stoic practices focus on understanding what we can control, accepting what we cannot, and cultivating virtues like wisdom, courage, and temperance.
One of the greatest strengths of Stoicism in the realm of mental health is its emphasis on rational thought and emotional regulation. By aligning our thoughts with reality and focusing on our response to life’s challenges, Stoicism provides a structured approach to managing stress, anxiety, and other emotional difficulties. Through practices such as negative visualization and mindfulness, Stoicism encourages a calm, reflective mindset that promotes inner peace and resilience.
Stoicism has been recognized for its effectiveness in helping individuals manage anxiety, depression, and stress. It also offers valuable insights into building emotional strength and living a life of purpose. By embracing Stoic principles, individuals can cultivate a mindset that fosters tranquility and well-being, even in the face of life’s inevitable challenges.
In summary, Stoicism offers timeless wisdom that is highly relevant for modern mental health. Its practical approach makes it a valuable tool for anyone seeking to improve their mental well-being. If you are looking to enhance your life through thoughtful reflection and inner strength, Stoicism is an excellent philosophy to explore.

- Scientific Reasoning
MATH

- Measurement and Data

Introducing SuperOne, the ultimate trivia battle! Prove yourself as the ultimate fan while competing for cash prizes in SuperOne's Battle Royale. Will you be the last fan standing? 
▶ HOW TO PLAY
• Swipe your way through trivia; right for true and left for false.
• The faster you answer correctly, the higher your score.
• If you answer incorrectly four times, you are eliminated.
• Cash prizes for the last fan standing and the runner-ups in second and third place.
• With a new game every five minutes, the wait is never long.
▶ FAN ECONOMY
In a world brimming with over 3 billion football enthusiasts along with billions more fans across various sports and entertainment genres, the absence of a unified platform to engage and monetize this colossal fan base is a blaring void.
• Super.One bridging global fan engagement with financial opportunity via gaming.
• With its trailblazing gaming and affiliate platform, Super.One is at the cusp of bridging this gap.
• The aim is to unite millions of fans under a singular gaming experience, converting their enthusiasm into substantial financial opportunities. 
• SuperOne transcends being merely a game; it's a conduit for monetizing passion, assembling fans globally under a unified gameverse.
▶ AFFILIATE 
• Super.One introduces an affiliate program designed to incentivize both active and passive engagements. 
• Affiliates can partake in real-time financial benefits through a tiered system of Lootboxes.
• The platform’s currency, Credits, facilitates transactions, and intertwines the gaming and affiliate ecosystems seamlessly.
▶ BONUSES
• The Affiliate Bonuses within the SuperOne platform are categorized into Stakeholder Bonuses and Affiliate Bonuses, catering to both passive and active engagement. 
• Super.One empowers affiliates with dynamic bonuses, igniting active performance and passive gains.
Stakeholder Bonuses: Passive Bonuses are earnings derived from holding or acquiring specific assets without the necessity of active engagement or recruitment. 
Affiliate Bonuses: Affiliate bonuses aim to incentivize engagement and performance on the SuperOne platform.
▶ INSTANT PAYOUT
• SuperOne’s multi-platform architecture enables an efficient management of asset transactions, purchases, and real- time payments,

• Check account balances
• Pay bills
• Transfer funds
• View transactions
• Deposit Checks
• Locate ATMs and branches in your area
SAFE AND SECURE
This App offers the same security measures that are utilized through CityBankandtrust.com.
GETTING STARTED
To use the City Bank & Trust Co App, you must be enrolled as a City Bank & Trust Co Internet Banking user. bluejetty:00085443:ios.description:
Official Australian Government myGov app to use myGov on your mobile. The myGov app makes dealing with government simple and easy.
You can use this app to:
 • securely sign in to myGov on your mobile with a myGov app PIN, Touch ID or Face ID
 • easily view and manage your myGov Inbox messages
 • quickly access your services
 • store some government digital cards and certificates in the digital wallet.
You need a myGov account to set up the app. If you don’t have an account, create one on the myGov site, go to my.gov.au
To find out more go to my.gov.au/app
myGov is not the same as myID (formerly myGovID). myID is the Australian Government’s Digital Identity app. For more information about myID go to myid.gov.au
