bluejetty:00122254:ios.name: UNKILLED - Zombie Online FPS
bluejetty:00122254:ios.summary:
Unkilled - Zombie Multiplayer Shooter is an exciting FPS game with intense PvP action. Team up with friends to fight the undead apocalypse in this survival horror shooting game. 
New York City is the epicenter of a terrifying zombie apocal
bluejetty:00122254:ios.description:
Unkilled - Zombie Multiplayer Shooter is an exciting FPS game with intense PvP action. Team up with friends to fight the undead apocalypse in this survival horror shooting game. 
New York City is the epicenter of a terrifying zombie apocalypse in this multi-award winning the first-person shooter. Choose one of five unique characters and join the elite team known as the Wolfpack, a task force assigned to combat the walking dead threat and discover the secret behind the cataclysmic plague. Take time out from killing zombies to challenge your friends in online PvP multiplayer battles. Good thing you brought plenty of bullets!
“Big, silly, violent fun.” - PocketGamer.co.uk
THRILLING SOLO COMBAT MISSIONS. ONLINE PVP MULTIPLAYER. TONS OF UNIQUE GUNS.
• The final frontier in the war between the living and the undead! Fight for survival over 150 missions with an epic storyline. Target unique enemies and bosses, including SHERIFF, DODGER, MINESWEEPER, BUTCHER and more.
• Take on players from all over the world with first person PvP multiplayer. Or build your own zombie army in Skirmish Ops and go to war against other player’s bases with your undead horde!
• More than 40 weapons in five classes, featuring the LSAT machine gun, SAIGA-12K shotgun, and the M24 sniper rifle. Just don’t run out of bullets...
• Loads of skins are ready for you to customize your character and guns. Be the best dressed killing machine in the zombie apocalypse!
RIDICULOUSLY INSANE GRAPHICS
We push the frontier of what is possible on mobile devices! UNKILLED is a feast for your eyes, with post-process effects to create an immersive cinematic experience. There’s high resolution, real-time soft shadows, and high-polygon character models, and don’t even get us started on our SpeedTree vegetation rendering! Not to mention shooting zombies in the face results in lovingly rendered gore...
SMOOTH FIRST PERSON SHOOTER ACTION!
• Our unique control system for mobile devices is approved by millions of players worldwide. Support for a wide range of gamepads.
• Intuitive gameplay. Our autofire shooting system lets you focus on your survival.
• Experience the new Adrenaline feature and put your aim to the test. Target as many undead domes as possible!
FEATURES
• Design your hero for PvP with customizable skills and loadouts, then combat real opponents in five distinctive environments.
• Become the Champion in ranked duels and leagues. Earn “intel” by winning PvP matches, leveling up your hero with a huge skill tree.
• Accept challenges and earn multiple rewards: VIP chests, gold, gadgets, money…

bluejetty:00099919:ios.description:
Title: Mahjong Match - Fun Pair & Relax
Ready for a visual brain teaser? Mahjong Match is the perfect blend of classic tile-matching and modern solitaire fun! It's designed to relax your mind while secretly giving your logic skills a fantastic workout. The more you play, the sharper you get!
 How to Play? It's a Breeze!
- Pick Your Challenge: Choose from Easy, Medium, or Hard mode. Newbie or master? The choice is yours!
- Spot the Pair: Scout the board for two identical Mahjong tiles and tap to make them vanish!
- Match Any Which Way: Pairs can be hiding in plain sight, lined up vertically or horizontally.
- Match Across the Gap: Even if there's space between them, two matching tiles can be a pair! Put your observation skills to the ultimate test.
- Slide & Solve: Can't tap directly? Slide tiles horizontally or vertically to create a match! Neighboring tiles move together, but watch out for blocked paths.
- Clear the Board: Your ultimate goal? Clear all the tiles from the board and rack up a high score!
 Awesome Features
- Easy-Peasy Gameplay: Simple rules, just tap and play! Enjoy a satisfying and brain-tickling experience.
- Fresh Themes Galore: Spice things up with a variety of beautiful themes for a new vibe every time.
- Lifeline Hints: Stuck? No worries! Use the handy hint booster to get back on track smoothly.
- No Time Pressure!: Say goodbye to stress! Play at your own pace and enjoy pure matching joy with no timer.
- Play Offline, Anytime!: On the subway or waiting for a friend? Enjoy the game anywhere, no Wi-Fi needed!
Mahjong Match is your portable brain gym and stress-relief tool! With new weekly challenges, you'll boost your observation power while having a blast.
What are you waiting for? Download Mahjong Match now and dive into a world of colorful tile-matching fun!

bluejetty:00130798:ios.description:
ATI TEAS 7 Test Prep 2027 is an application that has been carefully designed and developed by industry testing experts. With more than 1,600 high-quality test questions and answer explanations, multiple test modes and a scientific analysis system, it helps you practice efficiently anytime, anywhere, making it more likely that you will pass the ATI TEAS on your first try!
ATI TEAS 7 Test Prep 2027 now supports the Test of Essential Academic Skills (TEAS) preparation. Our test experts will update and revise the content based on the latest syllabus provided by the Assessment Technology Institute (ATI).
ATI TEAS 7 Test Prep 2027 provides you with everything you need to pass the exam with confidence. Our experts have carefully studied the content of previous exams and the latest exam requirements and have expertly categorized all the subjects on the exam so that you can practice more specifically for your situation.
Specifically, we provide you with the following resources:
* 6 efficient test modes;
* Subject classification based on the exam syllabus;
* Over 1,600 high-quality questions with answer explanations;
* Performance tracking and analysis system;
* Good user interface design and smooth functionality.
Preparing for the ATI TEAS exam can be difficult, but with the help of ATI TEAS 7 Test Prep 2027, if you are determined to pass the exam and are willing to put in the effort and perseverance to do so, we are confident that we can help you achieve your goals!
Don't feel confused or frustrated about preparing for the ATI TEAS exam, effective changes take time and effort, follow in the footsteps of ATI TEAS 7 Test Prep 2026 and enjoy this fun experience that will keep you motivated! 
Let's get started right now!
***
Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to gain access to all features, courses and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted from your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged according to the rate and term of the subscription plan you choose. Subscribers' accounts will be charged an automatic renewal fee 24 hours before the end of the current term.
You can manage your subscription after purchase by turning off auto-renewal in your iTunes account settings. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Use: http://www.supertest.vip/Terms-of-Service.html
Privacy Policy: http://www.supertest.vip/Privacy-Policy.html
If you have any questions or suggestions regarding use, please feel free to contact us via email at contact@supertest.vip.
LEGAL NOTICE:
We are NOT affiliated with any testing agency, certificate, test name or any trademark. All Trademarks are the property of respected trademark owners.
DISCLAIMER :
All the features we provide are for your practice or study before the exam only. Your success on these questions or quizzes does NOT necessarily mean that you will pass the certification or that you will perform well on the exam.

bluejetty:00024141:ios.description:
Vrbo is a vacation rental app for booking top-rated homes—beach houses, cabins, condos, cottages, and villas—so your family or group gets the entire place to yourselves. Members save 10% or more on select stays with Member Prices* and earn rewards** for future trips. Find the right place for your trip and book with confidence.
WHY TRAVELERS CHOOSE VRBO
- Top-rated homes with reviews from real guests, and space for everyone
- Plan together with Trip Planner and group chat, made for groups and families
- Deals and discounts: long-stay discounts and last-minute weekend deals
- Book with confidence: over 2 million properties in 190+ countries, free cancellation on many reservations, VrboCare™ protection, and 24/7 support
MEMBER PRICES & REWARDS
- Members save 10% or more on select stays—sign in to see Member Prices
- Earn and use OneKeyCash on eligible bookings, and put your rewards toward a future getaway
- One Key™: a rewards program you won't find on any other vacation rental platform
TOP-RATED HOMES & STAYS
- Browse highly-rated places with reviews from real guests
- Clear photos, amenities, and details on every listing
- Find unique homes not listed on other platforms
GREAT FOR GROUPS & FAMILIES
- Choose a place with enough room for everyone
- Filter by price, location, and amenities—pools, backyards, pet-friendly homes, and beachfront stays
- Compare prices across multiple dates, or search within days, weeks, or a range of months
PLAN & TRAVEL TOGETHER
- Plan and collaborate with your group using Trip Planner and group chat, in real time from anywhere
- Invite friends and family to join your Trip Planner, leave comments, and vote for your favorite places
- Tap the heart icon to save and compare your favorite rentals
- Message your host right in the app and share trip details with your group
DEALS & SAVINGS
- Find last-minute and weekend deals on your next getaway
- Get long-stay discounts on select vacation rentals
BOOK WITH CONFIDENCE
- Search private places to stay among over 2 million properties in 190+ countries
- Highly-rated vacation rental app with over 1 million 5-star ratings
- Free cancellation on many reservations
- Protection included with every stay with VrboCare™
- Book securely from your phone or tablet, and pay by credit card in the Vrbo app
- Get 24/7 support from a real person for any issues that come up—reach a real person in about a minute, by phone or chat (US only)
GOOD TO KNOW
- Have questions about a property? Get quick answers from our virtual assistant
- Quickly access important booking details like check-in instructions, WiFi passwords, and arrival information, even when offline
Whether it's a weekend getaway, a family trip, or a longer break, Vrbo helps you find the right place for everyone. Download the Vrbo app and plan your next trip today.
In short: Vrbo is a vacation rental app for booking top-rated homes for families and groups, where members save 10% or more with Member Prices and earn rewards, with free cancellation on many reservations, VrboCare™ protection, and 24/7 support.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
*Member Prices are available to signed-in members on select homes; savings vary.
**One Key™ is available in the US. Rewards can be earned and used on eligible bookings across the One Key family of brands.
Currency is displayed as USD in the property listings unless otherwise noted.
By using our app, you accept our Privacy Statement and Terms of Service.

bluejetty:00079747:ios.description:

How can humanity survive in a perilous wasteland overrun by rampaging mechanized beasts?
Our once flourishing world was annihilated by colossal mechanized beasts, causing humans to be displaced wherever these beasts roamed.
For centuries, this world has been plagued by wars and massacres, until you, a valiant commander emerges.
You will lead the survivors to capture and modify beasts, train troops, form alliances, and ultimately save humanity's last remaining enclaves.
[Free Exploration]
Explore the remnants of human civilization in a vast world.
Discover traces of rare beasts, encounter mysterious characters in need of help, and locate rare resource tiles... Embark on an exciting adventure!
[Build a Shelter in the Wasteland]
A shelter is the only source of warmth and security in this desolate world.
You can design your shelter to your liking, utilizing the colossal skeletons of defeated beasts as your roof and displaying all the souvenirs you have collected on your journey.
[Create Exclusive Mecha Beasts]
Vicious mechanical beasts roam freely, wreaking havoc and leaving destruction in their wake.
Craft dozens of hunting weapons, capture and tame these beasts, and transform them into your combat force.
From Scorchers and Spikerollers to Tyrants and Sickleclaws, and even Firespitters, you can build your very own beast army.
[Train Elite Troops]
Be sure to bring enough manpower when venturing into the wilderness to search for supplies, as vicious beasts can attack at any moment! 
Assemble your own expeditionary force and create the most effective lineup.
[Form a Strong Alliance]
Don't face the apocalypse alone!
Join forces with friends or join a powerful existing alliance to share resources and increase your influence. Lead survivors in rebuilding their homes, and find hope together in this post-apocalyptic world.

bluejetty:00152924:ios.name: Adventure To Fate: Dungeons
bluejetty:00152924:ios.summary:
A Turn-based Roguelite Dungeon Crawler unlike any other. Built on over a decade of handcrafted systems and content, now expanded with new roguelike mechanics, dungeons, quests, and deeper progression than ever before.
Battle through 4 uniqu
bluejetty:00152924:ios.description:
A Turn-based Roguelite Dungeon Crawler unlike any other. Built on over a decade of handcrafted systems and content, now expanded with new roguelike mechanics, dungeons, quests, and deeper progression than ever before.
Battle through 4 unique dungeons, each with its own design, enemies, loot, play modes, and storylines:
-The Crypt of Fate - Begin in the blighted Cemetery and descend into haunted catacombs where the dark entity Thanatos once rose.
-The Lost Sands - A scorching desert hides ancient magic beneath shifting dunes. Explore forgotten temples, cursed ruins, and face monsters awakened from the past.
-The Frozen Spire - A tower of frost and shadow where icy magic corrupts everything it touches.
-(NEW) The Infernal Volcano - Journey through rivers of magma and face infernal corruption before darkness consumes the realm.
Each dungeon features FOUR play modes:
-Casual (3 lives per run)
-Champion (true roguelike permadeath)
-Mystic Mode (a dungeon-specific challenge mode with mysterious mechanics)
-Hellish Mode (The Ultimate Challenge mode: No Gold Drops, Potions can only be used in battle, and No Remorse)
Deep Character Customization & Progression
-9 Starting Classes: Paladin, Witch, Assassin, Naturalist, Shadow Ranger, Thief, Monk, Death Knight, Illusionist, and more to come!
-7 Crafting Professions (Weaponsmith, Armorsmith, Leather Worker, Tailor, Alchemist, Jeweler, and Enchanter) with unique crafts for each Dungeon!
-Unlock additional classes, races, and spirits through achievements and quests
-Choose from over 1000 handcrafted skills and spells across a wide range of archetypes
-Discover 50+ Spirits who fight alongside you and can be customized with gear and passive abilities
-Over 100 Quests to complete, each with Unique Rewards to unlock.
-Global Leaderboards and Obituaries to track others' progress... or deaths.
A World Built for Replayability
-Item & Monster Prefixes - Equipment and enemies can have unique prefixes that add new stats, spells, and effects, drastically increasing loot variety and encounter dynamics
-Custom Forge System - Create weapons and armor with your own stats, icons, and names, then find them in future runs
-Quest & Achievement System - Daily quests, class boards, and over 200 unlockable goals turn every run into progression
-Monster Bestiary - Track every enemy, skill, and loot drop to improve strategies
-20 Shrine Events to encounter (Skill Shrines, Death Shrines, Curse Shrines, Crafting Shrines, Shops, and More!)
Content-Rich, Handcrafted World
-1000s of handcrafted items, skills, NPCs, enemies, maps, and story events
-Unlimited replayability with unique randomized dungeons each run!
-Constant updates and additions based on player feedback!
Built from the Ground Up for Accessibility (VoiceOver Support)
-Fully VoiceOver supported with detailed narration and intuitive screen navigation
-Every menu, battle, and interaction is carefully designed to work with touch and screen readers
-Designed for immersion: responsive combat sounds, audio cues for direction, and dynamic environmental narration
-Optional vibration feedback enhances immersion and accessibility with distinct alerts for key events.
-Enhanced action & battle logs help VoiceOver users track everything from item equips to quest progress.
Additional Features
-Epic rock RPG soundtrack & music player by Aaron Cloutier
-Autosave and Offline play
-Retro pixel art mixed with modern polish
-Designed specifically for iOS devices and Portrait Play. 
-An active Discord community for help or suggestions
-50+ Gamecenter Leaderboards and Achievements
Whether you're a casual RPG fan or a hardcore roguelike veteran, Adventure To Fate: Dungeons offers endless progression, deep strategy, and exciting loot-driven gameplay.
And for visually impaired players, this is a full-featured, immersive RPG made just for you by players just like you.
Thanks for Supporting Accessible and Indie Game Development!

bluejetty:00032129:android.description:
Embark on a spiritual journey with our FREE and easy-to-use app, featuring the soulful recitation of the Holy Quran by Sheikh Ali Al-Hudhaify. This user-friendly app is designed for seamless navigation, allowing you to immerse yourself in the divine wisdom of the Quran at your convenience and without the need for an internet connection.
🌟 Key Features 🌟
✅ Offline Listening : Access the entire Quran offline. Enjoy Sheikh Ali Al-Hudhaify recitations without needing an internet connection, ensuring your spiritual journey is uninterrupted. 
✅ HD Quality Audio : Enjoy the highest quality MP3 audio that brings each verse of the Quran to life with clarity and precision. 
✅ Listen and Read Simultaneously : Experience a multi-sensory engagement with the Quran. Listen to Sheikh Ali Al-Hudhaify’s recitation while reading the Arabic text or translation, enhancing understanding and retention. 
✅ Advanced Search Functionality : Quickly locate specific verses or surahs with a few taps, making your Quran study more focused and efficient. 
✅ Shuffle Play : Mix up your daily Quran listening with our shuffle feature, which randomly plays different surahs, offering a refreshing way to engage with the Quran. 
✅ Background Play : Our app ensures that the recitation continues even when you use other apps or lock your screen, perfect for continuous listening without interruption. 
✅ Bookmarking & Highlights : Mark your favorite verses for easy access and highlight sections for deeper study and reflection.
Our app is designed to be straightforward and accessible for everyone, from beginners to those who regularly recite the Quran. 
Share the beauty of Sheikh Ali Al-Hudhaify’s recitation with friends and family, and don't forget to rate and review us on the store. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve and expand our offerings.
✅Explore More on Our Developer Page : Delve deeper into the Quran with other renowned reciters like Maher Al Muaqly and Abdelbaset Abdessamad available on our developer page. Expand your recitation library and enrich your spiritual practice with diverse and revered voices.
Download now and immerse yourself in the soothing recitation of the Quran, available anytime, right at your fingertips !

bluejetty:00026389:ios.summary:
** Featured on TechCrunch, Daring Fireball, iMore, 9to5Mac, BGR, MacRumors & more! **
Ask Petey a question from your Apple Watch and read the answer on your wrist. No phone needed, no waiting for a screen to light up. Petey runs as its own
bluejetty:00026389:ios.description:
** Featured on TechCrunch, Daring Fireball, iMore, 9to5Mac, BGR, MacRumors & more! **
Ask Petey a question from your Apple Watch and read the answer on your wrist. No phone needed, no waiting for a screen to light up. Petey runs as its own Watch app, with a complication for your watch face so an answer is one tap away.
Petey is also on iPhone and iPad, and your conversations stay in sync across all three.
ON YOUR WATCH
• Ask by voice or scribble, read the answer right there
• Scroll long answers with the Digital Crown
• Have the answer read out loud
• Send an answer to your phone to use it in another app
• Add Petey as a complication for one-tap access
ON IPHONE AND IPAD
• Full conversation history, synced with your Watch
• Live Activity while Petey is thinking, so you can keep doing other things
• Share a single answer or a whole conversation
• Open any link Petey mentions with one tap
• Create Apple Music playlists and view places in Apple Maps from a conversation
• Shortcuts: open Petey or ask it a question from a shortcut, or from Siri
USE YOUR OWN API KEY
If you have an OpenAI API key, add it in settings and Petey uses it directly. You pay OpenAI, not us, and you can pick from the models your key allows. A ChatGPT Plus subscription is not an API key; keys come from platform.openai.com.
FREE AND PREMIUM
Petey is free to use with a monthly limit of messages. Petey Premium removes the limit and unlocks the more capable models. Bought Petey before it went free? Tap Restore Purchases and your original purchase carries over.
PRIVACY
Conversations are stored on your device and in your iCloud. Petey does not sell or share your data.
Questions or feedback: support@petey.app
FAQ: https://petey-assistant.com/faq.html
Terms: https://petey-assistant.com/terms.html
Privacy: https://petey-assistant.com/privacy.html

Coach and keep track of your client progress. It’s free to use for the first three clients. Simply let your clients download the app and discover how Virtuagym can improve your service offering. 
IMPORTANT: With Virtuagym's Coach App, you can manage your clients at any given moment with your mobile phone. No need for a PC! As a personal trainer you can create and assign workouts for your client in your Virtuagym Coach App. Share this with your clients so they can see the personalized fitness plan you have created for them on their own app - the Virtuagym Fitness App.
HOW OUR COACHING APP HELPS PERSONAL TRAINERS
With Virtuagym coach app you keep your clients happy and healthy. You can keep track of your client progress, commitments, reactions and actions. With our app you have the big opportunity to provide an outstanding coaching experience. You clients can enjoy an increase focus on reaching their personal goals while preventing injuries.
FEATURES
Virtuagym provides the mobile coaching solution that fits the needs of any fitness coach or personal trainer with the following features: 
- Client information 
View and edit client dossiers, including intake information, medical status, and other coaching notes.
- Workouts 
Create workouts on the go and assign them to your clients.
- Exercise 
database Workouts can be created using an extensive exercise library containing over 4500 exercises.
- Progress tracking 
Track over 250 different values for all your clients, from weight to endurance to muscle strength.
- Challenges 
Introduce a competitive element to your workouts. Add clients to challenges and track their progress.
- Connect 
Stay in touch with your clients with easy access to call, email and text message.
- Seamless integration with the Virtuagym Fitness App 
Clients can track their own progress in their own fitness apps. All data is synced to your Coach app.
HOW YOU CAN SAVE TIME
Manage all your client data on the go, create and assign their training plans, and easily stay in touch. No more running to a desktop in order to change a workout. With Virtuagym Coach app for personal trainers,, you’ll have everything you need to make client coaching truly mobile.
HOW CAN WE HELP YOUR FITNESS BUSINESS GROW 
Your fitness business will be able to grow faster and better than ever before. With more time to invest into training clients, your personal trainer business will be healthier and more attractive to new clients.
MANAGE IT ALL 
Manage all aspects of your business in app. Keep all your client information, from intake to account details, in a single overview. Track lesson bookings and always ensure your time is spent optimally.
CONNECT YOUR BRAND
With our coaching app you can connect your clients with your business. Building a brand is an essential task if you want to survive today’s business. bluejetty:00023581:ios.description:
Dive into a moody, puzzle-driven mystery set in early-20th-century Paris. In Man with Ivory Cane you are pulled into a thriller of love, crime and destiny — your beloved Sasha has vanished and a sinister puppet master is pulling strings behind the scenes.
Explore atmospheric Parisian locations, collect clues, combine items, crack ciphers and solve dozens of brain-teasing puzzles and mini-games to uncover the truth. Use your wits to interrogate suspects, access hidden rooms and piece together a conspiracy that reaches to the city’s highest ranks.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT
• Puzzle & mystery adventure — dozens of unique riddles and mini-games. 
• Intriguing narrative — a dramatic plot with twists and memorable characters.
• Atmospheric locations — early-20th-century Paris in rich art and cutscenes.
• Map & Journal – always know where to go next.
• Full voiceovers & HD visuals – immerse yourself in the story.
• 3 difficulty levels – from relaxed exploration to true challenge.
PERFECT FOR PLAYERS WHO WANT:
• Fully optimized for your iPad and iPad Pro — play on a big screen with stunning HD graphics and details!
• Play completely offline - Phone & tablet support — anytime, anywhere
• No data collection — your privacy is safe
• A hidden object puzzle adventure with a rich story.
• Try free, unlock full game once – no ads, no micro-transactions.
Gameplay
Tap to search scenes, collect clues, combine items from your inventory, and complete mini-games to progress the story. Use hints if you get stuck — but the reward is uncovering more of the mystery.
Play your way
Explore, investigate, find hidden objects and items, and solve puzzles and mini-games and reveal the mystery in your own way: adjustable challenge: Casual, Adventure, and Challenging difficulty modes. Win Achievements & Collectibles.
Atmospheric adventure
A gripping mystery adventure: narrative-driven game-play with a strong detective lead. Immersive locations waiting to be explored; seek, search and solve puzzles.
Why players love it
The combination of art and atmosphere and blend of story-driven adventure and classic puzzles and minigames. Whether you love relaxing hunts or challenge-driven puzzles, this game offers both.
Free to try
Try for free, then unlock the full game for the entire mystery — no distractions, just mystery to solve.
• STEP into the role of a young artist caught up in a STRANGE CRIME
• FOLLOW the bread-crumbs to save your love
• INVESTIGATE Paris and dozens of locations
• SEARCH for clues and FIND HIDDEN OBJECTS
• DISCOVER the truth behind the chaos
• SOLVE variety of riddles and MINI-GAMES
• EARN achievements and COLLECT special items
• DIFFICULTY MODES: novice, adventure, challenge and custom
• BEAUTIFUL high-definition graphics and an absorbing story line

bluejetty:00155976:ios.description:
We're virtual care, on your time. Get care in minutes and get on with your life.
With DocSquad, you can quickly and easily have qualified providers review your symptoms and get a diagnosis, with or without insurance. Get most common conditions treated and prescriptions refilled without needing an office visit.
How does it work?
1. Select the reason for your visit
2. Answer online questions for a fast treatment with Digital Diagnosis
3. Receive a diagnosis and treatment plan from a board-certified provider
It's that simple. Our Digital Diagnosis option allows you to submit your symptoms for provider review, while you get on with your day. You can also receive quick prescription refills with no office visit. On average, you'll receive your diagnosis and treatment plan, or prescription refill, in as little as 10 minutes! If the provider has any questions or concerns, they'll reach out to you for a call.
What do we treat?
We can treat you for most common issues, including:
• cold and flu
• sinus infections
• UTIs
• skin conditions
• aches and pains
• gastrointestinal issues
• sexual health conditions
We also provide quick and easy medication refills.
Our doctors and nurse practitioners are board-certified and based here in the US. The questions used in our Digital Diagnosis are created and regularly re-evaluated by providers to ensure accurate diagnosis and treatment.
Who can use DocSquad?
DocSquad is available to everyone 18 and older in the US - with or without insurance. We have upfront pricing with no surprise bills. Connect your insurance to see what your rate will be.
No insurance? No worries! Digital Diagnosis is available at affordable flat rates no matter what the reason for the visit is. Any prescribed medication is additional.
Preferred Insurance Features
Through a special partnership with Bright HealthCare, we do more than get you the care you need. Access your insurance plan information and search in-network doctors and clinics, all from the app.

bluejetty:00088337:ios.description:
Do you want to take control of your metabolism, lose weight, and live a healthier lifestyle?
With Lumen’s personalized metabolic coach, you can! 
Lumen is the world’s first device to measure whether your body is burning fats or carbs - in a single breath. Say goodbye to guessing and hello to real-time metabolic insights, tailored daily nutrition plans, and recommendations on what to eat and when.
With direct access to your metabolism at your fingertips, our features will guide you to speeding up your metabolism, keep you motivated to reach your health goals, and feel your best self. 
EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO HACK YOUR METABOLISM
Features include:
* Real-time metabolic insights to guide you on your journey
* Personalized daily nutrition plans
* Lifestyle recommendations for sleep, exercise, fasting, and more
* Customizable tracks to achieve your goals
* Healthy habit building
* Progress tracker
* Monthly cycle tracker
* An engaged community for support and discussions
This app integrates with Health apps to sync data on your activity and sleep.
SUITABLE PLANS FOR EVERYBODY
At Lumen, we believe in a personalized approach to health. That's why we offer different plans designed to fit your unique goals, whether it's weight loss, fitness performance, or improving your metabolic health. With our progress tracker and healthy habit influences, you'll have the support you need to succeed.
WORKING ON YOUR WEIGHT LOSS JOURNEY 
By macro-tracking your meals, you can continue enjoying the meals you love with a new outlook and healthier relationship with food and yourself!
PERSONALIZED NUTRITIONAL PLANS & MEAL PLANNING
Lumen tracks your metabolism, but it’s also a powerful tool for managing your journey in nutrition, fitness, and overall well-being. The app includes interactive features to help you stay on track with your nutrition goals, such as meal planning and recipe suggestions. 
FUELING UP PRE AND POST WORKOUTS
Don't let energy levels hold you back from your workout goals. Lumen gives you real-time insights into your body's fuel usage, so you'll know exactly when to hit the gym and when to rest. Lumen levels will guide you on whether you have enough energy or need to fuel up before your workouts. 
SCIENTIFICALLY-BACKED
If you like talking science - we’ve been featured in peer-reviewed articles and building research ourselves. Lumen's technology has been scientifically proven to accurately measure metabolic fuel usage when compared to the gold standard (RER) for measuring metabolism in multiple validation studies.
PREMIUM CONTENT
Improve your knowledge with our informative library of videos from fitness experts, coaches, and nutritionists.
MOTIVATION
Every breath measurement will tell you what’s happening in your body. These insights help you maintain your motivation and give you guidance on how to hit your goals. 
So, what are you waiting for? Download Lumen today and start your journey to a healthier, happier you! You'll have the support and guidance you need to take control of your metabolism and live your best life.
Lumen has been featured in Forbes, BBC News, TechCrunch,Entrepreneur.com, Wired Magazine, Shape Magazine, and more
Winner of the CES 2019 Best Reviews Award | Listed in the Top 30 Best Devices CES 2019 | Esquire 2020 product award
Please note:
You must have a Lumen device to use this app. You can order your device from www.lumen.me
While Lumen is not intended as a medical device, it is recommended to consult your doctor before starting any nutrition plan.
Interested in partnering with us? Get in touch with us www.lumen.me/partners
Join us and begin your Lumen journey today!

bluejetty:00097130:ios.description:
open road tracks every drive for you. it records your route, miles and top speed, then adds each road to your own map.
see your full history, your records, and the drivers you follow. it works with carplay.
pro unlocks the community map, live friends and deeper stats. 3 days free on the yearly plan.
50,000+ drivers
you drive every day and almost none of it gets kept. the store run, the loop, the drive to a friend's, the long way home. open road keeps all of it, so the map of where you have driven fills in on its own and any drive you took is still there a year later.
drive tracker, drive log, trip log, route tracker, car stats, mileage, odometer, driving history. people call it a lot of things. it is the same idea. every drive saved without you doing anything.
what you get
• your drive log: every drive with the route drawn, the time, the distance and the day you took it.
• your map: every road you have driven, filling in as you go.
• your garage: every car you own, tracked on its own.
• your friends on one live map while they drive.
• speed cameras and average-speed zones on the map, plus police and hazard reports from drivers.
• navigation built in, and the drive keeps recording while you use it.
• convoy voice chat with your group, and the recap after you park.
• streaks and milestones for every drive you take.
• weather on your past drives, so you remember the day how it was.
• a 3D map and a share card for the drives worth showing.
• long drives are easy on the battery, and every drive saves and syncs.
the map is the part people keep coming back to. one road at a time it turns into a picture of everywhere you have taken your car, and it is yours. it does not reset, it does not expire, and it keeps filling in for as long as you drive.
who it is for
drivers who care about the road. the person who takes the long way. the weekend trip that ends up being the best part of the month. the group that drives together and wants one map for all of it. anyone who looks forward to getting in the car.
how far it goes
free to download. premium adds depth: more of your history, deeper stats, and more of what you already use. 30 languages.
what drivers say
"App is clean and far better than competition." Jan 21, 2026
"Works well super clean interface." Jan 25, 2026
drive responsibly. use where legal.

community guidelines: openroaddrive.com/community-guidelines

bluejetty:00122514:ios.summary:
BCGE TWINT allows you to send and receive money quickly and easily directly from your BCGE account. You can also pay securely in participating stores with the TWINT logo and at online shops.
Functionalities :
- Send, request and receive mo
bluejetty:00122514:ios.description:
BCGE TWINT allows you to send and receive money quickly and easily directly from your BCGE account. You can also pay securely in participating stores with the TWINT logo and at online shops.
Functionalities :
- Send, request and receive money directly from your BCGE account
- Pay in participating stores and at online shops
- View details of past transactions
- Receive many special offers and include your loyalty cards directly into your BCGE TWINT app
Advantages :
- Fast, sending and requesting money only takes a few seconds
- Practical, your account is debited or credited directly. No more cash needed
- Secure, you register with your BCGE Netbanking access and you log in with a PIN you chose.
- Attractive, your loyalty cards are already on the app and your discounts will always be at hand
- Free, there are no additional fees on transactions
Pay in shops:
Depending on the option chosen by the store, you will have the possibility to pay by clicking on “Pay” on your BCGE TWINT or by scanning the QR code of the shopkeeper. 
For your online shopping, you can enter their digital code of five numbers and finalise your purchases.
More information on : https://www.bcge.ch/en/twint
Read our general terms and conditions: https://www.bcge.ch/en/twint-utilisation

bluejetty:00142891:ios.name: Prelude Connect
bluejetty:00142891:ios.summary: Prelude Connect provides the tools you need to effectively manage the fertility process. Features include an instant access account portal, care team text messaging and interactive calendar and one-touch clinic call and directions. Exclusiv
bluejetty:00142891:ios.description:
Prelude Connect provides the tools you need to effectively manage the fertility process. Features include an instant access account portal, care team text messaging and interactive calendar and one-touch clinic call and directions. Exclusive to the Prelude Network of fertility centers across the U.S., Prelude Connect is a virtual companion created by experts to support and guide you through your individualized fertility care plan. 
Tools and features to give you access, support and control throughout your personal fertility journey include:
• A personalized interactive calendar offers a complete view of the medications to be administered during a treatment cycle, visibility into appointments in and out of cycle, and menses cycle tracking. When clicking each calendar day, you can see medications to take, confirm whether they have been taken, and access videos for help in administrating medications. You may also directly message your care team with questions.
• Prelude Connect Messaging allows for two-way HIPAA compliant text messaging preventing phone tag and missed timelines and enabling you to receive quick reminders from your care team to help keep you on track. In-app video messaging also offers valuable face time with your team between clinic visits. 
• The Prelude Connect Portal offers 24/7 access to your account including clinical records, labs, and other helpful resources.
• A one-touch contact feature allows you to call your clinic immediately from app.
• A one-touch feature also allows you to launch directions to your clinic from the app.
Additional Features:
In- app notifications support patient appointment reminders, medication changes following a monitoring appointment, lab results and remarks, documents shared from the care team, procedure prep notifications, trigger notifications for cycle shots, and more. 
Download Prelude Connect today to effectively manage your personalized fertility plan. 
A Modern Approach to Family 
The Prelude Network is the largest network of fertility clinics providing comprehensive fertility services in the U.S. We launched Prelude to enhance what people know and change how they think about fertility. We’re on a mission to help educate people about their reproductive health and provide them with the best options, science, and care so that, when they are ready, everyone can have the opportunity to be a parent. Visit https://www.preludefertility.com/ for more information.

bluejetty:00161572:ios.description:
Melhore sua alimentação com escolhas mais saudáveis e inteligentes. Com o Posso Comer você tem acesso a uma análise completa dos alimentos para transformar sua alimentação.

Escaneie qualquer alimento e descubra: 
- Nota saudável
- Pontos positivos e negativos
- Tabela nutricional completa
- Alimentos semelhantes e recomendados
"Você sabia que muitos alimentos que parecem saudáveis podem conter ingredientes prejudiciais?"
Nos desenvolvemos um aplicativo com tecnologia avançada de inteligência artificial para resolver esse problema. Basta escanear um produto e ter uma análise nutricional completa do rótulo, nutrientes e tabela nutricional. É a ferramenta certa para te ajudar a fazer escolhas mais conscientes.
-> Nunca mais seja enganado por rótulos! Saiba a verdade sobre os alimentos que você consome com o PossoComer. 
Com o Posso Comer ainda é possível: 
- Comparar alimentos e marcas
- Criar listas de compras
- Compartilhar suas listas com outras pessoas
- Fazer compras simultaneamente 
"Mas e se eu não entender os ingredientes?"
O Posso Comer explica de forma simples o que cada nutriente representa e se ele faz bem ou mal para a sua saúde. Sem termos complicados ou informações confusas – tudo fácil de entender.
"Será que o app realmente funciona?"
Sim! O Posso Comer utiliza inteligência artificial para garantir a precisão das análises nutricionais. E com atualizações frequentes, ele se mantém sempre atualizado com as novas descobertas e tendências do mundo da alimentação.
-> Faça escolhas inteligentes e melhore sua alimentação com o Posso Comer. Instale agora!

bluejetty:00114726:ios.summary:

Sow is an all-in-one landscape planner and garden companion that helps you visualize new ideas, choose plants suited to your spac
bluejetty:00114726:ios.description:
Bring your outdoor space to life—with the right ideas, the right plants, and the tools to keep them thriving.
Sow is an all-in-one landscape planner and garden companion that helps you visualize new ideas, choose plants suited to your space, identify and diagnose plant problems, measure sunlight, map your property, and manage your yard with confidence.
Sow gives you 10k+ real plants, practical planning tools, and care guidance to turn inspiration into a thriving outdoor space.
DESIGN AND VISUALIZE YOUR YARD
See what your outdoor space could become before you buy, dig, or build.
Generate landscape ideas from a photo, explore different styles, and refine your plan with easy-to-use editing tools. Create bird’s-eye layouts, arrange plants and furniture with drag-and-drop controls, and use satellite imagery and site plans to organize everything from one bed to an entire property.
Turn inspiration into an editable landscape plan built with real plants.
CHOOSE PLANTS THAT WILL THRIVE
Explore more than 10,000 trees, shrubs, perennials, grasses, native plants, vegetables, groundcovers, and cultivars available from nurseries and garden centers.
Find plants suited to your:
• Hardiness zone and local climate
• Sunlight and growing conditions
• Available space and desired mature size
• Preferred colors, styles, and bloom seasons
• Water and maintenance preferences
• Landscape goals, from privacy to pollinator support
Compare online nursery availability and prices when you are ready to plant.
MEASURE SUNLIGHT BEFORE YOU PLANT
Avoid guessing whether a spot is full sun, part shade, or deep shade.
Use Sow’s AR sunlight tool to analyze the sun’s path from any location in your yard. It accounts for sunlight blocked by trees, buildings, fences, and other obstacles as the sun moves across the sky, estimating how many hours of direct sunlight that spot receives.
IDENTIFY PLANTS AND DIAGNOSE PROBLEMS
Take a photo to identify an unknown plant — backed by over 1.5 million identifications — and save it to your collection.
When a plant or lawn looks unhealthy, Plant Doctor checks it against hundreds of thousands of expert-annotated images and 548 classes of pests, diseases, disorders, and harmless look-alikes. Get likely causes, treatment steps, and prevention guidance.
MAP AND MANAGE YOUR OUTDOOR SPACE
Create a living map of everything in your yard.
Record the locations of plants, beds, patios, paths, structures, and other landscape features. Organize projects, save photos, and keep a useful history of what you planted and where.
SMART WEATHER, WATERING, AND CARE GUIDANCE
Use local forecasts, rainfall history, drought conditions, frost dates, and watering insights to understand what your landscape needs.
Track plant care, receive helpful growing tips, and make better decisions based on your plants, location, weather, and growing conditions.
SHARE IDEAS AND GET FEEDBACK
Share landscape designs and garden projects, ask questions, discover new ideas, and get feedback before making changes.
PLAN ON MOBILE OR WEB
Your designs, maps, plants, and garden information sync with usesow.com, so you can plan and manage your outdoor space from your phone or computer.
Sow can help you:
• Redesign a front yard, backyard, or garden bed
• Plan native, pollinator, privacy, and vegetable gardens
• Identify unknown plants and diagnose struggling ones
• Choose plants for difficult sun, shade, or climate conditions
• Map your landscape and track watering, weather, and seasonal care
• Plan DIY projects or collaborate with professionals
From your first idea to a thriving landscape, Sow brings your entire outdoor space together in one place. 
Download Sow and start designing, planting, and caring for your yard today.
Privacy First:
Sow does not track or share personal data with ad networks.

bluejetty:00043610:ios.name: Cookingdom
bluejetty:00043610:ios.summary: Hey there, chef! Welcome to Cook & Chill, an ultimate chill & cozy game that makes cooking as relaxing as a satisfying Sunday morning. This is all about slowing down, having fun, and creating delicious dishes step by step. You’ll go from ch
bluejetty:00043610:ios.description:
Hey there, chef! Welcome to Cook & Chill, an ultimate chill & cozy game that makes cooking as relaxing as a satisfying Sunday morning. This is all about slowing down, having fun, and creating delicious dishes step by step. You’ll go from chopping potatoes to plating masterpieces, all while soaking in those soothing chill vibes.
Step-by-Step Cooking Fun:
Each recipe is broken into small, satisfying mini-games that let you focus on one step at a time:
Chop & Dice: Gently slice veggies, herbs, or even fancy garnishes. The soft sounds of your knife hitting the cutting board? Chef’s kiss! 
Mix & Stir: Combine ingredients with satisfying swirls as batter or soup comes together before your eyes. Watch the colors blend—it’s like food ASMR.
Cook to Perfection: Flip pancakes, sauté veggies, or grill meats just right. Mistime it? No problem—there’s always room for a laugh and another try!
Plating Masterpieces: Carefully arrange your dishes to look as tasty as they are. Add a sprinkle of herbs or drizzle a sauce for that perfect finishing touch.
Dishes to Warm Your Soul
From comforting classics to creative fusion dishes, there’s always something delicious to make:
A steaming bowl of miso ramen with all the toppings 
Stacks of fluffy pancakes drizzled with syrup 
A colorful charcuterie board full of cute snacks 
Warm chocolate lava cake oozing with goodness 
With each completed dish, you’ll unlock more recipes, ingredients, and fun tools to play with.
Make Your Kitchen a Cozy Haven
Cooking feels better in a space you love, so customize your kitchen to match your vibes:
Add cozy touches like twinkling fairy lights, potted plants, or rustic wooden shelves.
Upgrade your tools, from colorful cutting boards to adorable whisks shaped like cats.
Dress your chef in comfy aprons, fuzzy slippers, or even themed outfits for each recipe!
Why You’ll Love It
It's Your Cozy Culinary Escape: No stress, no timers, just the relaxing joy of creating beautiful food.
Sounds You Can Feel: The crunch of slicing veggies, the gentle simmer of soup, the tap-tap-tap of seasoning… it’s like a warm blanket for your ears.
Your Kitchen, Your Style: Decorate your space with cute plants, fairy lights, or even a cat clock that says “meow” when you finish a dish.
Adorable Chef Fits: Rock a bunny apron, fuzzy slippers, or a sweater that screams “I make soup and it’s amazing.”
Relaxing Vibes for Every Playthrough: With soft lo-fi beats, soothing sound effects, and dreamy visuals, the game feels like wrapping yourself in a warm blanket while sipping hot cocoa. Take your time, enjoy the journey, and let your inner chef shine.
Ready to Cook & Chill?
Whether you’re winding down after a long day or just want to chill with some virtual pancakes, Cook & Chill is here for you. Take your time, enjoy every step, and let the cozy vibes do the rest.
Cook & Chill is the ultimate cozy cooking escape. Whether you’re here to unwind, get inspired, or simply enjoy making food step-by-step, you’ll leave every session feeling refreshed and satisfied. So grab your spatula—it’s time to cook up some chill vibes! 
So, what are you waiting for? Download now and turn your screen into the cutest little kitchen where cooking made cozy stories. It’s time to cook, relax, and chill.

bluejetty:00063252:ios.description:
Diamond Art is a relaxing color-by-number diamond painting app.
Choose from beautiful pictures, follow the numbers, and fill each canvas with sparkling gems. Every tap adds shine, color, and a satisfying sense of progress.
Diamonds can appear as gems, flowers, jewels, buttons, and other playful shapes. Pick a picture, zoom in, match the number, and watch the artwork come alive piece by piece.
Features:
- Plenty of free pictures and diamond art designs
- Simple one-finger coloring controls
- Calming progress for quick breaks or longer creative sessions
- Family-friendly pictures, mandalas, flowers, animals, patterns, and more
- Save finished artwork and share it with friends
Open Diamond Art whenever you want an easy, colorful, and glittering painting moment.
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
- Diamond Art can be accessed for free. Free users have access to free content. The free version may include interstitial, banner, and native ads.
- You can purchase a weekly, monthly, or yearly subscription to unlock all content and remove ads.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off in your Apple ID subscription settings after purchase.
Canceling trial or subscription
You can cancel the subscription anytime in your Apple ID subscription settings. See https://support.apple.com/HT202039. When the current subscription period expires, access to Premium content will end.
Contact: creative.feedback@hotmail.com

Privacy Policy: http://incolor.cc/en/nodiamond_privacy.html

bluejetty:00170865:ios.description:
Welcome to Triple Goods: Match & Sort 3D, the ultimate store-themed matching and sorting experience! Dive into the world of supermarkets, grocery stores, and shops as you arrange and match sets of goods on shelves. Test your matching skills and become a master sorter in this fun and casual game that's perfect for short gaming sessions.
Key Features:
- Explore various store environments, from supermarkets to local grocery shops.
- Arrange and match sets of goods on shelves to perfect your sorting skills.
- Engage in exciting matching games that challenge your speed and precision.
- Enjoy the satisfaction of creating matched sets and perfectly sorted shelves.
- Play a variety of short games that offer quick and enjoyable experiences.
- Discover the joy of easy and free matching games that are perfect for casual gameplay.
- Sharpen your matching skills with food items, bottles, and other fun items.
- Combine games and goods in a unique way, creating a good fun-filled experience.
- Collect free games and rewards as you progress through the sorting challenges.
- Experience the thrill of finding and matching items, from groceries to store essentials.
- Immerse yourself in the world of goods triple matching for an extra challenge.
- Test your matching prowess in tiledom and enjoy the satisfaction of perfectly sorted shelves.
Triple Goods: Match & Sort 3D is the best matching and sorting game for those who love the excitement of exploring supermarkets, grocery stores, and shops while honing their matching skills. Get ready for a unique and entertaining gameplay experience that combines the thrill of matching with the joy of sorting. Download now and embark on a sorting adventure like never before!

bluejetty:00183448:ios.summary:
Can't tolerate lactose, fructose, histamine, gluten or something else? ALLiCANEAT shows you in seconds what you can still eat – no ads, no tracking, no account.
Sorbitol, salicylic acid, FODMAP, allergies or sensitive ingredients such as c
bluejetty:00183448:ios.description:
Can't tolerate lactose, fructose, histamine, gluten or something else? ALLiCANEAT shows you in seconds what you can still eat – no ads, no tracking, no account.
Sorbitol, salicylic acid, FODMAP, allergies or sensitive ingredients such as cow's milk, egg, soy, wheat, fish, crustaceans, nuts, sulphites, benzoates, glutamate or aspartame: just select everything that applies to you, in any combination. ALLiCANEAT calculates your personal tolerance rating for every food and every scanned product.
HOW IT WORKS
• From apples to zucchini: a large food database with a traffic light system – green, yellow, orange, red
• Barcode scanner: scan millions of products and instantly see whether they suit you – including label information such as "gluten-free", "lactose-free", allergens and traces
• Quick search and categories such as fruit, beverages, dairy products or sweets
• Color filter: for example, show only green foods
• Details on lactose, fructose, glucose, histamine, sorbitol, salicylic acid, biogenic amines, amino acids, the fructose-glucose ratio, histamine liberators and DAO inhibitors
• Your own rating: if you tolerate a food better or worse than suggested, simply adjust it
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No ads
• No tracking, no analytics tools
• No account, no sign-up
• Your intolerances, ratings and favorites stay on your device
• Works offline – only the barcode scanner needs internet
A FULL PLATE FOR FREE
The essentials are free, without any ads:
• As many intolerances and allergies as you like – in any combination
• Search, categories and color filter
• All details for every food
• Your own ratings for your 10 most important foods
• Barcode scanner with 2 scans per day
• Dark mode and 22 languages – handy when traveling, too
HUNGRY FOR SECONDS?
Pro gets you even more:
• Unlimited scans – for the big weekly shop
• Favorites: your go-to foods are always on the menu
• Unlimited custom ratings
• Combine color filters freely, for example green and yellow together
Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription or as a one-time lifetime purchase. You can try the subscription for free and cancel anytime.
Note: ALLiCANEAT does not replace advice from a doctor or nutrition professional. Your individual tolerance may vary.
Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00030291:ios.name: Match Factory!
bluejetty:00030291:ios.summary:
Welcome to Match Factory - The Ultimate 3D Puzzle Adventure!
Dive into the fascinating world of Match Factory, the brand new puzzle game from the creators of Toon Blast & Toy Blast. Once you play, you will come for Match Factory every day!
bluejetty:00030291:ios.description:
Welcome to Match Factory - The Ultimate 3D Puzzle Adventure!
Dive into the fascinating world of Match Factory, the brand new puzzle game from the creators of Toon Blast & Toy Blast. Once you play, you will come for Match Factory every day!
Connect identical items, sort tiles, and clear the board in this mesmerizing match 3D game. Challenge your puzzle-solving skills as you keep sorting and matching objects until every item is cleared from the screen. It’s not just a puzzle; it’s a test of your wit and strategy.
Relax and Have Fun! Leave your worries behind and enjoy quality relaxation and fun. Immerse yourself in the soothing game atmosphere , enjoy your brain time and increase your zen!
Play Anytime, Anywhere without WI-FI! Enjoy the game online or offline, and never worry about Wi-Fi. Whether you’re on a grand adventure or simply taking a break, Match Factory will always be there to entertain you. In-app purchases do require an active internet connection.
Become the Master of 3D Puzzles! Time is of the essence in this match 3d game! With each level equipped with a timer, you’ll need to think fast and act even faster to triumph!
Boosters to the Rescue! Stuck on a level? Fear not! Match Factory offers a range of powerful boosters to help you overcome tricky situations. Utilize these remarkable tools to advance through the game and unlock exciting items like fruits, candy, cake objects and much more!
Immerse yourself in the world of Match Factory, where thrilling 3D puzzles and hidden objects awaits your keen eye and sharp mind! Download Match Factory now and prove your matching skills to the world! Can you conquer every level and emerge as the ultimate puzzle master?
The Factory Gates Are Open - Start Matching Now!
Match Factory is free to download and includes optional in-game purchases. If you wish to disable in-game purchases, please turn off the in-app purchases in your phone or tablet’s Settings.
You must be at least 13 years of age, or such higher age as required in your country, to play or download Match Factory.

bluejetty:00128324:ios.description:
Unlock the world of mathematics for children who are naturally curious and eager to learn through immersive gameplay. Dinosaur Math offers a unique adventure that combines educational games and math learning games for kids, perfectly designed to entertain and educate simultaneously. With a rich tapestry of Montessori math activities and pre-K activities, this app sets the stage for a lifelong love of learning.
Explore and Build with Numbers!
Dive into over 30 foundational principles of math, each embedded within captivating and interactive stories. Merging the essence of mathematics with the charm of storytelling, Dinosaur Math makes learning effortless and exciting. Whether it's through counting and numbers games or complex problem-solving, children are inspired to explore mathematical concepts in a world filled with vibrant animations and responsive gameplay.
What Your Child Will Learn
Our content ranges from recognizing numbers 0-20 to mastering addition and subtraction within those bounds. This app offers unique teaching modes and practice scenarios for every kind of math challenge. Ideal for toddler, kindergarten, and preschool-aged learners, Dinosaur Math is a safe haven for young minds to blossom.
Meet Your New Friends: T-Rex and the Fluffy Monsters
Join T-Rex and five adorable monsters in a journey of discovery and fun! These characters are not just companions; they are catalysts for learning, sparking creativity and enthusiasm in every lesson. Learning through play has never been more delightful, with each interaction designed to foster a love for mathematics and collaborative learning.
Engage and Decorate: Instant Rewards and Building Games
When challenges arise, T-Rex is there to offer helpful hints, keeping frustration at bay and motivation high. Each completed task rewards children with gold coins, which can be used in our engaging building games for kids. Create a magical in-game world with fountains, sculptures, and luxurious castles, enhancing the joy and satisfaction of learning.
Offline Accessibility and Child-Friendly Interface
Dinosaur Math works offline, ensuring your child's learning journey continues anywhere, anytime. With no third-party advertisements and a user-friendly interface, it's a completely safe for kids environment. Our intuitive study reports update automatically, providing insights into your child's progress with details on exercise time and accuracy rates.
Colors, Shapes, and More: Engage with Every Element
Beyond numbers, Dinosaur Math incorporates learning about colors and shapes, making it a comprehensive tool for early education. These elements are woven into the gameplay to enrich the learning experience, making it an all-encompassing tool for cognitive development.
Download Dinosaur Math today and give your child the joy of learning through play with one of the best preschool math games and brain games available. Transform learning into an adventure with Dinosaur Math, where education meets excitement!
About Yateland
Yateland creates educational gems, inspiring little learners worldwide to embrace play as a pathway to knowledge! “Apps children adore, and parents trust.” Discover the Yateland treasure trove at https://yateland.com.

bluejetty:00185764:ios.description:
One player has dark pieces, and one player has light pieces. They take turns moving their pieces. Players move their pieces diagonally from one square to another square. When a player jumps over their opponent's (the other player's) piece, he takes that piece from the board. By default a potential piece will have to be taken but you can set custom rules and disable this rule.
The player's goal is to take all the pieces of its opponent.
With this version of Checkers (also known as Draughts) , you can play with a friend who sits next to you or play against your phone.

bluejetty:00200173:ios.name: Forum, a Facebook app
bluejetty:00200173:ios.summary:
Facebook is great for keeping up with friends, watching videos, and staying connected. Forum is where you go deeper in groups. It's a space designed for real discussions, shared interests, and the people who’ve been there.
Dedicated space
bluejetty:00200173:ios.description:
Facebook is great for keeping up with friends, watching videos, and staying connected. Forum is where you go deeper in groups. It's a space designed for real discussions, shared interests, and the people who’ve been there.
Dedicated space for your groups 
Sign in with your Facebook account and your groups, profile and activity carry over. You have the option to post with a nickname. Your groups still exist on Facebook and anything you share on Forum will be visible in your groups on Facebook. This is just a space built around them. 
Stay in the loop on conversations you care about
Your feed is built around conversations from groups. See what real people are saying, not just what’s trending, and easily jump back in where you left off.
Ask and get answers from real people 
Looking for opinions, advice or recommendations? Ask pulls together responses from across groups, so you can get answers right away from people who've been there and join the conversation.
Built for the people who run groups
Admins still have access to all their tools on Facebook, and now they also have an admin AI assistant on Forum to help manage their groups, moderate content, and keep their communities healthy — all while maintaining control. 
Dive into topics that interest you 
Forum brings people together around the things they care about, from niche hobbies to local recommendations to support groups. Share your take, join the conversation and connect with your communities. 
Some features may not be available in your country or region.

bluejetty:00143614:ios.description:
BzZzZz! Join our hive and start communicating smoothly in a foreign language. It has never been easier to learn English and Spanish!
BeeSpeaker is a true revolution and the first-ever app totally devoted to learning to actually SPEAK English and Spanish. The app gets you speaking from day 1. Within the first week, our users say up to 1000 words in the language they’re learning.
How? It’s a voice-controlled and AI-powered app, based on modern machine learning technology, in which your task is to listen to words and phrases and repeat or answer questions, speaking out loud in a foreign language. BeeSpeaker recognizes what you’re saying and gives you instant feedback. This way, you know where you’re making mistakes and where you need to improve.
Why BeeSpeaker?
- 3000+ English and Spanish video lessons with our teachers and native speakers designed to improve your speaking skills.
- All language lessons are tailored to your level - starting from A0 and ending at C1.
- A powerful AI Tutor module that corrects your mistakes and lets you practice free conversations, any time, any place.
- Focus on vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, and listening skills.
- Real-time feedback shows you where you’re making mistakes.
- Progress tracking, points and streaks help you stay motivated and keep the learning part FUN!
Are you tired of English vocabulary apps? Are you feeling stuck when actually trying to communicate in English?
We focus on a natural method of learning a language. Instead of memorizing words, grammar rules, or reading flashcards, you learn by listening and repeating in English or Spanish and by practicing real-life conversations. Our interactive lessons help you listen, repeat, and correct mistakes instantly, building confidence every time you speak. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced learner, we’ve got lessons tailored for all levels!
How different people use BeeSpeaker?
- Absolute beginners learn English or Spanish from scratch, with our video lessons tailored to A0 and A1 levels
- Intermediate learners build vocabulary and progress to upper levels through our video course and by practicing speaking with BeeSpeaker’s AI Teacher
- Advanced learners practice pronunciation and speaking with AI Tutor to prepare for popular English exams, like FCE, TOEFL, IELTS, or TOEIC
- And for the most advanced learners, we’ve just added a C1 English course so that you can master your English to perfection
Our instructors
- Experienced teachers and native speakers from countries like Great Britain, the United States, and Australia.
- Thanks to them you will learn different accents and ways of pronouncing particular words.
AI Tutor
- BeeSpeaker’s AI Tutor is your personal English & Spanish language coach powered by artificial intelligence, available 24/7.
- It lets you practice free conversations and adjusts responses to what you’re saying - just like in real life. But without judgement or stress.
The app offers a free 7-day trial during which you can test every feature inside. You can cancel your trial anytime. And when you’re ready, you can unlock all features with our PRO subscription.
Break free from speaking anxiety, gain confidence, and speak English and Spanish naturally! The more you practice with BeeSpeaker, the faster you'll improve. Ready to start speaking fluently? Let BeeSpeaker be your guide.
Download now and join the language revolution!
Terms of use: https://beespeaker.com/terms/
Privacy policy: https://beespeaker.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00061010:ios.name: OrbitNote
bluejetty:00061010:ios.summary: OrbitNote is an accessible, reading and study PDF tool for all. Annotate, mark up, listen to and save PDF files which are then still fully compatible with other popular PDF apps. Have accessible text PDF files spoken back to you with human
bluejetty:00061010:ios.description:
OrbitNote is an accessible, reading and study PDF tool for all. Annotate, mark up, listen to and save PDF files which are then still fully compatible with other popular PDF apps. Have accessible text PDF files spoken back to you with human quality voice & synchronised highlighting. PDF image files or photographs of text can be converted to accessible, searchable PDF files and read in the app.
+ Speech, Productivity and Accessibility
Alongside the full range of iOS system voices, OrbitNote comes with a range of high-quality voices in different languages. A ‘Speak in Background’ option lets you listen to a PDF while viewing another app - great for proofreading PDF files while you’re working in other apps. The ‘Speak on tap’ and ‘Stop on tap’ options make speech easy to control.
+ OrbitNote allows the background colour of the PDF to be changed, and text colour inverted, to enhance readability. OrbitNote fully supports VoiceOver. 
+ Annotations, Notes and Comments
OrbitNote includes a powerful Annotation toolbar that lets you add notes and other comments. These are fully interchangeable with most other popular PDF apps, so your OrbitNote comments will still be there if you open the PDF on another device. Annotations created in another PDF app can also be viewed and edited.
Annotation features include: highlight; underscore; strikeout; notes; free text (type straight into the PDF); free line draw; shapes (circle, square, line - with many options); images (you can even insert photos from your iPad camera or photo library into the PDF file); audio and video.
+ Photos and Image PDF to Text PDF Conversion
You can convert photos and other images to fully accessible text PDF files that can be spoken, searched, copied and highlighted. As well as converting photos, you can also convert any PDF Image file into a fully accessible Text PDF file. Along with making these PDF files accessible and searchable, it will also compress them, reducing file size. Further credit can be purchased in app. Photos and Image PDF to Text PDF Conversion in OrbitNote requires an internet connection.
+ Managing PDF Files
PDF files can be opened in OrbitNote from all other apps, including Mail and Safari. All opened PDF files will be placed in the OrbitNote Documents List for later viewing. You can also open files from Google Drive, OneDrive, or import directly from your device. PDF files can be saved into OrbitNote Documents, OneDrive or Google Drive, sent by email, or opened in other apps that support PDF files.
+ Sync with iCloud 
You can sync ClaroPDF with your iCloud account. This lets you store and synchronise your PDF files and annotations across multiple devices. Sync with iCloud can also act as a document backup so you can keep your documents safe.
+ Switch Accessibility
OrbitNote responds to switch or Bluetooth keyboard commands:
1 (~1) Start speech
2 (~2) Stop speech
3 (~3) Turn to previous page
4 (~4) Turn to next page
+ Fullscreen mode
Allows the full document to be seen without toolbars in view. Ideal for smaller screens!

bluejetty:00138751:ios.name: Sink It for Reddit
bluejetty:00138751:ios.summary: Sink It for Reddit is a hyper focused Safari extension that makes Reddit's web version usable. Features a ton of quality of life improvements including color coded comments, content muting, adaptive dark mode and more. Tired of seeing too m
bluejetty:00138751:ios.description:
Sink It for Reddit is a hyper focused Safari extension that makes Reddit's web version usable. Features a ton of quality of life improvements including color coded comments, content muting, adaptive dark mode and more. Tired of seeing too many banners and buttons asking you to use the app or login? Sink It silently, and safely, removes all of them as well as the "promotional" content too! 
Make the "Modern" Reddit Experience Usable
-------------------------------------------
Supercharge your Reddit experience with color coded comments, improved comments navigation, adaptive dark mode, content muting, and so much more. 
Sink It also de-clutters and removes most “omfg please use our app” banners and buttons as well as the annoying login popups from Reddit in addition to removing advertisements. Yeah, we loathe them too! 
Privacy First
--------------
Sink It has been built with a privacy first approach. 
- All the blocking happens on your device with literally ZERO data being recorded or sent back to be data mined. 
- We don't keep usage data like the count of how many popups and banners it has blocked or links it has redirected. 
- We don't even come with basic app analytics or telemetry to keep track of how many times you've opened or use the app. 
- It does check whether you have dark mode on or not so it can show you the correct tutorial video. (I hate opening a bright video on dark mode as much as you.)
If you're a security researcher, feel free to poke around to make sure the app isn't up to anything funky.

bluejetty:00138060:ios.description:
Use the JOE & THE JUICE app to order your favorite juice, coffee, sandwich, or smoothie for pick-up or delivery, and earn points on every purchase with our new Loyalty Program.
If you are a new app user, after your first app order, you'll receive a free coffee and enjoy 15% off for 30 days. Exclusion applies. T&Cs apply.
Still not convinced? Here are more good reasons why you are going to love the JOE & THE JUICE app:
PRE-ORDER:
- Skip the line and save time!
- Place an order in the app and it will be ready when you arrive, or choose an exact pick-up time.
- Customize food and drinks to your dietary preferences. Gluten free sandwich? Acai bowl without granola? Protein or collagen in your iced matcha? The app makes it possible.
- Track the progress of your order and receive a notification when it’s ready!
LOYALTY PROGRAM & REWARDS
Our new loyalty program gives you control into the way you get rewarded for your loyalty.
- Earn points with every purchase made in the app or in store using scan to pay excluding purchases made with JOE Cards, Reward Cards and Campaign cards.
- Exchange your points on your favorite juices, coffees and treats.
- Complete fun in-app challenges to boost your points and unlock exclusive rewards.
- Level up through the Loyalty Program. The more you order, the higher your level!
Our Loyalty Program consists of 3 levels:
- GREY: Welcome Reward after your first purchase (excluding counter products, shots and water). Your journey begins here.
- YELLOW: Order 15 items per year and level up to Joe Member status. Earn +10% more points on every purchase.
- PINK: Order 50 items per year and unlock exclusive rewards you won’t find anywhere else. Earn +20% more points, plus even more treats, surprise campaigns and more.
DELIVERY
Need your brewed espresso, tropical smoothie, breakfast bundle, or sandwich delivered straight to your door? Say no more! Use Deliveroo, or order directly through the JOE app so you don’t miss out on any points.
WAIT, THERE’S MORE. USE THE APP TO:
- Find the nearest JOE & THE JUICE location.
- Scan for points when you order food and drinks at the counter.
- Reorder your favorite food and drinks with two taps. That best smoothie on the planet. Or sweet green salad.
- Receive special JOE coffee and juice offers before everyone else.
- View allergens, nutrition, and calories for each food and drink product. Gluten? Vegan? Specialty coffee order? The app has your back with whatever makes you feel good and healthy.
If you have any questions or feedback, you can contact customer service in the app.
For more juice, smoothie, coffee, and fast delivery, find us on Instagram @joeandthejuice or visit www.joejuice.com

bluejetty:00143258:ios.description:
The Emergency WA app is Western Australia’s trusted, official source for fast and accurate information during emergencies – helping you make informed decisions to stay safe. Information on Emergency WA comes directly from emergency responders.
The app provides all the features of the Emergency WA website with the ability to set up customised notifications so you receive the types of alerts that are important to you.
Key Features:
- Set custom watch zones to receive alerts and warnings for specific areas.
- Receive near real-time notifications about emergencies that impact you.
- Create an emergency plan tailored to your needs and receive automatic prompts to activate your plan when linked to a watch zone. 
- Choose which alert types you receive, including fires, storms, floods, burn-offs, Total Fire Bans and Fire Danger Ratings plus many more.
- Experience all features of the app as a Guest or create an Account to receive notifications across multiple devices.
- Listen to live, local emergency radio broadcasts.
- Upload and store critical documents in one place.
- Tailor the app to receive accessible emergency information in multiple formats.
Emergency WA is managed by the Department of Fire and Emergency Services on behalf of the Government of Western Australia.

bluejetty:00114912:ios.description:
At Kotcha, we have an obsession.
Find the best runners on Earth. Study how they train. Break it down. And hand you the playbook to outrun yourself. That's how Eliud Kipchoge & Kilian Jornet's methods ended up in your training plan. 
THE METHOD
1. PERFECT PLANNING TO PEAK ON D-DAY.
Build phase. Intensity phase. Taper. Every week planned around A and B races to peak exactly on the big days.
2. DAILY ADAPTATION TO REAL LIFE.
Paces and workouts update every week based on actual performance, not on rigid templates.
3. STRONGER LEGS. FEWER INJURIES.
The Kotcha Strength & Conditioning is built into the plan. Kipchoge's own drills for an injury-free career.
4. THE SAME FUELING SYSTEM THAT BROKE RECORDS.
Race-day nutrition strategy powered by Maurten, the fuel behind Kipchoge and Kilian. Now built into your plan, down to the gram, every km of the race.
5. CONSISTENCY BEATS INTENSITY.
Getting faster without burning out is the hard part. Your coach tracks both: fitness going up, and power-to-heart-rate holding steady. The metrics used by the champions.
---
ROAD. TRAIL. PERFORM ON EVERY TERRAIN.
5K, 10K, half marathon, marathon, trail — every distance, every terrain. Or just a general plan to become a better runner.
YOUR TEAM
Built with Eliud Kipchoge and Kilian Jornet and their team — coach, personal trainer, nutritionist and data analyst. The minds that shaped the greatest careers in running. Now coaching you.
YOUR GEAR
Apple Watch, Garmin, Coros, Huawei & Strava — we sync with what you already use. No new gear needed.
START FREE
The first 7 days are on us.
Then it's Kotcha Premium — monthly or yearly.
Terms of use: https://kotcha.com/terms-and-conditions
Privacy policy: https://kotcha.com/privacy-policy
APPLE HEALTH USAGE:
Kotcha uses your health data to provide accurate heart rate, distance and pace information during your runs and workouts on Apple Watch.
AGE 18+
You may download and use our App provided you are aged 18 or older. We may delete your account (and associated data) if you are under such age.
