bluejetty:00157770:ios.name: DIME®
bluejetty:00157770:ios.summary:
DIME®’s mission is to create luxurious skincare and beauty products that are clean, effective, and affordable. 
With our new app, customers will experience a seamless end-to-end experience for all things DIME®! Place and track orders, earn
bluejetty:00157770:ios.description:
DIME®’s mission is to create luxurious skincare and beauty products that are clean, effective, and affordable. 
With our new app, customers will experience a seamless end-to-end experience for all things DIME®! Place and track orders, earn and spend rewards points, manage subscriptions, get access to app-only sales and product releases, and stay educated and up to date on all DIME® products and news.
Shop
Browse DIME’s collections of skincare and beauty products. Learn about each product by viewing in-depth educational video content, information about ingredient lists and EWG hazard ratings, and step-by-step guides for individual product uses and multi-step routines.
Exclusive Events & Sales
Our app will feature exclusive sales for app purchases only. The app will host all product limited releases for a chance at early access to test our newest formulas before their official launch! You can also watch out for new products available to app users only. No matter the product or event, the app will always have it first!
Build Custom Bundles and Save
Our app allows you to create any custom bundle to perfectly fit your skin’s unique needs. Love an existing bundle but want a different moisturizer? Just view any bundle and tap “customize” to make it your own. Already know your skincare routine and want to build it from scratch? Use our bundle builder to create your own skincare routine.
Manage Your Subscriptions
Conveniently view all your subscriptions to change your next delivery date, increase or decrease shipment intervals, or skip a delivery. It’s all available in your personal profile, and as always, you can cancel at any time.
Manage Your Orders
Can’t wait to get your order? Track current order status within your profile to know exactly when to expect your product to arrive. Can’t remember which product you ordered last time? Reference your order history to reorder favorites and see which subscription frequency might make sense for your usage habits to score additional savings.
Earn Rewards
Earn rewards points just for downloading the app! Then, with every purchase made, rewards points are automatically added to your account. Keep track of your DIME rewards points on your personal profile, and use them to redeem discounts on purchases.
Chat With Us
Questions about your orders? Curious about what the best product for your skin may be? Reach out to us via live chat directly in the app and talk to one of our skincare experts for guidance and recommendations.
More About DIME®
The DIME Clean™ Promise means that DIME® is committed to providing clean and safe alternatives for traditional skincare and beauty products without sacrificing performance. We protect the integrity of our mission by aiming to use ingredients with low EWG hazard ratings across all products.
We are 100% transparent about every ingredient included in each of our formulas. Our products never contain parabens, sulfates, phthalates, or BPA/BPS.
To ensure every single ingredient in our products is healthy and non-toxic, we utilize an in-depth database from a third-party research group called EWG Skin Deep.
The EWG or Environmental Working Group is an activist group specializing in agricultural subsidies and toxic chemicals research. The group advocates for safer consumer products and transparency. Products and ingredients are rated on a hazard scale from 1-10, one being the safest and ten being the most toxic. We only use the highest quality ingredients in DIME® products with low hazard ratings from the EWG.
With over 1 Million customers, we’re excited to watch the DIME family continue to grow with us and on our new DIME® Beauty App.

bluejetty:00032734:android.description:
Bullet Echo India: Battle Royale is your go-to gun shooting game made for Indian players who love high-intensity online games. 
*What's new in Update 7.8.1*
New Season Noir – New Noir-themed season with 10 seasonal hero skins, including Ramsay and Alter.
Mafia Club Map – New seasonal map introduced.
New Hero: Alter – Sniper with invisibility, decoys, and unique talents.
Profile Enhancements – More player profile customization and improved visuals.
Syndicate Gifts – Send special offer gifts to syndicate members.
UI Improvements – Updated Echo Path and clearer Battle Arena visuals.
Balance Updates – Talent and stat adjustments across multiple heroes.
Team Strategy Meets Pure Action
This isn’t your average run-and-gun shooter. In Bullet Echo India, multiplayer means coordination. Squad up, plan smart, and outplay your enemies. 
Whether you're duo-queuing or joining a full squad, this Indian multiplayer game has the intensity you crave.
Game Modes That Keep You Coming Back
- League mode offers progression and bragging rights
- King of the hill demands quick thinking and tight teamwork
- Solo and squad modes mean you can play your way
- Whether you’re into classic gun games or new-age banduk wale game tactics, there’s something for everyone
Gun. Shoot. Hunt. Repeat.
- Bring your A-game to every match
- Banduk game fans will feel right at home
- Easy to pick up, deep enough to master
Why This Isn’t Just Another Shooter Game
- A standout title in the action game category
- Smooth controls for mobile, designed for fast reactions
- PvP built from the ground up for mobile multiplayer
- Combines the thrill of shooter games with thoughtful strategy
Progress and Upgrade as You Go
- Unlock new heroes, guns, gear, and maps
- Collect perks and complete missions
- Dominate both solo and multiplayer game modes
Built for India
Bullet Echo India is a true Indian game with exclusive content for local players. From skins like Samrat Levithan to maps and hero personalities, the game captures the spirit of India's gaming community. It’s one of the few shooting games where you’ll find authentic references to banduk wala game action and tactical stealth inspired by classic contract killer styles.
Get ready for an online game where skill, speed, and strategy come together. Play Bullet Echo India today and join the next-gen multiplayer gun game revolution.

bluejetty:00130783:ios.description:
View and edit your org mode tasks while on the go.
Org is a wonderfully rich markup language, so **please check** if your favorite feature is supported below (or check https://plainorg.com/#faq):
- Beautifully rendered org markup.
- Filter by keyword, tag, and priority.
- High fidelity org roundtripping.
- Sync your org files using your favorite cloud provider.
- Control your display between regular and compact mode.
- Toggle visibility for scheduling, tags, and stars.
- Toggle recurring tasks.
- Log state transitions.
- Optimize wrapping using paragraph fill.
- Regroup your tasks so active ones bubble up.
- Create new files.
- Outline-style editing with toolbar
 - Keywords
 - Indent
 - Priority
 - Tags
 - Formatting: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, verbatim, and code.
- Open files via the iOS Files app using its "Share" menu.
- Add links from Safari via share extension.
- Add new tasks via Spotlight.
- Reorder headings via drag/drop.
- Checkboxes
 - Interactive toggling.
 - Quickly reset multiple checkboxes.
- Open local links (including id links).
- Render latex src blocks (experimental).
- Render LOGBOOK.
- Show inline images.
- Show property drawers.
- File-local keywords and visibility.
- Filter open/closed tasks.
- Edit raw text.
- Light/dark mode.
- Open either .org or .txt files.
- Quickly switch between open file and recently open (tap on title).
NOTE: Cloud syncing support varies across providers. Please check for compatibility https://plainorg.com/#cloud-providers

bluejetty:00094805:ios.summary:
*NOTICE - TRY BEFORE YOU BUY* - Play the beginning for free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks the full game. No ads.
Ever wish you were a wall-jumping, arrow-dodging, trap-setting horse, besting your animal pals in a race through a peril
bluejetty:00094805:ios.description:
*NOTICE - TRY BEFORE YOU BUY* - Play the beginning for free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks the full game. No ads.
Ever wish you were a wall-jumping, arrow-dodging, trap-setting horse, besting your animal pals in a race through a peril-laden obstacle course that you all built together?
Wish Granted!
Ultimate Chicken Horse is a party platformer where you and your friends build the level as you play, placing deadly traps before trying to reach the end of the level. If you can make it but your friends can't, you score points! Play online or locally with your animal buddies and experiment with a wide variety of platforms in all sorts of strange locations to find new ways to mess with your friends.
Key Features
- Online and local play for up to 4 players
- Unique game flow, from strategic block placement to twitch control platforming
- 17 levels with different features 
- Build and share custom levels
- Additional Controller Support (please note not all controllers are support at this time)
- Compete for global best times on Challenge levels across all platforms
- Shared controller mode to play multiplayer with one controller
- Huge library of blocks to create an infinite variety of levels
- Customizable rule sets and game modes
- Play as a chicken, horse, sheep, raccoon and other wonderful animals
- Fun, cartoony art style
- Sweet funky soundtrack

bluejetty:00073075:ios.description:
Brite Daily Planner: Your Ultimate Companion for a Balanced and Productive Life
Discover the all-in-one solution that helps you tackle your daily tasks, stay organized, and achieve your goals with ease. With Brite Daily Planner, we've combined the essential features all in one user-friendly app, allowing you to focus on what truly matters and replace the need for multiple apps.
Who is Brite Daily Planner for?
Brite Daily Planner is designed for a wide range of users who want to consolidate their organization and productivity tools into one app, including:
* Busy professionals seeking to manage their work tasks and personal life more efficiently
* Students aiming to stay organized with their schoolwork, extracurricular activities, and personal goals
* Freelancers looking to manage their projects, clients, and deadlines effectively
* Parents striving to balance family life, work, and personal growth
* Individuals seeking to improve their emotional well-being and mindfulness through mood and meditation tracking
* Anyone who wants to be more organized, productive, and focused in their daily life, without the distraction of switching between multiple apps
*Key Features of Brite Daily Planner
**Manage your time and schedule:**
Full-featured Calendar - Sync with Google and Apple calendars for a seamless scheduling experience
Daily Planner - Organize and prioritize your day effortlessly
Reminders - do not lose important events.
Countdowns - Create a countdown to track time until important events
**Track and achieve personal and professional goals:**
Task Manager - Keep track of personal and business tasks, complete with reminders and AI tags
Habit Tracker - Build healthy habits and track your progress
Goal Tracker - Set and achieve your goals with a library of pre-built goals to choose from
Projects - Collaborate on projects, with integrated tools like timeline, storage, groups, finances, and chat
**Improve your emotional well-being and mindfulness:**
Mood Journal - Reflect on your emotions, track your mood, and access a library of mind techniques to improve your overall well-being
Meditation Tracker - Monitor your meditation practice and track your progress
Collaborate on projects with others:
**Organize and store your thoughts and ideas:**
Notes - Jot down your thoughts, ideas, and insights, and integrate them with tasks and group chats
Storage - Save, manage, and share your files and ideas with ease
Timeline - Plan, view, and manage your tasks on a day-to-day basis
Brite Daily Planner is available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and the Web, allowing you to manage your productivity from anywhere.
With over 500,000 downloads and 7,000 reviews worldwide, Brite Daily Planner boasts an average rating of 4.8 out of 5 stars. The app supports 30 languages, making it accessible to users around the globe.
By using Brite Daily Planner, you'll no longer need to switch between multiple apps and lose focus. Everything you need for a productive workday and a happier life is right at your fingertips.
Our mission is to create an ideal environment that helps you maximize your personal and professional potential. We understand how work and personal affairs can be intertwined, and we believe that minimizing distractions, like switching between apps, is key to achieving a balanced and productive life.
With Brite Daily Planner, we aim to provide the perfect space for you to grow, develop, and collaborate with like-minded individuals. Start your journey to a more organized and productive life today with Brite Daily Planner.
For any feedback: hello@britetodo.com

Discover the ultimate collection of breathtaking Anime Girl Wallpapers designed for every anime lover! We know every anime fan has a unique taste — that’s why we provide a huge range of wallpapers:
💕 Cute Anime Girls
Sweet, adorable, blushing characters with big sparkling eyes, pastel outfits, cat ears, soft lighting, and warm expressions.
❄️ Cool / Badass Anime Girls
Strong female characters with swords, magical powers, glowing eyes, cyberpunk vibes, or dramatic battle scenes.
🎓 School Girl (Gyaru, Seifuku, Idol)
Traditional Japanese school uniforms, idol performers, classroom aesthetics, lively poses, and youthful charm.
🌸 Aesthetic & Pastel Anime Girls
Pink, lavender, sky-blue tones, soft filters, dreamy atmospheres, and light sparkles perfect for aesthetic lovers.
🌙 Fantasy & Magic Girls
Mystical mages, witches, spirits, celestial goddesses, elemental warriors, wings, glowing effects, and enchanted worlds.
🐾 Neko Girls / Kemonomimi
Cat girls, fox girls, wolf girls, bunny girls — cute hybrid characters with animal ears and playful expressions.
⚔️ Samurai & Ninja Anime Girls
Traditional Japanese clothing, katanas, action poses, ancient villages, cherry blossoms, and heroic warriors.
🌓 Dark / Gothic Anime Girls
Black dresses, red eyes, gothic accessories, horror elements, stylish vampire characters, and dramatic lighting.
🔥 Anime Girls with Weapons
Guns, swords, scythes, bows, futuristic weapons, sci-fi armor, and action-packed scenery.
🌈 Chibi Anime Girls
Tiny, cute chibi-style drawings perfect for fans who love adorable miniature characters.
🐉 Fantasy Beasts & Companions
Dragon riders, magical pets, mythical creatures, and surreal fantasy backgrounds.
🌌 Sci-Fi / Cyberpunk Anime Girls
Neon cityscapes, holograms, futuristic outfits, robots, and glowing cybernetic details.
🏖️ Summer / Swimsuit Anime Girls
Beach scenes, summer vacation vibes, bright sunny backgrounds, and fun seasonal aesthetics.
❄️ Winter / Christmas Anime Girls
Snow scenes, winter outfits, cozy scarves, festive lights, and holiday-themed illustrations.
😈 Demon Girls / Angel Girls
Wings, halos, horns, magical aura effects, celestial battles, and divine or dark beauty.
🌿 Nature & Floral Anime Girls
Flowers, forests, butterflies, natural backgrounds, and peaceful outdoor designs.
🎮 Gamer & Tech Anime Girls
Headphones, gaming gear, neon lights, digital effects, and energetic poses.
★ Features:
Our simple & user-friendly interface offers following features...
Newest > This is where you see latest updated wallpapers
Random > Wallpapers randomly shown from whole collection with hourly updates.
Download high quality wallpapers for free
Save your favorite wallpapers and access them through "Favorites"
Share/Send wallpapers through various apps like Whatsapp, Mail, Skype and much more..
Set wallpaper as home, lock screen and both
• 100% Free
• Beautiful user interface
• Super-fast & lightweight app
• High-quality wallpaper
• All backgrounds are available in "Portrait" mode only for perfect fit
• Support caching so you can see the photo already loaded without Internet
Stay glued and we bet you will be amazed 😍
We are thankful for all of your support and always welcome your feedback and suggestions

bluejetty:00089350:ios.description:
Make a parallel space on the phone so you can run multiple instances of the same app at once.
The new app Dual Space Multiple Accounts is released. It offers capabilities that allow for several app clones of one. Unlimited accounts can be maintained, and they can all be online at once.
On your phone, did you frequently have to move between various social accounts?
Have you ever kept your accounts online on two or more phones in case you missed a WhatsApp message?
Dual Space Multiple Accounts has now been released! Your issue can be properly resolved by it! You can effortlessly log into many accounts on one phone and keep them all online at once!
Also, you won't have to worry about issues with multiple accounts' message delivery or data storage because they will all function separately and without interfering with one another.
Main Features:
- Maintain several social media accounts logged in at once.
- You can effectively balance your personal and professional lives if you keep both online at the same time.
- The Parallel Space - Dual Account feature is supported by nearly all social media apps.
- Data from various accounts won't conflict with one another.
- Split Browser.
- Direct Chat for WhatsApp.
- Private Note.
- Privacy Browser and Accounts.

bluejetty:00100493:ios.description:
READING IS SUPER FUN WITH SUPERFONIK! 
Who says learning to read has to be a chore? Meet Superfonik – the trash-zapping, soda-slurping, space-surfing app that makes reading feel like recess! Perfect for even the most reluctant readers, kids advance through tons of hilarious games that make reading practice ridiculously fun. 
**Superfonik is part of Piknik – a bundle of the world’s best apps for kids in one subscription. Unlock fan-favorites from Sago Mini, Toca Boca, and Originator with an Unlimited Plan!**
FUN READING GAMES FOR KIDS: Kids build vocabulary with 800+ words, practice phonics, and learn to read sentences in games like Chicken Pickin’, Tongue Zapper, Baby Burglar, and more! 
PLAY ON THE GO WITHOUT WIFI: Safe and 100% ad-free, kids can learn to read anytime, anywhere – without WiFi or data. 
DESIGNED FOR RELUCTANT READERS: Perfect for beginners or any kid who needs support or motivation to read. Skip the struggle and read like a pro! 
COMICS MEET PHONICS: With the touchable, tappable, sounder-outer tool, kids build the skills they need to read confidently in interactive comics and reading games for kids. 
DESIGNED WITH EXPERTS: Informed by the Joan Ganz Cooney Center's evidence-based research on kids’ learning and development, and literacy experts at Hoot Reading. 
MOTIVATING & REWARDING: Earn coins for perfecting new words, unlock tons of outrageous surprises, and build confidence with every play.
ADAPTIVE LEARNING: With activities that adjust to individual reading levels, kids stay challenged and engaged for best results. 
FEATURES
• Learn over 800 words in 25+ kid-approved games
• Kids learn new words, practice phonics, and build vocabulary with the sounder-outer tool
• Effective in improving early reading & phonics skills with UFLI’s research-backed methods 
• Play downloaded games offline without WiFi & learn on the go 
• Use one subscription across multiple devices for easy family sharing
• Members get early access to new games and releases
• Perfect for beginners, reluctant readers, and any kid learning to read 
• COPPA and kidSAFE-certified
• No ads or in-app purchases for subscribers
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Try before you buy! Download to start your free trial, no strings attached. 
• When you confirm your purchase, payment will be charged through your Apple ID account.
• Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Don’t want to auto-renew? Manage your account and renewal settings in your user Account Settings.
• You can use your subscription on any device registered with your Apple ID. Like all Apple subscriptions, Superfonik can’t use family sharing to share subscriptions across different Apple IDs.
• Cancel your subscription anytime through your Account Settings, with no cancellation fees.
• Questions? Need a hand? Give us a shout at support@playpiknik.com.
Privacy Policy
Sago Mini is committed to protecting your privacy and the privacy of your children. We adhere to the strict guidelines set forth by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) & kidSAFE, which ensure the protection of your child’s information online. 
Privacy policy: https://playpiknik.link/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://playpiknik.link/terms-of-use
About Sago Mini
Sago Mini is an award-winning company devoted to play. We make apps, games and toys for preschoolers worldwide. Toys that seed imagination and grow wonder. We bring thoughtful design to life. For kids. For parents. For giggles.
Find us on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok at @sagomini.

bluejetty:00126213:ios.summary:

This is a free application designed to create labels for telecom, datacom and/or electrical identifications on demand. It enables you to easily print labels from yo
bluejetty:00126213:ios.description:
[Description]
Pro Label Tool is the successor to Mobile Cable Label Tool.
This is a free application designed to create labels for telecom, datacom and/or electrical identifications on demand. It enables you to easily print labels from your smartphone/tablet to a Brother label printer using a local wireless network. 
[Key Features]
1. Automatic loading of pre-designed label templates from Brother's cloud server to keep them up to date.
2. Easy to use - just a few taps to choose, edit and print professional quality labels.
3. No computer or printer driver required.
4. Powerful Print Preview
5. Enables you to work more efficiently by creating label designs with P-touch Editor at the office, then send them via email to others to print at the working site.
6. Connectable to CSV database
7. Serialize function frees you from duplicate typing when printing sequential labels with similar content on rows of ID labels.
8. Use the Custom Form function to create labels with standardised network address information. 
[Compatible machines]
PT-P750W, PT-P900W, PT-P950NW, PT-D800W, PT-E850TKW, PT-E310BT, PT-E560BT, PT-E720BT, PT-E920BT
To help us improve the application, send your feedback to Feedback-mobile-apps-lm@brother.com. Please note that we may not be able to respond to individual emails.

Atlas uses AI to help you study with anything you upload. Turn websites, PDFs, videos, PowerPoint slides, Word documents, audio recordings, and much more into notes, flashcards, quizzes, study guides, and essays.
- Chat with your uploads to extract insights and get deeper explanations
- Create notes from your uploads for concise summaries
- Create flashcards from your uploads for bite-sized studying
- Create quizzes from your uploads to test your knowledge
- Create essays that cite your uploads

- Everything is synced across the app and website
- Work with as many uploads as you want at once (other apps only allow you to work with one upload at a time)

bluejetty:00092621:ios.description:
This vibrant game transforms you into a screw master, ready to take on a variety of thrilling puzzle challenges that will truly put your skills to the test. Get set for an exhilarating experience filled with colorful screws, pins, and nuts, where every twist of your tool opens the door to new adventures! As you solve each puzzle, you’ll unlock a sense of accomplishment and satisfaction that will keep the fun flowing and your mind engaged.
With hundreds of unique levels waiting for you, each stage is meticulously designed to challenge your logic and strategy. You’ll find yourself navigating through increasingly complex scenarios that demand quick thinking and clever planning. The satisfaction of overcoming each level will not only sharpen your skills but also enhance your confidence as you tackle even more difficult challenges. bluejetty:00096121:ios.name: Color Cube Match: Sort Puzzle
bluejetty:00096121:ios.summary:
Color Cube Match—a calm cube-sorting game with a clever twist.
Take a break and dive into a vibrant flow of colors, crates, and smart moves. This puzzle sort game helps you unwind while your brain stays pleasantly engaged. Play at your own
bluejetty:00096121:ios.description:
Color Cube Match—a calm cube-sorting game with a clever twist.
Take a break and dive into a vibrant flow of colors, crates, and smart moves. This puzzle sort game helps you unwind while your brain stays pleasantly engaged. Play at your own pace—perfect for fans of sorting games with no timer who love precise cube sorting.
Clear the Field, One Crate at a Time
Tap to pick up color cubes and place them on the conveyor. Watch them travel into matching crates and fill the slots. When a crate is full, it disappears—freeing space and revealing what's beneath. But mind the flow: conveyor slots are limited, so plan ahead to avoid jams in this thoughtful cube game and satisfying puzzle sort game.
Puzzle with a Twist
Your journey to sort cubes is filled with unique twists that make this puzzle sort game stand out:
- Mystery Boxes: Colors are hidden until revealed—adapt on the fly.
- Multicolor Crates: Need several block types—get the sequence right for a perfect clear.
- Crate Lock: Some crates open only after you clear others—rethink your route and keep the conveyor moving.
- Sealed Cube: One cube is hidden. Reveal it at the right moment to avoid jams.
- Shape Sort: Not only cubes—some crates need different object shapes. Slots show silhouettes; pieces auto-fill when color and shape match.
Power-Ups & Smart Tools
- Box Out: Instantly fill and remove any chosen crate to clear space fast.
- Hold Box: Move extra cubes off the conveyor into neutral storage when things get tight—then release them at the perfect moment to sort cubes efficiently.
Simple to Play, Satisfying to Master
One-tap controls, short levels, and pure logic—no twitchy moves needed. Enjoy a relaxed sort challenge or push yourself with trickier stacks and shapes. Designed for players who prefer no-timer color-sorting games and a fair, strategic challenge that rewards planning.
Why You'll Love It
- Unique conveyor flow you won't find in another cube game.
- Clean rules, low randomness—your plan wins.
- Great fit for breaks or longer puzzle streaks.
- Works offline—play anytime, anywhere.
- For fans of color-match and puzzle sort game design and those who like to sort cubes for tactile satisfaction.
Ready to match color cubes, fill crates, and clear the board? Jump into this fresh conveyor puzzle sort game—your next relaxing sort challenge awaits!

bluejetty:00133204:ios.summary:
嗨，我叫Moo，一只长耳朵兔子，一款记录心情和故事的日记App。
复杂世界，有太多东西试图吸引你的注意力，夺走你的时间。或许你有很多秘密、压力、烦恼和坚持没有地方可以倾诉，在这里写下你的感悟、生活、心情、故事和美梦，Moo会替你守护秘密。如果你有一些想分享的瞬间，治愈包容的兔窝等你光临。在这里，放慢你的脚步，感受此刻的治愈时光吧。
【记录每日心情】
用图片、语音、文字描绘今天的故事吧。文字排版简单够用，位置标记，时刻记录。你的心事，是Moo和你一同守护的秘密。
【对话式引导
bluejetty:00133204:ios.description:
嗨，我叫Moo，一只长耳朵兔子，一款记录心情和故事的日记App。

【记录每日心情】
用图片、语音、文字描绘今天的故事吧。文字排版简单够用，位置标记，时刻记录。你的心事，是Moo和你一同守护的秘密。
【对话式引导 轻松写日记】
天气、心情、活动标签，轻松标记你的每一天。解决写日记难以坚持，复杂心事不知如何表达的问题。

每天坚持记录，你会看到按周/月绘制的心情温度曲线。随着时间的变化，曲线是如何发生变化的呢?这很有趣，对吧。
【兔窝社区 真实暖心】
如果你也有一些想分享的瞬间，欢迎你到兔窝做客。你可以与他人互动，友好交流；也可以做一个观光客，感受各不相同的人生百态。人类的悲欢无法相通，但每种情绪都值得善待，所以，我们有了兔窝。
【简约但不简单】
简洁优雅的风格，极简的卡片式排布清爽不油腻；日历与时间轴可快速翻找日记。超多精美插画，为你的心情量身定制。
【想努力给你更好的】
如果你喜欢，就请解锁专业版模式吧。超大图片空间，应用加密，定时提醒，一键云同步，给你更多惊喜。这就是我，小小的，白白的，软软的长耳朵兔子。你的心情Moo来听，你的秘密Moo守口如瓶。新的旅程已经开始，那么现在，就让Moo陪你踏上全新的旅程吧！

我们在不影响正常使用的前提下，增加了一些扩展延续，这部分扩展功能需要通过解锁才能正常使用。moo日记专业版提供更丰富的图表及其它功能。moo日记包含自动订阅的形式解锁专业版，提供按季或者按年订阅，价格为 ¥15/季、 ¥43/年，价格可能会因为地理位置的不同而不同。确认购买时会从您的 Apple ID 帐户扣款。下个订阅期会自动进行扣款，系统会在当前订阅期结束前 24 小时内，从您的帐户扣除续订费用。除非您在当前订阅期结束前至少 24 小时取消订阅，否则订阅会自动续订。完成购买后，您可以前往 App Store 的帐户设置来管理和取消您的订阅。感谢用户的支持，之前已分享解锁的用户现在转为“永久版”。

用户服务协议：https://nact.aiyo-aiyo.com/moo_agreement

被大家喜欢，实在是诚惶诚恐，诚惶诚恐。Moo日记仅是来自几个小透明的小制作，第一次做这样的事，还需要很多的提升空间，我们将持续优化，请期待后续版本更新喔。如有问题或建议，欢迎联系我们。微博：@Moo日记QQ群：639708138；748917715

bluejetty:00146147:ios.description:
Ninja Jump is a free simple endless-runner style game. Climb a tower by jumping between walls and collecting power ups along the way.
Ninja Jump is a very simple game where you will have to take your charismatic ninja run dash character to the highest building rooftops. while other ninjas dash run try to stop you.
Use Your Ninja Skills
Ninjas are not only masters of stealth and movement. They are also superb tricksters, dash masters, assassins and run dash combatants. By collecting the right reagents or performing the right stunts, you can perform an array of impressive feats that can only be described as superhuman. Use these to conquer everything in your way and rise to the top!
How to play
The Ninja Jump gameplay is simple and addictive ninja skills, comprising of a single action dash. Jump between walls using a sword slash, cutting down enemies and collecting items as you go.
your character will start by automatically climbing one side of the building and every time you touch the screen it will jump to another side by kicking the air. This way, you will have to go dodging the different obstacles that come up on every wall and blocking your enemies attacks.
- Run between two walls rooftop with ninja skills. Tap the screen to leap from one to the next without missing a beat in your step.
- Avoid deadly hazards like birds, squirrels, balconies and ninja throwing stars!
- Put enemies out of your misery by slicing them up in midair with your ninja.
- Run endlessly upward! The fun never stops and the action never slows down.
- Don’t hit anything on the wall, or else your career as a ninja will come to an abrupt end.
- Grab the magical shield to avoid taking damage.
- Slice up enough squirrels to assume the power of the squirrel! Grow a fluffy tail and dash up the side of the building at a breakneck speed.
- Dice up those angry little birds to sprout wings and fly upward between the buildings.
- Cut up the shuriken thrown at you by enemy ninja to execute a powerful spinning attack with your blade, destroying everything you come in contact with.
GAME FEATURES
Epic ninja adventure game
● Amazing power-up boosts on rooftop!
● Ninjas, throwing stars & bombs
● Various enemies & obstacles
● Intuitive tap controls
● Endless ninja fun

listings.description:
Ninja Jump is a free simple endless-runner style game. Climb a tower by jumping between walls and collecting power ups along the way.
Ninja Jump is a very simple game where you will have to take your charismatic ninja run dash character to the highest building rooftops. while other ninjas dash run try to stop you.


Use Your Ninja Skills
Ninjas are not only masters of stealth and movement. They are also superb tricksters, dash masters, assassins and run dash combatants. By collecting the right reagents or performing the right stunts, you can perform an array of impressive feats that can only be described as superhuman. Use these to conquer everything in your way and rise to the top!


How to play
The Ninja Jump gameplay is simple and addictive ninja skills, comprising of a single action dash. Jump between walls using a sword slash, cutting down enemies and collecting items as you go.
your character will start by automatically climbing one side of the building and every time you touch the screen it will jump to another side by kicking the air. This way, you will have to go dodging the different obstacles that come up on every wall and blocking your enemies attacks.

- Run between two walls rooftop with ninja skills. Tap the screen to leap from one to the next without missing a beat in your step.
- Avoid deadly hazards like birds, squirrels, balconies and ninja throwing stars!
- Put enemies out of your misery by slicing them up in midair with your ninja.
- Run endlessly upward! The fun never stops and the action never slows down.
- Don’t hit anything on the wall, or else your career as a ninja will come to an abrupt end.
- Grab the magical shield to avoid taking damage.
- Slice up enough squirrels to assume the power of the squirrel! Grow a fluffy tail and dash up the side of the building at a breakneck speed.
- Dice up those angry little birds to sprout wings and fly upward between the buildings.
- Cut up the shuriken thrown at you by enemy ninja to execute a powerful spinning attack with your blade, destroying everything you come in contact with.


GAME FEATURES
Epic ninja adventure game
● Amazing power-up boosts on rooftop!
● Ninjas, throwing stars & bombs
● Various enemies & obstacles
● Intuitive tap controls
● Endless ninja fun

The Good Lood App is much more than a mere loyalty application. It’s an actual loodspot in your smartphone!
Download it today, register and start using all its features!

• YOUR POINTS - you get points for ice cream, loodboxes, Good Noot spreads, choosing the 'to the building entrance' delivery option and returning empty Good Noot jars. • REWARDS - dreaming of a Good Lood deckchair on your own balcony? Feeling peckish for a jar of Pistachio? Register to the app and collect points for ice cream to get a deckchair, Good Noot spreads and many other fantastic rewards we have prepared for you.
• LOODSPOT MAP - easily accessible and clear maps of Kraków and Warsaw with locations and opening hours of all loodspots. You can check the nearest loodspot in no time!
Life is good with Good Lood!

bluejetty:00131211:ios.summary:
Introducing Bloom, the investing app that TEACHES you how to invest!
Whether you’re a young adult striving for financial freedom or a teen looking to get a head start on your financial journey, Bloom is your destination to learn, earn, and
bluejetty:00131211:ios.description:
Introducing Bloom, the investing app that TEACHES you how to invest!
Whether you’re a young adult striving for financial freedom or a teen looking to get a head start on your financial journey, Bloom is your destination to learn, earn, and invest to grow your wealth and knowledge. Join our community of 2 MILLION+ Bloomers learning & investing on Bloom, and take control of your financial future today.
LEARN
- 10,000+ bite-sized, interactive financial lessons on critical topics like investing, stocks, credit & more!
- Start out with “investing basics”, then build your knowledge through more advanced lessons on concepts like diversification, dollar cost averaging, fundamental analysis, financial metrics and more!
- Learn how to evaluate stocks, read financial numbers, construct your portfolio & build long-term wealth
- Test your knowledge with quick quizzes and earn stock rewards
- With new lessons released every week, you’ll always be able to learn something new!
INVEST
- Open a real investing account in just a few minutes so you invest in 5,000+ stocks / ETFs and start building your wealth!
- $0 commissions when you trade stocks and ETFs on Bloom!
- Automatically copy the investments of top politicians and billionaires with Auto-Portfolios!
- Fractional shares - start investing with as little as $1!
- Set up investing strategies with conditional and recurring orders
- Easy, instant deposits from bank accounts & debit cards + no-fee withdrawals so you can get your money when you need it
- Set price alerts on your favorite stocks to track their price movement
- Your account is SIPC insured up to $500,000 and protected by bank-grade encryption & authentication
- Teens 13 - 17 can start investing on Bloom with parental approval through our UTMA/UTGMA custodial accounts
EARN
- Complete your first lesson & earn up to $75 in free stocks!
- Earn “Oinks” for completing financial lessons & quizzes
- Compete in mock investing tournaments against other Bloomers to earn REAL cash prizes!
- Exchange Oinks for real stock rewards!
- Play games like “Guess the Stock”, “Card Game”, and the “Mystery Wheel” to earn Oinks
- Complete “Quests” like buying your first stock, sharing Bloom with friends & more to earn even more Oinks!
- Guess which stock will perform better each day with "Bulls vs Bears" and earn Oinks!
——
FOR PARENTS OF TEENS
Investing is the most effective way to build long-term wealth, but most teens don’t learn about investing or finance in school. Bloom teaches your child about these important concepts with 300+ interactive, world-class financial lessons + a real investing account with industry-leading parental controls.
- Bloom allows you to open a UTMA/UGMA custodial brokerage account for your child in just a few minutes! Plus, our custodial accounts automatically transfer to your teen when they turn 18 - 25, depending on your state of residence.
With parental controls & options, you can be as involved in your teen’s financial journey as you’d like
- Approve your teen's stock trades through the Bloom app, or turn on automatic approvals
- View your teen's progress on their financial lessons
- Control which assets your teen can buy and sell
- Monitor your teen's investments & returns
- Don’t want your teen investing yet? No problem — start them out with the lessons, and open a brokerage account whenever you feel comfortable!
Flexible, safe funding options
- Add funds to your teen's investing account with a bank account or debit card with as little as $1 — or allow them to fund their own account
- Set up an allowance directly on Bloom to make recurring deposits to your child’s investing account
- Withdraw funds from your child’s account at any time
- Your account is SIPC insured up to $500,000 and protected by bank-grade encryption & authentication
- Have more than one teen? We’ve got you covered — add up to 5 teens to your account with no additional cost!

bluejetty:00016128:ios.description:
Canasta card game by LITE Games: play the popular game Canasta now for free on your smartphone or tablet.
Canasta is a true classic as it was once one of the most frequently played card games. It is still widely played and enjoyed today as it is easy to learn and can be discovered again and again in many different variations. 
The new overhauled version of the famous Canasta app by LITE Games combines intuitive gameplay, pleasing design and advanced customization options to deliver endless fun in this wonderful card game.
When playing offline against the computer, you can alter a large variety of rules and adjust the strength of your opponents and partners to suit your needs. These flexible settings make it easy to relax, to learn the game or to face a challenging opponent when you’re on the go. 
For the most exciting experience you can play online against players from all over the world and climb the leaderboards or challenge your friends and family.
Features:
- Play offline and online
- Single- and multiplayer mode 
- Customize rules and design 
- Global leaderboards
- High quality design and animation
- Adjustable difficulty for opponents and partners
- Many exciting achievements
The app is available in high-quality localizations for the following languages: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish & Turkish
Canasta is perfect for everyone who loves to play card and puzzle games. If you enjoy Rummy or Bridge, you'll love it. 
Canasta is an advertiser funded app, i.e. ads are presented within the app. If you prefer to use the app without ads we do offer a "no ads" setting as auto-renewable subscription. You have the choice between the following options:
- 1 month for $0.99 or equivalent (subscription renews after 1 month)
- 3 months for $1.99 or equivalent (subscription renews after 3 months)
- 12 months for $4.49 or equivalent (subscription renews after 1 year)
The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.

You can find our general terms and conditions here: 
https://tc.lite.games
...and our privacy policy here: 
https://privacy.lite.games
With our app, we try to reproduce Canasta as comprehensively and realistically as possible on mobile devices. The app is not aimed at children, but is designed for adults. There is no money and no prizes to be won in our app. Gaming practice and / or success in casino games without a win ("social casino games") does not necessarily mean that the participant concerned will also be successful in future games for real money.
_________
General Data Protection Regulation

Challenge your friend with this collection of 2 playe
bluejetty:00125931:ios.description:
If you want to play with your friend on the same device, this is the right game!
But also if you have no friends to have fun in multiplayer on one device, just play alone against the AI!
Challenge your friend with this collection of 2 player games and enjoy the beautiful graphics of the minigames!
Choose between one of the 2 player games ( and remember that you can also play alone against the AI if you have no possibility to multiplayer):
Ping Pong :
Move the racket with your finger and challenge your friends!
Spinner war :
Push your opponent outside the stage! Two players on a small area are too much!
Air hockey :
Use your finger to move the paddle and score letting the puck entering in your friend's goal!
Snakes :
Don't touch your opponent's body and stay alive!
Pool :
The classic pool game for 2 player on one device!
Tic tac toe :
Instead of using pen and paper just open the app and challenge your friend on the same device! A two player classic!
Penalty kicks :
Let the goalkeeper dive and kick the soccer ball to make goal! 
Sumo :
The multiplayer version of a famous Japanese sport!
And much more! (Like minigolf, racing cars, sword duels, chess...)
This collection of 2 player games features beautiful minimal graphics to keep your focused on the duel with your opponent and it saves scores between matches, this way you can dispute a 2 player cup and let the challenge go on between minigames!
Unleash the power of local multiplayer on one device / one phone / one tablet, and bring the fun to the party!
Disclaimer: this multiplayer game can ruin friendships!

bluejetty:00152729:ios.description:
Tired of letting adult content and lust control your life? You're not alone in this fight. Maybe you're bored, can't sleep, or stressed — first comes the urge, then the relapse, and then the guilt, shame, and emptiness. The more it repeats, the stronger the habit becomes. Lust feeds on this cycle of instant gratification, secrecy and regret. Gracen equips you with daily tools to fight temptation, break the pattern, and take back control of your life.
Gracen is the flagship Christian app to quit adult content and lust. Built on daily discipline and strengthened by faith, it creates a custom plan tailored to your journey — giving you the exact tools you need, right when you need them most.
TOOLS FOR THE MOMENTS THAT MATTER
Gracen is designed for the real battles — the moments when urges feel overwhelming. Every feature is built to give you instant support and practical strategies:
• Daily pledge – commit each morning to living lust-free
• Chat with Gracen – receive personalized advice from your AI companion
• Content blocker – automatically block all adult websites
• Breathing exercises – calm your body and reset your focus
• Emergency prayer – pray to God when lust feels strongest
• Distraction exercises – shift your mind away from temptation
• Panic button – quick help when you're close to relapse
• Daily verses – scripture for encouragement and truth
• Daily prayers – guided prayers to strengthen your spirit
MILESTONES THAT KEEP YOU MOTIVATED
Recovery isn't instant — it's built step by step. Gracen helps you measure progress with clear milestones, so you can see how far you've come and stay motivated to keep going. From your very first adult content-free day to longer streaks, each milestone is a victory over lust and sin.
A CHRISTIAN APPROACH
Gracen doesn't just focus on willpower. It's built on the belief that lasting freedom from adult content and lust requires more than self-control — it requires Jesus. That's why Gracen combines practical anti-lust tools with faith-based guidance, so you never fight sin and temptation alone.
WHY GRACEN?
Other apps offer streaks or statistics. Gracen goes deeper. With its custom plan, it adapts to your journey — helping you quit adult content with faith, resist lust with scripture, and replace temptation with prayer.
BUILT FOR YOUR PRIVACY
Your journey is yours. Gracen is designed with privacy in mind, giving you the freedom to be honest without fear of judgment.
DISCLAIMER
A paid subscription is required to use Gracen. Gracen provides tools and encouragement to support your journey, but it is not a substitute for professional medical advice. If you need medical help, please consult a qualified healthcare provider.
SUPPORT
For feedback, questions, or support, contact us at:
support@gracen.app

Privacy Policy: https://legal.gracen.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00060986:ios.summary: Cattle Market Mobile is an app designed to help cattle producers monitor market data across the United States. This app displays reports produced by the USDA's Agricultural Marketing Service and reports composed by local livestock markets.
bluejetty:00060986:ios.description:
Cattle Market Mobile is an app designed to help cattle producers monitor market data across the United States. This app displays reports produced by the USDA's Agricultural Marketing Service and reports composed by local livestock markets. In addition to market reports, users can also view commodity futures pricing and use other tools, such as a Profit/Loss Calculator, LRP Calculator, and Slide Calculator.
SALE PREVIEWS
See what's coming to the ring before sale day. Participating livestock markets post their consignments ahead of each sale, with photos, video, head count, weights and other details for each lot.
• Browse upcoming lots from participating markets
• Save the lots you're watching, no account needed
• Contact the market about a lot
• Share a lot or a whole sale as a link, picture or PDF
• See which lots sold, when the market shares results
Market staff can post Sale Previews from their phone, with photos and video of each lot, and report results after the sale. Markets interested in posting can request access in the app.

bluejetty:00186919:ios.description:
Transform Your Music Journey with Anytune™! Discover a new way to learn, practice, and teach music with Anytune™ – the ultimate music practice app. Learn faster, transcribe easier, and play along at your pace to make practice more fun. A complete suite of tools to practice better.
For over a decade, Anytune has been changing the lives of musical artists worldwide. With tons of user-requested features, Anytune gives you unparalleled power over your practice sessions, making it easier than ever to learn new songs, perfect challenging pieces, and enhance your musical skills.
Anytune is perfect for singers, dancers, and musicians of all kinds. Adjust the tempo, choose the perfect pitch, repeat loops, and set marks to master every note.
HEAR IT FROM MUSICIANS
 • “Anytune takes you right to the music, it is a game changer … moves everything out of your way … makes you a much better musician.” - Peter Martin
 • “Anytune is my priceless personal trainer, helping me practice parts, songs, or an entire setlist. It organizes my playlists, slows down tricky sections while remembering detune settings, and with LiveMix I can learn Anything, Anytime, Anywhere.” - Phil Soussan
***** “Great App - Anytune Pro is the most-used app on my iPad. It’s the best thing for learning tunes that would be too fast or too out of tune to learn easily. Saves me a lot of time. I love it!”
***** “The Best!!! - Worth absolutely every penny. Other similar apps don’t come close to the quality of this one! It will slow things down to a crawl without a loss of quality. Looping and pitch adjusting at the touch of a finger. If you’re looking for better you won’t find it!”
GET STARTED FOR FREE
Download Anytune today and discover why it’s a game-changer for musicians worldwide. The free version is fully functional with options for advanced Pro+ features.
FEATURES
Discover what makes Anytune the top-rated music practice app:
 • Practice at your pace by easily adjusting tempo without affecting pitch, with amazing HQ audio quality down to 0.05x
 • Adjust the pitch (± 24.0 semitones) of your music to your instrument or transcribe directly into a different key
 • Use marks and loops to break down the song and use advanced looping for focused, efficient practice
 • Visualize your song to find the part you want quickly and easily
 • Organize tracks into playlists for efficient practice sessions with Shuffle
 • Import your music from the Files app, Dropbox, WiFi, Paste from AudioCopy, and Open-In
 • Record and analyze your performance to correct mistakes before they become habits
 • Play songs directly from your Apple Music Library, import audio files, and extract audio from video files
 • Display lyrics or textual TABs that scroll to your music
 • Audible and Visual Count-In
 • Step-it-Up Loop Interval Trainer
 • Transcribe Mode to easily work through a song
 • ReFrame™ Audio Isolation to solo and mute vocals or instruments
 • Pinpoint your instrument in the song with FineTouch™ EQ
 • Feel as though you’re playing in the band with LiveMix™
 • Queue up a mark for playback with Play Next
 • Fade-In or Fade-Out music when playing or pausing
 • Gain and Pan Control
 • Custom Skins to customize the look
Need a little more? Additional EXPORT AND REMOTE CONTROL & WATCH APP Add-ons are available.
Anytune cannot play DRM-protected songs, including songs through subscription services like Apple Music.
CONNECT WITH US
See us on YouTube: AnytuneApp
Like us on Facebook: /Anytune
Follow us on X (formerly Twitter) or Instagram: @AnytuneApp
Contact us with your questions and suggestions!
Anytune is a Universal App. Buy it once for all your iOS devices.
Anytune (Mac) is available separately from the Mac App Store.

bluejetty:00084762:ios.description:
Dr Lal PathLabs – Enabling Healthier Lives
India’s leading diagnostic player with 75+ years of experience, we bring medical expertise and proficiency in the field of diagnostics. We have established a vast network of 15000+ touch points, including patient service centers and hospitals. Whether you need a routine blood test, comprehensive health checkup, or specialized pathology services, our app makes booking tests easy, fast, and reliable.
Dr Lal PathLabs offers a comprehensive diagnostic experience with a test menu of 5000+ options, covering everything from blood and urine tests to specialized screenings for diabetes, thyroid, liver, heart conditions, and cancer markers. Each sample goes through more than 50 quality checks to ensure the highest level of accuracy. Our team of highly skilled professionals ensures the highest standard of quality and precision in every test we conduct. This makes Dr Lal PathLabs the biggest diagnostic laboratories network in India.
About Dr Lal PathLabs Mobile App
We bring to you the ease of diagnostic services through our app. You can book any blood or urine test, or full body checkups suggested by doctors at your convenience through Dr Lal PathLabs app. 
 Some common blood tests include: 
 1. Diabetes test 
 2. Thyroid test
 3. CBC
 4. Vitamin D
 5. Allergy test 
Some common urine tests include:
 1. Creatinine Test
 2. Uric Acid Test
 3. Urea Test
 4. C-Peptide Test
 5. Pregnancy Test
Dr Lal PathLabs also provide advance tests, such as:
 1. Dual Marker Test
 2. PAPPA Test
 3. Quadruple Marker Test
 4. Non-invasive Prenatal Testing (NIPT) 
 5. Karyotyping
 6. Antiphospholipid Antibody (APLA) Panel
 7. Bad Obstetric History (BOH) Panel
 8. Cancer Markers (commonly called as Cancer Tests, they help in cancer screening.)
Timely Reports 
Dr Lal PathLabs focuses on bringing quality diagnosis services by providing accurate and timely test results to our valued customers. Our well-defined processes, trained staff and NABL and CAP accreditation ensure that we are able to reduce the error margin, which means that we are able to give accurate reports on time. 
Dr Lal PathLabs App Features
 1. Create a profile of you and your family for easy test bookings. 
 2. Easy navigation to complete information about Routine Medical Tests.
 3 Book a blood test or full body health checkup at home or lab, at you your convenience.
 4. Locate a nearby centre for your convenience.
 5. Track your phlebotomists.
 6. Access and download blood test reports online.
 7. Access current as well as past reports with DLPL at one place.
 8.Access reports of family members with a simple swipe.
Regular lab tests at Dr Lal PathLabs Pathology Test App for precise Healthcare Solutions:

Full Body Health checkup Packages at Dr Lal PathLabs App:

bluejetty:00031003:ios.summary:
Weather radar in your pocket! Use RadarNow!® to quickly see an animated radar image and current conditions! No digging through menus to see if a storm is on the way!
RadarNow!® provides National Weather Service (NWS) radar images from the
bluejetty:00031003:ios.description:
Weather radar in your pocket! Use RadarNow!® to quickly see an animated radar image and current conditions! No digging through menus to see if a storm is on the way!
RadarNow!® provides National Weather Service (NWS) radar images from the NOAA WSR-88D NEXRAD Radar sites located around the US. Radar images are downloaded directly from NWS servers so are always the most current available. When you start the app, the radar images are from the site closest to your location.
Don't like Ad banners? It's now possible to opt-out banners with paid upgrade (Settings > Upgrade).
Please use the "Contact us" form inside RadarNow!® (Settings icon > Contact us) if you encounter a problem or have a suggestion for improvement.
We value your input! It was suggestions and constructive critiques from users just like you that helped to create the new, improved RadarNow!®.
RadarNow! is designed to be fast, efficient and have great free options. If you want a full featured weather app that shows things like ski conditions or tide reports, we suggest using WeatherBug or Weather Channel. RadarNow! Standard (Free) provides animated radar, local conditions and NWS Alerts centered on your current location. Radar Now! Premium provides the same but allows you to select other radar sites as well as provide more zoom levels, range rings, selectable locations and a pannable map of the continental US with a looping weather radar.
RadarNow! uses US radars only, therefore is active for entire U.S., Puerto Rico, Guam and areas of Canada, Mexico and the Caribbean that border the U.S.
Battery is used ONLY when RadarNow! is active, otherwise RadarNow! has no effect on battery life. RadarNow! uses GPS and network location services to fix your location. If location services aren't available, Zip Code can be used with RadarNow! to set location.

The All Router Admin Setup Control app is an all-in-one solution for you to easily configure and control router settings.

bluejetty:00065078:ios.description:
New to our app?
At MBNA, we’re boringly good at credit card stuff, which doesn’t make us ideal dinner party guests, but does make people want our credit cards in their wallets. Check out our Mobile Banking app.
Account management stuff
• Log in quickly and securely with Touch ID, Face ID or three characters from your memorable information
• Manage your account – check balances and pending payments
• View your PIN or request a new one
• Easily request a new card, report lost or stolen cards, freeze them and order replacements
• Quickly find and view transactions and statements
• Update your contact details
You can find plenty of other information in the app by using our ‘Search’ tool, as well as our handy ‘Help hub’.
Getting started
It’s quick and easy. You’ll need:
• The phone number that you’ve registered with us
• An MBNA credit card
Keeping you safe online
We do all we can to protect you online. This includes preventing connections from the app on devices that we think have been tampered with.
How we’ll contact you
Using our app won’t affect how we contact you. Our emails will address you by your title and surname and include the last four digits of your account number, or the last three digits of your postcode. Any texts we send you will come from Halifax. Be wary of any message that differs from this – it could be a scam.
Important information
Your phone’s signal and functionality may affect your service. Terms and conditions apply.
When you use this app we collect anonymous location data to help combat fraud, fix bugs and improve future services.
Touch ID requires at least iPhone 6s running iOS 14.0 or above or iPad (5th generation), iPad Pro, iPad Air 2, or iPad mini 3 (or later models). Face ID requires either iPhone X or later models, or iPad Pro with Face ID capability (2018 onwards).
Everyday Offers is available to Lloyds Bank UK personal current account customers, excluding Basic Account holders, aged 18+ with a debit/credit card who bank online. Terms and conditions apply.
Apple, the Apple logo, iPad, iPad Air, iPad mini, iPad Pro, iPhone, Touch ID and Face ID are trademarks of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries.
Credit cards issued by MBNA Limited. Registered Office: Cawley House, Chester Business Park, Chester CH4 9FB. Registered in England and Wales under company number 02783251. Authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority. MBNA is also authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority under the Payment Services Regulations 2017, Register Number: 204487 for the provision of payment services.
Credit is available, subject to status, to UK residents aged 18 or over.
Calls and online sessions (e.g. completing an application) may be monitored and/or recorded for quality evaluation, training purposes and to ensure compliance with laws and regulations.

This app is designed and intended for MBNA UK customers to access and service UK personal products. It should only be downloaded for this purpose.

bluejetty:00045246:ios.description:
Goodbye pill box, hello Hero: the new way to manage your meds! 
Hero is the first end-to-end medication management service that liberates caregivers and loved ones from sorting pills, remembering doses, tracking refills, and more.
The Hero mobile app is a virtual med management assistant designed to schedule and track even the most complex regimen, manage a loved one’s meds remotely, receive missed-dose and refill notifications, and get personalized insights on medication adherence habits. Connected to Hero’s smart dispenser –– an award-winning device that automatically sorts and dispenses up to a 90-day supply of 10 different medications –– the app helps manage every pill stored in your dispenser, plus up to 10 additional meds outside of your device.
Whether you’re caring for a loved one or managing your own meds, Hero’s app brings peace of mind to the whole family, with access to:
- Alerts if a dose was missed or if any medications are running low
- Unlimited adjustments to your medication schedule at any time 
- Real-time adherence tracking with personalized insights
- Safety and security monitoring for your Hero smart dispenser, including passcodes, daily pill limits, etc.
- And more!
Remember, the Hero app requires an active Hero subscription and a connected smart dispenser. It does not work as a stand-alone application. To become a Hero member, please visit herohealth.com.

FN365 offers a soccer experience like never before! We've elevated our app to be your go-to guide for the bustling world of football. Stay ahead of the game with daily news and events from your favorite teams, ensuring you never miss a key match or transfer!

Our team is proud to be the FIRST app partner of soccer fans in the US! Reach out anytime on social media or by email to say Hi! at hello@fn-365.com. We are looking for soccer influencers to share their passion with us.

Below for our exclusive app features.

Football Calendar Integrated in the app:
• News Highlights: From the English Premier League to Major League Soccer, we cover every crucial event of your favorite football team.
• Transfer Windows & Cup Matches: Easily track transfer periods and cup matches.
• Women's Soccer Coverage: Embrace the excitement of the NWSL and other key women's leagues.

Why FN365?
• Tailored News Feed: Customized updates for your favorite teams and leagues.
• Broad Coverage: Access news from over 25 diverse sources for a well-rounded view.
• Real-Time Updates: Latest matchday lineups, scores, breaking news, and more!
• Polls & Ratings: Participate in discussions about player performances and major events.
• Alerts & Notifications: Stay updated 24/7 with the latest soccer news.

Premium Perks:
• Ad-Free Experience: Enjoy uninterrupted access to soccer news.
• Exclusive Content: Gain access to special features for premium members!
• Download FN365 now — and transform your soccer experience with our exclusive event calendar! Don’t forget to share it with your friends or leave us a review if you like it!

bluejetty:00143451:ios.summary: GoZem est une plateforme technologique de transport pour le Togo. Notre objectif est d'offrir la simplicité, la sécurité, et la fiabilité de nos services aux passagers et aux conducteurs locaux, en commençant par les motos-taxi (ou «zemidja
bluejetty:00143451:ios.description:
GoZem est une plateforme technologique de transport pour le Togo. Notre objectif est d'offrir la simplicité, la sécurité, et la fiabilité de nos services aux passagers et aux conducteurs locaux, en commençant par les motos-taxi (ou «zemidjans») au Togo.
Vous cherchez un moyen simple pour vous déplacer rapidement à Lomé ? Choisissez GoZem, notre solution de transport individuel.
Pourquoi ?
Gozem n’est pas qu’une application, mais beaucoup plus. Notre mission est de vous fournir un service fiable et simplifié afin que vous puissiez naviguer en toute tranquillité et sans inquiétude. Il est important pour nous qu’au 21ème siècle chaque pays d’Afrique Francophone puissent disposer d’un service qui aide à la fois les gens qui y vivent et leurs permettre d’avoir accès à un service qui associe économie et confiance lors de leurs déplacements.
Comment ?
En mettant à votre disposition des conducteurs assurés ayant acquis une formation spécial, un équipement de sûreté pour vous protéger lors de vos déplacements cela accompagné d’engins fiable.
Se déplacer avec GoZem est extrêmement simple. Voici comment procéder :
- Ouvrez l’application et sélectionnez votre lieu de départ et votre destination.
- L’application utilise votre localisation GPS pour que le chauffeur puisse venir vous chercher. 
- Vous verrez une photo de votre chauffeur, les détails de son véhicule, et vous pourrez suivre son avancée sur la carte et le contacter en cas de besoin.
- Vous pouvez payer avec tous les moyens de paiements: espèce, carte bancaire et mobile money
- Après la course, vous visualiserez dans la rubrique “historique” le détail de votre trajet et le montant de votre course. Vous pourrez également noter votre conducteur et nous donner votre avis pour nous aider à améliorer l’expérience GoZem.
Nos Fonctionnalités:
- Prix fixé par l’application
- Paiement en espèce, carte de crédit et mobile money (Moov Flooz, Togocel T-money)
- Service disponible 7/7 et 24/24
- Temps d’attente moyen de 5 minutes
- Conducteurs formés pour vous garantir le meilleur service et la sécurité sur la route
- Assurances et assistances accident pour les passagers
- Programme de fidélité exclusif et généreux
- Programme de parrainage qui permet de gagner des crédits pour chaque nouvel utilisateur que vous parrainez
Visitez notre site ou nos réseaux sociaux: 
Site web: https://www.gozem.co
Suivez-nous sur Twitter http://twitter.com/gozemtg
Facebook https://www.facebook.com/gozemafrica
Instagram https://www.instagram.com/gozemafrica
Vous avez besoin d’aide ? Visitez http://www.gozem.co/support

bluejetty:00171082:ios.description:
The Detonator: Mining Adventure and Explosive Game
Dig into the depths of the Earth, mine minerals, and get rich with explosions! The Detonator is an exciting mobile mining game that will draw you into the mysterious world underground, and you'll want to come back often. Blast your bombs, collect minerals, discover special bombs, and go deeper by increasing your earnings.
Key Features:
-Earth's Depths: Find yourself journeying towards the heart of the Earth. How deep can you go?
-Blast and Mine: Use your bombs to uncover minerals and discover rare resources. Every explosion can bring a big reward!
-Get Rich: Earn wealth and fortune by selling the minerals you collect. Build your own mining empire!
-Mining Exploration: Explore hundreds of different types of minerals. Precious gems, metals, and more await you.
-Special Bombs: Customize the game with over 50 special bomb types and create more powerful explosions.
-Action-Packed Explosions: Test the power of your bombs and witness massive explosions. The world will shake!
-Achievements and Leaderboards: Compete with other players and rise on the leaderboards to become the best miner in the world.
Why Choose The Detonator:
-Addictive Gameplay: With simple controls and fun gameplay, it appeals to players of all ages.
-
Valuable Minerals: Discover rare minerals you can find in the real world and build your collection.
-Upgradable Bombs: Upgrade your bombs with your earnings in the game and create bigger explosions.
-Regular Updates: We're constantly adding new features, levels, and rewards to the game, so you'll never get bored!
-Community and Feedback: We listen to our players' feedback and work to make the game even better. Share your thoughts too!
The Detonator is the perfect choice for anyone looking to explore and experience a blast-filled mining adventure. Compete with players from all around the world, climb the leaderboards, and gain fame among miners worldwide.
Download the game for free now and join the mining adventure. Prove yourself among miners worldwide!
The Detonator offers you a mining adventure full of explosions. Escape boredom and dive into the depths of the underground!

bluejetty:00144711:ios.description:
Meeting.ai is the AI note taker agent for every meeting: in person, on Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams.
Record on your phone, let the bot join your call, or upload a file. You get a transcript, a summary, meeting minutes, action items and a Visual Note: one picture of the whole meeting.
Then the agent does the follow-up work: PowerPoint decks, Word documents and Excel trackers built from what was said.
TAKE NOTES IN ANY MEETING
• In person: put your phone on the table and record. No bot needed.
• Online: the Meeting.ai bot joins Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams, or auto-joins from your calendar.
• Upload: MP3, WAV, MP4, MOV and more.
• 30+ languages with auto-detect.
WHAT YOU GET AFTER EVERY MEETING
• A full transcript with speaker names (Voice Match)
• A summary, key decisions and meeting minutes
• Action items with owners
• A Visual Note: a one-page, hand-drawn-style infographic of the whole meeting. The main topic sits at the center; decisions, action items and owners branch out around it. One meeting, one picture, made for people who think in visuals.
• Share by link or email
AN AGENT THAT DOES THE FOLLOW-UP
Ask in plain words and it finishes the task:
• "Turn this meeting into a 10-slide deck" gives you an editable PowerPoint
• "Write the minutes as a document" gives you a Word file or PDF
• "Make a task tracker" gives you an Excel spreadsheet
• "Draft the follow-up email to the client"
• Research with sources, images and audio recaps
Installable skills add new abilities over time.
ASK YOUR MEETINGS
Search and ask across past meetings: "What did we promise the client last month?" The agent knows who said what and what was decided.
BUILT FOR WORK
Client calls, sales and consulting, legal and audit interviews, lectures, board and team meetings, NGOs and field work.
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
We don't train AI models on your recordings, transcripts or summaries.
START FREE
Your first meeting is free. Join 700,000+ professionals and choose the Intern, Manager or Director plan when you need more.
Works on iPhone, iPad, Android and the web.

Privacy Policy: https://meeting.ai/en/privacy

bluejetty:00022790:ios.description:
My bpost app: easily track, receive, or send parcels and registered mail 
■ Never lose track of a parcel, including deliveries from PostNL, DPD, DHL, and other carriers – whenever, wherever. Automatically track your bpost parcels, or scan or enter the barcode of the parcel you want to follow. 
■ Not at home at the expected delivery time? Let us know via your delivery preferences where we can deliver your bpost parcel, or easily postpone the delivery by a day. 
■ Set your delivery preference for registered mail. Let us know who is authorized to receive your registered mail, or choose to have it delivered directly to your letterbox. Would you prefer to receive your mail a day later, or pick it up immediately at a Post Office or Postal Point? Just let us know 
■ Sending a parcel? Quickly create a shipping label in the app and print it at home, at a Post Office, or Post Point. 
■ Need to send registered mail? Easily create your own shipping label for your registered mail. Print yourself or go to a Post Office or Post Point and have it printed for you. Affix it to your envelope and pop it in the post! 
■ Open Parcel Lockers without a screen via the app. 
■ Choose when you receive notifications for parcels and registered mail. 
■ Expecting a parcel from outside the EU? Then pay the import costs securely via the app. This way you can be sure that the request is coming from bpost and protect yourself against phishing. 
■ Find Pick-up points & Drop-off points. With 3,100+ Post Offices, Post Points, Parcel Points and Parcel Lockers, you’ll always find one close by.

bluejetty:00074328:ios.name: Overland Bound One: Maps & GPS
bluejetty:00074328:ios.summary: Overland Bound One is the app for overlanders and off-road explorers. Find trails and campsites shared by overlanders who’ve been there, plan trips with real route maps, and meet up with members near you. Built by overlanders specifically f
bluejetty:00074328:ios.description:
Overland Bound One is the app for overlanders and off-road explorers. Find trails and campsites shared by overlanders who’ve been there, plan trips with real route maps, and meet up with members near you. Built by overlanders specifically for adventure on and off-road.
Find the spots worth the drive
Thousands of overland-specific trails, camps, and resources, mapped by the community. Dispersed camping on USFS and BLM land, established campgrounds, fuel and water resupply, and mechanics who know 4x4s. Add your own finds or explore what’s already there.
Maps built for off-road
Switch between the layers you need: road, satellite, topo, National Forests, BLM routes, and USFS MVUM roads and trails. Toggle the map by Trails, Resources, Members, or Rally Points. Only see what you need when you need it. 
Go off-grid with Expedition mode
Members get offline maps, track recording, GPX import and export, offline navigation, and three-word GPS location lookup for when there’s no signal and no road.
Rally Points: trips you can actually join
Members create trips, meetups, training days, and events with routes and details specific to overlanding. Browse what’s happening near you, or organize your own.
A map full of people who get it
The Member Map shows Overland Bound members worldwide. Check in, ask a local what the trail’s like this week, or reach out to members in a specific area when you need help.
Overland Bound is a global community of overlanders. Download the app, make a free account, and start exploring. Membership unlocks Expedition mode and the full planning toolkit.

bluejetty:00119086:ios.name: Day by Day Meditations
bluejetty:00119086:ios.summary: More than a million people have relied on the words of Day by Day as an essential source of inspiration, spirituality, and mindfulness for their ongoing health and wellness. Reinforcing the Twelve Step principles of Narcotics Anonymous, eac
bluejetty:00119086:ios.description:
More than a million people have relied on the words of Day by Day as an essential source of inspiration, spirituality, and mindfulness for their ongoing health and wellness. Reinforcing the Twelve Step principles of Narcotics Anonymous, each thought of the day in this classic collection fosters the coping skills, insights, and spiritual growth that have helped people around the world find freedom from drug dependency and addiction.
Each daily message includes a reading, a question, and a prayer. Also included every day is an interactive “sentence starter” to help you think about and relate the daily topic to your own life. Use this as inspiration for journal writing or discussions, or type your thoughts right into the app.
The Day by Day app also includes lists of the Twelve Steps and Twelve Traditions as well as the Prayer of Saint Francis.
Features:
PRESS the “Today” button to access today’s reading.
SWIPE forward or back to easily access more daily readings.
TYPE and save your answers to the daily sentence starters.
SHARE the daily reading with friends by e-mail or text.
BOOKMARK your favorite meditations (press the star in the upper right-hand corner) and easily return to them (press the star in the bottom toolbar).
SEARCH all 366 daily readings.
RECEIVE a notification every day to remind you to read the daily meditation.
JUMP to a specific reading using the calendar button.
SET your font size using your device settings.
CHOOSE between light or dark mode.

bluejetty:00016596:ios.description:
Travel back in time to Ancient Rome in Jewels of Rome®! A struggling settlement in a remote but beautiful corner of the Roman Empire needs your help to be restored to its former glory. Play thousands of match-3 levels, meet charismatic characters, follow the suspenseful storyline and build this close-knit village into a sprawling Roman city!
This game is a unique and epic combination of city building and match-3, tied together with a storyline full of twists and turns, Mediterranean culture, and an atmospheric and vibrant setting of Ancient Rome. You’ve been named the prefect of a troubled settlement in a distant corner of the Roman Empire. Help the determined residents revive their community after a disastrous betrayal by your scheming predecessor, Cassius. Reconstruct an impressive settlement that’s worthy of legends, thwart Cassius’ evil machinations and ensure that fortune favors your citizens once again!
● PLAY through a unique combination of match-3 and city building in one game
● GO on an adventure through Roman history, fantasy, and myths
● MEET villagers, nobles, craftsmen, Gods and mortals on your way to glory
● MASTER thousands of unique match-3 levels
● WIELD incredible boosters and power-up combos
● UNLOCK a variety of beautiful buildings and landmarks in the city to rebuild and upgrade
● FOLLOW your friends’ progress with the innovative built-in social network
While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.
You can play this game even if you’re offline!
Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Ukrainian.

bluejetty:00176115:ios.summary:
Welcome to Bug Identifier! This innovative, AI-driven mobile app takes entomology, the study of insects, to the next level, putting the knowledge and fascination of the insect world right into your hands.
Bug ID is designed to make insect
bluejetty:00176115:ios.description:
Welcome to Bug Identifier! This innovative, AI-driven mobile app takes entomology, the study of insects, to the next level, putting the knowledge and fascination of the insect world right into your hands.
Bug ID is designed to make insect identification easy, fun, and educational. Simply snap a photo of an insect, and our advanced AI will analyze it in seconds, identifying from a database of thousands of global insect species. It's a perfect tool for nature enthusiasts, gardeners, students, or anyone interested in exploring the incredible diversity of the insect world.
Each insect identification is accompanied by a richly detailed profile containing an array of interesting and helpful information, including the insect's common and scientific name, habitat, behavior, life cycle, and more. You'll also find high-quality images and helpful guides that provide more detailed insights, whether you're dealing with a common housefly or an exotic praying mantis.
Never again wonder about the mysterious insect you encountered on your hike, in your garden, or in your home. Bug ID will instantly transform your device into a pocket entomologist. Learn, explore, and appreciate the intricate world of insects right at your fingertips!
Key Features:
1. AI-Powered Identification: Snap a photo, and get accurate results instantly.
2. Comprehensive Insect Database: A global collection covering thousands of insect species.
3. Detailed Insect Profiles: Learn about habitats, behaviors, life cycles, and more.
4. High-Quality Visual Guides: Supports your learning with clear and detailed images.
5. User-Friendly Interface: Easy to use, whether you're a budding naturalist or an expert entomologist.
So, are you ready to buzz into the captivating world of insects? Download Bug ID today and start your entomological exploration!
In-App Purchase:
Bug ID is a free download, completely risk-free, before purchasing the service. If you purchase the service, you will be charged a weekly, monthly or yearly price according to your country and which item you purchase. The user can create one story for free. Access to creating more than one story is restricted to subscribed users. Users can always view the community stories for free. The price will always be shown in the app before you complete a purchase. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your Bug ID subscription automatically renews at the end of every billing period (as determined by your purchase of monthly or yearly service) and your iTunes account will automatically be charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of Service: https://www.brantleymediagroup.com/brantleymediagrouptermsofuse
Privacy Policy: https://www.brantleymediagroup.com/insect-id-privacy-policy
