bluejetty:00100494:ios.description:
1. Como o Boora funciona
O Boora é um mapa social pra quem quer sair de casa e conhecer pessoas de forma natural.
Sua localização não aparece no mapa.
O que aparece são atividades criadas por pessoas reais, abertas a quem quiser participar.
Entre ou crie atividades simples, do dia a dia:
almoço em grupo, caminhada, happy hour, café, treino, cinema, eventos culturais ou qualquer outro motivo pra sair de casa.
Abra o mapa da sua cidade e veja o que está acontecendo por perto.
Encontrou algo legal? Entra.
Quer fazer algo? Cria.
Você conhece pessoas novas com interesses parecidos e que já estão abertas a socializar, sem match forçado e sem conversa infinita que não leva a lugar nenhum.
a. Planeje também o que vem pela frente
Vai mudar de bairro ou cidade?
Cadastre seu destino e entre em atividades de pessoas que também estarão lá.
Assim, você chega já conhecendo gente — e não começa do zero.
b. Recomendações inteligentes
O Boora sugere atividades e encontros com base na sua localização, rotina e interesses.
Quanto mais você usa, mais o mapa fica com a sua cara.
c. Chat e grupos no app
Antes do encontro, você conversa com o grupo, combina os detalhes e chega se sentindo mais confortável e seguro.
2. Boora Plus (Recursos Premium)
Com o Boora Plus, você ganha mais visibilidade e controle da sua vida social:
- Veja todas as pessoas próximas
- Saiba quem visitou seu perfil
- Destaque seu perfil no mapa
- Apareça com mais visibilidade pra quem está buscando novas conexões
- Visibilidade total ao mudar de bairro ou cidade
3. Por que o Boora?
Conexões reais, não virtuais
O foco é sair do online e viver experiências de verdade, em grupo.
Sem pressão, sem clima estranho
Aqui a conexão acontece pela atividade, não por match ou cantada.
Perfis reais
Verificação opcional pra encontros mais tranquilos.
Ideal pra quem acabou de se mudar
Chega de passar fim de semana sozinho só porque ainda não conhece ninguém.
Comece em poucos segundos
- Crie seu perfil com sua cidade, interesses e rotina
- Abra o mapa e veja o que está rolando por perto
- Entre em atividades ou crie a sua
- Conheça pessoas e comece a se sentir em casa
Não vá sozinho.
Baixe o Boora e transforme sua cidade em um lugar cheio de conexões.
- TERMOS E PRIVACIDADE
https://www.boora.space/politica-de-privacidade
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00180962:ios.description:
Quotescapes is a brand new word puzzle game for those who love word games, word search puzzles, word collects, crosswords and sudoku puzzles. Quotescapes introduces a new twist to word search puzzles by challenging players to complete sentences. This offline word puzzle game is perfect for anyone seeking a new word game, crossword puzzles, and new games without internet.
Challenge yourself and train your brain. Try to find hidden words in given quotes. You will have fun trying to solve beautiful inspirational and motivational quotes, sayings, idioms, proverbs, movie lines, celebrity and funny quotes and much more on crosswords! Play this word calm game and relax with offline word collect games.
Quotescapes is an exciting puzzle game for true word geniuses! Concentrate to find all hidden words in given quotes. It starts off as an easy word game but becomes challenging by time! You will have fun while improving your vocabulary and spelling skills. Your brain will thank you for the workout! Be a word search explorer with unique quote levels.
Immerse yourself into the beautiful music and scenery backgrounds to relax your brain and ease your mind. There are many free word games and word scramble games on IOS but this unique word connect is a mix of word search, crossword and word escape. You can play this nice game with your family.
HOW TO PLAY?
- Tap the word you want to solve.
- Swipe the letters to fill in the blanks in the sentences.
- Having difficulty solving the puzzles in the word game? Tap the Hint buttons to get clues or tap the Shuffle button to change the order of letters.
- Get more hints by purchasing coins or watching videos.
- Find as many words as possible to earn more points and extra coins.
QUOTESCAPES FEATURES:
- Hundreds of unique challenges in this word connect game.
- Difficulty increases by levels. Easy to play, but hard to beat!
- Great exercise for the brain. wow!
- Best games in the world and brain games.
- Word games free for adults and word games offline.
- Play OFFLINE anytime and anywhere.
- Play brain teasers games without internet.
- All levels are double-checked to make sure they are solvable!
- Daily bonus rewards and free word games for adults!
- Word puzzle games improve your memory and are great to play in your spare time.
- Travel theme with unique landscapes from all over the world.
- Enjoy word games for kids and brain games for adults. 
This is a brand-new word life game for word games fans. Download, and find the words! Play the word games for adults now, you will find it so addictive and just can't put your phone down. 
We highly value your feedback; please share your thoughts when you rate our word quote game. Your comments will be read carefully.
We really hope you enjoy our game! Email our support team at support@unicostudio.co

bluejetty:00178265:ios.name: World War Armies: RTS Game
bluejetty:00178265:ios.summary: Experience the ultimate real-time strategy challenge in World War Armies. As a commander in this gripping World War 2 strategy experience, you'll lead your forces through intense tactical war scenarios. Build your army, command powerful uni
bluejetty:00178265:ios.description:
Experience the ultimate real-time strategy challenge in World War Armies. As a commander in this gripping World War 2 strategy experience, you'll lead your forces through intense tactical war scenarios. Build your army, command powerful units, and conquer the battlefield in one of the most immersive World War 2 games available.
COMMAND YOUR TROOPS IN EPIC BATTLES
World War Armies brings the true feel of a classic RTS game to your mobile device. Step into the boots of a general and orchestrate massive assaults. Every decision matters in this tactical war environment. From positioning your infantry to deploying heavy tanks, your army strategy will determine the victor.
REAL-TIME STRATEGY AT ITS BEST
If you are looking for true military strategy, look no further. This is an RTS game where skill, quick thinking, and army strategy win the day. Outsmart your opponents in fast-paced real-time strategy battles. Unlike other World War 2 games, here you have full control over your units on the battlefield.
THRILLING WW2 MULTIPLAYER
Test your mettle against players from around the globe in competitive WW2 multiplayer. Climb the ranks and prove your tactical war supremacy. The RTS multiplayer mechanics ensure that no two battles are the same. Forge alliances, coordinate with friends, and dominate the WW2 multiplayer leaderboards.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR FORCES
A successful army strategy requires the right tools. Unlock, upgrade, and customize a vast array of WW2 units. Whether you prefer the raw firepower of heavy armor or the agility of airborne troops, you can tailor your loadout for the perfect RTS multiplayer experience. Combine different unit types to execute flawless military strategy.
KEY FEATURES:
• True real-time strategy action on mobile
• Intense WW2 multiplayer battles with players worldwide
• Historically-inspired units for authentic World War 2 games fans
• Deep army strategy progression and unit customization
• Exciting RTS multiplayer tournaments and events
• Masterful tactical war mechanics that reward skill over pay-to-win
Prepare for the ultimate military strategy test. Download World War Armies now and become a legend in the most intense RTS game available!
Instagram: instagram.com/wwarmies
Discord: discord.gg/F4NbMqyzyb
YouTube: youtube.com/@wwarts
Facebook: facebook.com/gaming/wwarmies

bluejetty:00159403:ios.description:
Introducing the brand new Count.It app, a breakthrough in corporate wellness and team building. The new app seamlessly syncs with Apple Health and other fitness tracking apps and creates an interactive, virtual wellness challenge. Built to get people moving and promote healthy community culture, the new app is the result of nearly a decade of market experience. Among many innovations: 
--A zoomable virtual challenge path that displays user avatars as though they were together on a real world journey. 
--Multiple challenge types, including daily steps, hundreds of exercises, and mindfulness/meditation. 
--A new sync'ing engine build from the ground up to ensure fast delivery data to make challenges feel increasingly "real time."
--Hooray for one tap emoji reactions! Yep, that's in there too. 
--Configurable goals and rewards for individual users, and the group as a whole. 
--Smart scaling technology which allows admins to set the relative difficulty of their challenge
--And much more! 
Come host a challenge, and get your people moving!

With CAC Connect, you can easily access and engage with your online courses, events, and explore enriching content that supports your spiritual journey. Connect with like-minded individuals in dedicated spaces to share insights, ask questions, and build meaningful relationships within a supportive community.

bluejetty:00159282:ios.description:
Prep to pass every high-stakes exam! Access your Qbanks for Pre-PA, Didactic exams, Rotation exams, PANCE, and PANRE/PANRE-LA on the new Blueprint PA app, as well as your PANCE/PANRE Review Course assessments and exams. 
The Blueprint PA app (formerly Rosh Review) will simplify your life and accelerate your learning for your PA journey. Prep with your Qbank anywhere and anytime, perfect for your busy schedule and on-the-go studying. Use this app to:
• Quickly create practice sets 
• Easily answer and review questions
• Seamlessly move between desktop and mobile and see your progress
• Effortlessly study on-the-go - no matter your schedule!
• Download practice sets for offline practice and sync when you’re back online
What's included:
• Extensive Question Library : access hundreds to thousands of practice questions aligned with the topics and exam format for Pre-PA, Didactic exams, Rotation exams, PANCE, or PANRE/PANRE-LA. 
• Detailed Explanations: maximize your understanding of core concepts with expert explanations for every correct and incorrect answer.
• Memorable Illustrations: improve your retention with vivid medical images that allow you to focus on the essential info. 
• Customizable Practice Sets : create personalized practice sets that align with your specific needs to target weak areas and concentrate your studying efforts.
• Flexible Practice Modes : choose between Tutor Mode, where you receive immediate answers and explanations as you progress, or Exam Mode, which replicates the test day experience.
• Rapid Review & One Step Further: recap the main points with a rapid review and bonus question provided with each Qbank explanation. 
• Offline Mode: easily download practice sets or exams for offline practice and sync when you’re back online.

bluejetty:00099715:ios.description:
The Informed Delivery® Mobile application allows you to start your mornings with a preview of your day’s USPS mail and packages. This free app let's you see photos of your mail before it arrives and receive USPS tracking updates. You can use the app to:
• Create your account or sign-in with an existing account.
• Get daily digest notifications to preview your mail and packages scheduled to arrive soon.
• See grayscale images of your mail before it arrives*. Images are of the exterior, address side only of letter sized mail.
• Interact with mailer-provided digital content associated with your mail (e.g. - special offers, related links).
• Scan eligible tracking numbers or label barcodes to track the status of your inbound or outbound USPS packages.
• Get delivery status updates directly to your smartphone.
*Images are only provided for letter-sized mailpieces that are processed through USPS’s automated equipment. Mail and packages may not arrive the same day you get a notification – please allow several days for delivery.

Create Without Limits: Step into
bluejetty:00081094:ios.description:
Dive into the immersive world of sandbox, where creativity meets endless possibilities! Unleash your imagination in this dynamic sandbox game and embark on an exciting journey filled with fun and adventure.
Create Without Limits: Step into sandbox environments where you can build, design, and craft anything you can dream of. Construct towering structures, intricate landscapes, and much more using intuitive tools and controls. The only limit is your creativity in this sandbox world!
Engage in Thrilling Simulations: Green Sandbox is not just about building—experience the thrill of simulation games with challenging scenarios and dynamic sandbox gameplay. Solve puzzles, race against time, and navigate through challenging terrains for an exhilarating adventure in the sandbox.
Intense Boss Fights: Prepare for occasional yet intense boss fights that will put your skills to the test. Strategize, adapt, and conquer these powerful foes to earn exclusive rewards and elevate your sandbox experience.
Connect and Collaborate: Join a vibrant community of sandbox players from around the world. Share your sandbox creations, explore others' masterpieces, and collaborate on exciting projects. With multiplayer options, you can team up with friends or compete in exciting sandbox challenges and events.
Discover and Unlock: Dive deeper into the sandbox to unlock a wealth of new content. From innovative tools and customization options to themed environments and mini-games, there's always something new to explore and enjoy in the sandbox.

bluejetty:00093654:ios.description:
Towne24 by TowneBank allows our members to securely manage their personal or business finances. Monitor your accounts, send, and receive money with Zelle®* and deposit checks. 
Manage Accounts
• Quickly access your finances with biometric login**
• Review account history, transactions, and balance information
• Transfer funds between accounts at TowneBank or another financial institution 
• Deposit checks*** 
• View check images 
• Easily search and find statements and documents 
Make Payments

• Schedule, edit, or cancel bill payments 
• Add and delete payees 
Business Tools
Towne24 features business tools to support your business banking needs, whether you’re in the office or on the go. 
• View your business account balances, transactions, and activity in real time
• Transfer funds between accounts or to external financial institutions 
• Deposit checks remotely with Mobile Check Deposit***
• Manage cash flow with secure, on-demand access to your accounts 
• Access digital statements and important financial documents 
• Send wires securely 
• Approve ACH and wire transactions on the go 
Contact Us
• Locate offices and ATMs based on your current location 
Security You Can Trust 
Your financial security is our top priority. Towne24 uses the same trusted protections as our online banking, including SSL encryption and enhanced login authentication. 
• No sensitive data is stored on your device 
• Account information is never transmitted unsecured

• An Apple device with the latest version of the TowneBank Business Mobile Banking App

bluejetty:00175792:ios.description:
Tall Man Run: The Ultimate Running Game Adventure!
Get ready for an exhilarating experience with Tall Man Run, the fun and addictive running game that will keep you on your toes! Navigate through challenging obstacles, collect power-ups, and see how far you can run with our tall hero!
How to Play:
Run Fast and Jump High: Control your tall character as you run through various obstacle courses. Jump over hurdles, slide under barriers, and dodge obstacles to keep moving forward.
Collect Power-Ups: Gather coins and power-ups along the way to enhance your abilities and unlock new features. The more you collect, the further you can run!
Endless Running Adventure: The game features endless running mechanics, meaning the fun never stops! Test your reflexes and see how far you can go in this exciting tall man run challenge.
Game Features:
Exciting Gameplay: Enjoy a combination of fun mechanics and fast-paced gameplay in this unique running game.
Stunning 3D Graphics: Immerse yourself in beautifully designed environments and smooth animations that enhance your gaming experience.
Challenging Levels: Face increasingly difficult obstacles and challenges that will test your skills and reflexes.
Leaderboard Competition: Compete with players from around the world. Can you reach the top of the leaderboard in Tall Man Run?
Offline Play: Enjoy the game anytime, anywhere, without the need for an internet connection. Perfect for gaming on the go!
Why You’ll Love Tall Man Run: Running Game:
Fun and Addictive: Easy to learn but hard to master, this game is perfect for players of all ages!
Casual and Engaging: Play at your own pace, whether you have a few minutes or want to dive into a longer session.
Free to Play: Download Tall Man Run for free and enjoy in-app purchases that enhance your gaming experience.
Special Features:
Funny Character Design: Enjoy the quirky and humorous design of your tall character as you run through the vibrant game world.
Dynamic Obstacles: Experience a variety of obstacles that keep the gameplay fresh and exciting.
Power-Up Boosts: Use power-ups strategically to gain an edge and run even faster!
Download Tall Man Run: Running Game today and embark on an endless running adventure! Whether you’re a fan of tall man run challenges or looking for an exciting running game, this game has it all. How far can you go? Let the running begin!

bluejetty:00121849:ios.name: Playapod
bluejetty:00121849:ios.summary: Playapod is the best way to listen to your favorite podcasts and features cross-platform device syncing, episode tracking down to the second, remote media controls, offline listening, new episode notifications, bulk imports, fast performanc
bluejetty:00121849:ios.description:
Playapod is the best way to listen to your favorite podcasts and features cross-platform device syncing, episode tracking down to the second, remote media controls, offline listening, new episode notifications, bulk imports, fast performance, no ads, and more!
• Multi-Device Sync
Sync all your podcast subscriptions and episode progress between multiple devices and across all platforms! Just sign-in with your favorite social network or with e-mail.
• Episode Tracking
Tracks exactly the portions of episodes that you have listened down to the second. You'll never forget where you left off or what you skipped over!
• Bookmarking
Bookmark your favorite parts of any episode so you can quickly go back and listen again. Bookmarks are time-coded and synced across all your devices.
• Video Playback (NEW v2 Feature)
Video playback supported. Tapping on the video will toggle full-screen mode.
• Text to Speech (NEW v2 Feature)
Turn any text-based feed into an audio podcast with full progress bar support including scrubbing and bookmarking. Great for keeping up with the latest news and blogs.
• Media Bar (NEW v2 Feature)
Quickly access whatever is currently playing by tapping on the media bar at the bottom of the screen. It’s always on with quick access to play/pause. Tap the bar to bring up the full media player view.
• Recommendations (NEW v2 Feature)
Our recommendation engine will suggest new subscriptions you might enjoy.
• Groups & Filters (NEW v2 Feature)
Filter content by favorites, category, media flags, content type, and time. Save filters into Groups for quick one-touch access.
• Media Files (NEW v2 Feature)
Add media files such as audio, video, and text files to Playapod using iTunes File Sharing for local playback.
• Car Play
Driving with your iPhone puts your Playapod Now Playing queue right on your car's built-in display.
• Custom Playlist
Create a custom playlist of your podcast episodes. Drag and drop reordering makes it easy to listen to your favorite shows all day without device interaction.
• Media Controls
Toggle playback and skip forward and backwards quickly using lockscreen and bluetooth controls.
• Listen Offline
Download entire podcasts and listen on the go without a network connection or cellular data charges.
• Free & No Ads
Free download with no advertising! There are no bulky 3rd party ad networks that are known to kill battery life, slow performance, and consume network bandwidth.
• Push Notifications
Get new episode notifications so you stay on top of your favorite shows. Toggle notifications in the app settings.
• Import Podcasts
Quickly bulk import a list of podcasts with OPML files (Outline Processor Markup Language XML Files).
• Advanced Configuration
Lots of settings to customize and tweak the behavior of the Playapod app. Custom settings available for each subscription too!
• Customer Support
Our developers listen to your feedback and quickly fix all reported issues. Join our Facebook Page and start a discussion! 
Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/playapod/
Twitter:
https://twitter.com/playapod
Website:
https://playapod.com/

bluejetty:00022565:ios.description:
Atlantisor is a casual shooting elimination (match of three) game based on the ancient civilization of Atlantis. Guided by the Princess of Atlantis, you will command your heroes to fight back (eliminate) the evil invaders from Greece. Defeating opponents can earn points and battlefield achievements. Boss battles are also essential, of course!
"Dear warriors! Please lead the Atlanteans to victory!" - Princess Alexandra
Note: Atlantisor is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. It's an extremely enjoyable experience, and we strive to provide the best, richest entertainment experience within a limited period of time. Atlantisor is a game for all ages.
Features of the game:
● Casual and refreshing but sticky gameplay
● A slightly more realistic game screen with various details shown at a glance and cool special effects
● Simple operation, coupled with unique operation feedback from your iPhone, to ensure a great experience
● Dynamic sound effects and a deep sense of empathy
● Multiple checkpoints, each with its own exquisite style and experience
● Extremely challenging boss battles
● The ability to earn higher battlefield scores and level ratings
Special statement: Atlantisor will be a game that provides continuous updates and services. The following content will be provided soon:
● New elements of game development
● More levels with different artistic styles and gameplay
● More challenging boss battles
● Continuously evolving system depth, as in the powerful stacking effect of special balls
● Mini games and new game modes
● Online battles for two or more players
● Social elements based on Facebook
● Rich collection and achievement elements
● Global ranking
Player support: Send an e-mail to Customer Service: weiwangguru@gmail.com.
Last but not least, a big THANK YOU goes out to everyone who has played Atlantisor!

apple-macos:6741479634.description:
Tally Up is the personal finance app that gives you the full financial picture — where you stand today, and where you're headed in 30 years. Track accounts, reconcile transactions, build budgets, and run long-term forecasts, all privately on your devices.
Perfect for anyone saving for retirement, pursuing FIRE, building wealth, or planning a major life purchase.
— PRIVATE & SECURE BY DESIGN —
Your financial data stays on your devices. No third-party clouds, no data mining, no subscriptions to external services. Syncs seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, and Mac using your private iCloud account.
— COMPLETE WEALTH TRACKER —
Get a complete picture of your finances in seconds. Track savings accounts, investment portfolios, property, retirement accounts, and more. Add as much or as little detail as you want.
— BUDGETS —
Create budgets manually or generate them from your transaction history. The Budget Report tracks planned-versus-actual spending by category, with drill-downs to individual transactions and period navigation.
— TRANSACTIONS & IMPORTS —
Track account activity in detail. Import transactions from CSV and QIF files, including securities and multi-currency activity, to build your portfolio faster.
— BANK CONNECTIONS —
Connect Tally Up directly to your financial accounts. Link Lunch Flow to bring in bank transactions automatically using your own API key, or connect Interactive Brokers via Flex Query to pull in brokerage activity statements. Your credentials stay in your device Keychain and are never shared with anyone.
— LIVE MARKET DATA —
Security prices and FX rates update automatically in the background, keeping investment valuations current without any manual input.
— REPORTS & FORECASTING —
Tally Up's reporting engine covers your full financial timeline:
* NAV Report — total net worth over time with asset breakdown
* Portfolio Report — current holdings, market values, and IRR per position
* Cash Flow Forecast — project income and expenses over 30 years
* Operational Cash Flow — short-term view of the year ahead
* Budget Report — planned vs. actual spending with full drill-down
— "WHAT IF?" SCENARIOS —
Model the future with confidence. Simulate how inflation, interest rate changes, salary increases, major purchases, or early retirement could affect your finances over decades.
— BUILT FOR FINANCIAL INDEPENDENCE —
Whether you're pursuing FIRE, planning traditional retirement, saving for a house deposit, or simply want a clearer picture of your money, Tally Up gives you the tools to make confident decisions.
Download Tally Up today and start building your financial future.
DISCLAIMER: Tally Up provides general financial information and educational tools only. It is not financial, investment, tax, or legal advice. All forecasts and scenarios are estimates based on user inputs and may not reflect actual results. Always consult a qualified professional.

bluejetty:00200206:ios.description:
Go Narrow is a game that teaches antibiotic coverage: which antibiotics cover which bacteria, and why. Your goal is always the narrowest drug that does the job.
I'm a microbiology resident. Ever since I studied antibiotics in medical school, I've been thinking about how coverage could be taught in a fun way, because many medical students, and residents too, really struggle with it.
Play the plate
Tap the bacteria your antibiotic covers, leave the ones it doesn't, and use the culture result to choose the narrowest drug that works. Every wrong tap tells you why in one sentence: an enzyme destroys the drug, its target has changed, or the drug can't get in. The pairs you get wrong come back for review until they stick.
Interactive textbook
From penicillins to nitrofurantoin, each class has its own path. Animations show how the drugs work, on the cell wall and membrane, the ribosome, DNA gyrase and folate synthesis, and how bacteria fight back, from MRSA and VRE to ESBL, AmpC, carbapenemases. Each path covers the drugs' uses and adverse effects and ends on cases from the ward and the clinic, 123 in all.
Night Shift
A new shift every day. Play Today's shift against the clock and see where you stand on the leaderboard.
The Lab
Learn Gram staining step by step and train your eye for morphology: Klebsiella are Gram-negative rods, staphylococci Gram-positive cocci in clusters, streptococci Gram-positive cocci in chains.
Your crew
Finish a chapter and its bug joins your crew. Any of them can be your bug.
For medical, pharmacy and nursing students, residents, and anyone who wants to go narrow. In English and German, on iPhone and iPad. Plays offline, with no ads and no account.
For learning only: real prescribing depends on local resistance, the site of infection and the patient, so always follow your local guidelines.

Turn a still photo into a Live Photo that plays with a press and hold in Photos. Live.AI uses AI-generated motion to bring portraits, pets, travel memories, and landscapes to life.
CREATE IN FOUR STEPS
1. Choose one photo or select up to 9 for a batch
2. Pick a visual style, camera movement, and quality
3. Add an optional motion prompt, then start cloud generation
4. Get notified when it is ready and save the Live Photo to Photos
MADE FOR YOUR MOMENTS
• Keep a portrait natural with subtle movement
• Add depth to travel and landscape shots with zoom, pan, or orbit
• Animate pet photos, artwork, and favorite memories
• Choose from realistic, anime, cyberpunk, oil painting, vaporwave, and dreamy looks
MORE CONTROL, LESS REPETITION
• Create one Live Photo or process up to 9 photos with shared settings
• Track every item in a batch and save completed results together
• Stop pending items; photos that have not started do not use credits
• Adjust the style, camera direction, movement amount, quality, and custom prompt
• Regenerate a result with different settings
• Leave the app while generation runs and receive a notification when it finishes
PHOTOS-READY OUTPUT
Live.AI pairs the generated motion with your still image so Photos recognizes the result as a Live Photo, not a GIF. Press and hold to play it. After saving, you can use the sharing and Live Wallpaper options supported by your device and iOS version.
New users receive trial credits. Each generation uses credits, and failed generation tasks return them automatically. Cloud results expire after 30 days, so save finished Live Photos to your library promptly.
AI results can vary with the source image and selected settings.
CONVERT, FREE AND ON DEVICE
• Live Photo to video: export as MP4 to share anywhere
• Video to Live Photo: trim a clip, pick the cover frame, get a real Live Photo

apple-itunes:1629600786.description:
Holafly is your best travel companion. Stay connected wherever you go with Holafly's eSIM cards and enjoy Unlimited Data plans worldwide.
What is an eSIM card?
An eSIM card provides mobile data like a regular SIM card but is digital and international, eliminating expensive roaming fees. You can use an eSIM alongside your local SIM card to receive FaceTime calls, iMessages or WhatsApp messages with your regular number.
Why Choose Holafly?
Holafly is your go-to international prepaid eSIM provider, offering Unlimited Data with quick, easy connectivity.
With Holafly’s eSIM, you get:
Connection Anywhere, Anytime 
Enjoy fast, reliable Internet access during your international travels in over 200 destinations, with multiple plan options, with unlimited and limited data, that can be adapted to the days of your trip. Connect to the internet within minutes and enhance your travel experience.
Cost-Effective Connectivity 
Travel without the fear of extra expenses. Holafly offers prepaid eSIM cards with Unlimited Data coverage in over 200 destinations, including Europe, Mexico, China, Turkey, Japan, and the USA. You can also purchase limited data plans for other destinations and top-ups for extra data.
Easy Installation & Activation
Purchase your eSIM through the Holafly App with Apple Pay, Credit card or PayPal. Receive your eSIM in your email within just seconds. Install your eSIM seamlessly through the Holaly App with the help of our guides, videos, and offline content. The eSIM data will only start to be consumed once at your destination.
Data Plan Insights
Track your eSIM data usage, activation, and expiration dates through the app of one or multiple eSIMs. Top-up your eSIMs anytime you need extra data.
Universal Compatibility
Holafly's eSIM is compatible with all iPhones with technology-enabled eSIM (from iPhone XS, XR onwards). Check our compatibility guide for details.
How to Buy an eSIM?
Choose Your Plan
Download the app and choose your destination, select a plan according to your travel schedule, and continue to checkout (you can save your payment information for later purchases). You’ll receive your eSIM via email in seconds and can log in to the app to manage and set up your card.
Set Up Your eSIM
Install and activate your eSIM through the app. Log in using your email or your Apple account (make sure it matches the one you used for purchase). For iOS 17.4+ users, enjoy one-button installation. Alternatively, use QR or manual codes for setup, you can find step-by-step guides in our app; they are also sent by email.
Activate Your Data
Once you finish installing your eSIM, activate data roaming. Data will only start consuming once at your destination. Track data usage in real-time within the app of all your available eSIMs. That’s it! Start enjoying internet connectivity for all your trips.
24/7 Support
Need help? Contact our multilingual support team anytime inside the app with one button. We’re here to assist with the eSIM setup and any other questions.
Embark on your adventures with Holafly – made with love by people who love to travel. Stay connected worldwide—download the Holafly App now!
